article.articleHeadline: Xử lý ổ dịch nghi chó dại ở phường Phước Thắng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Containment of a suspected rabies outbreak in Phước Thắng Ward.
article.articleSummary: Containment of a suspected rabies outbreak in Phước Thắng Ward, Ho Chi Minh City, was reported on 21 April. From 13–17 April, a stray dog belonging to a resident bit three neighbors, killed four of its own dogs and bit seven to eight neighboring dogs. The dog died on 17 April; the owner dumped the carcass under a water body, preventing laboratory confirmation. On 19 April, all bite victims completed full post-exposure vaccination, and their health remains normal. An interdepartmental team conducted district surveillance and urged residents to confine dogs, with vaccination for 21 other dogs. Authorities warn rabies is nearly 100% fatal after symptom onset and emphasize routine canine vaccination, muzzle use when outdoors, and immediate wound care: wash with soap under running water for at least 15 minutes and initiate vaccination after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: フォック・タン地区における狂犬病疑い感染症の封じ込め
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ホーチミン市での狂犬病疑い事例であり、ヒト咬傷と動物への感染が確認されているが、被害者が既に予防接種を完了し健康状態は正常であり、現在の深刻度は限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は対象国（ベトナム）で報告されている。動物（野良犬）が複数の犬と人間（3名）を咬んでいるが、被害者は既に曝露後予防接種を完了し健康状態は正常である。死亡動物のラボ確認ができていないため、狂犬病の確定診断は未確認。地域レベルの公衆衛生対応は実施されている。スクリーニング基準2つ該当するが、重症度と国際的拡大リスクが低いため、フルRRA前の経過観察段階が適切。

article.articleHeadline: พบผู้ป่วย "โรคไข้ดิน" ระบาดในกลุ่มผู้สูงอายุและเกษตรกร จริงหรือไม่? : เช็กข่าวชัวร์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak of 'soil fever' among the elderly and farmers — true or not? Fact-check.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis outbreak in Thailand is real; 732 cases and 23 deaths reported nationwide during Jan 1–Apr 16, 2026, according to the Ministry of Public Health and the Department of Disease Control. Burkholderia pseudomallei, the causative bacterium, lives in soil and water; infection occurs from contact with contaminated soil or water via wounds, inhalation of dust, or drinking unclean water. Elderly individuals (50+) and those with diabetes or kidney disease are at higher risk for severe illness. Preventive measures include wearing boots and gloves when handling soil. The social-media posts warning of soil fever have been verified as factual by health authorities; while the situation warrants vigilance, there is no need for panic. If high fever persists more than 2 days, seek medical care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 「土壌熱」の流行が高齢者と農民の間で見られている？本当かどうか？ 事実確認
triage.triage_reason: タイで732例・死亡23例の咲きており、IHR基準2つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーには明確に「タイで732例、23例の死亡が2026年1月1日～4月16日に報告された」と記載されており、公式な保健省および疾病管理局からの確認がなされている。土壌・水由来のBurkholderia pseudomalleiによる感染で、高齢者（50歳以上）および糖尿病・腎臓病患者が高リスク。ソーシャルメディアでの警告は保健当局により検証済みで事実とされている。現在進行中の流行状況と思われる。

article.articleHeadline: Influenza cases rise nearly fivefold in March, authorities warn public | MACAU DAILY TIMES 澳門每日時報
article.articleSummary: {"description":"In March 2026, Macau documented 1,785 influenza infections, about 4.6× the 320 cases in March 2025 and 1.9× the 618 cases in February 2026. Notifiable diseases total reached 1,998. Influenza, norovirus, and enterovirus were the most common illnesses, with influenza and enterovirus rising MoM while rotavirus declined. Enterovirus infections numbered 50 in March, up 66.7% from 30 in March 2025 and ~1.6× the 19 cases in February 2026. Rotavirus fell to 11 cases, down 35.3% year-on-year and 63.3% from February. No dengue fever cases were recorded in March, but one imported chikungunya fever case was confirmed during the period. Health authorities urged residents to strengthen personal protective measures."}

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ感染者が3月に5倍近く増加、当局が国民に警告
triage.triage_reason: 単一地域（マカオ）での季節性インフルエンザの増加であり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生危機の直接的証拠に乏しい。ただし複数感染症の同時報告と当局の警告があるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: マカオはChina (1814991) に含められた。複数の呼吸器・腸管感染症が同時報告されているが、死亡や重症例の言及がなく、マカオ・中国内での局所的な季節性疾患と見られる。インフルエンザの月別増減は自然な季節パターンの可能性がある。1例の輸入チクングニア熱は国際的拡大リスクを示唆するが、現在のところ限定的。

article.articleHeadline: 28 cases test positive for Influenza B
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-22, the Health Bureau (SSM) reported six clusters of influenza-like illness in students who developed fever and respiratory symptoms, including cough, beginning Apr 17. A total of 48 students were affected across the six outbreaks, with most cases presenting mild symptoms. One patient required hospitalization and is in stable condition; no severe cases or major complications have been reported. Respiratory samples from the clusters identified 28 cases positive for Influenza B virus. Affected institutions have implemented enhanced cleaning and disinfection, improved indoor ventilation, and strict isolation protocols for infected individuals to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザBで28例が陽性
triage.triage_reason: マカオ（中国特別行政区）における学生のインフルエンザB集団発生。重症度は低く（軽症が多く、入院1例）、地域限定的だが、スクリーニング基準に部分的に該当し、情報収集継続を要する。
triage.notes: マカオは中国の特別行政区であり、China (1814991) に含める。学生集団発生で複数クラスター（6つ）が存在し、ヒト-ヒト感染が継続する環境（学校）である点が該当。ただし重症度が低く（軽症主体、入院1例のみ）、国際的拡大のリスク記載なし、管理可能（隔離・消毒実施中）であるため、IHR基準は未達成。スクリーニング基準は長期曝露と流行易感性で該当するが、社会的・政治的関心の明示的記載がないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: "โรคไข้ดิน" สธ.ยกระดับเฝ้าระวัง พบผู้ป่วย 752 ราย ตายแล้ว 23 ศพ  เช็กอาการด่วนก่อนสาย!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Soil Fever" Ministry of Public Health intensifies surveillance; 752 cases detected, 23 deaths. Check symptoms urgently before it's too late!
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, or 'soil fever', is intensifying surveillance in Thailand after 752 cases and 23 deaths were reported from January 1 to April 18, 2026. The disease-agent survives in soil and water and can enter the body through three routes. Common signs include high fever for more than two days, shortness of breath, chronic cough, joint or bone pain, and skin abscesses, especially with soil or water exposure. Diabetics and other vulnerable groups face higher risk of death. Early diagnosis is challenging due to non-specific symptoms, and delayed treatment can be life-threatening. Prevention focuses on wearing boots and vigilant symptom awareness ahead of the rainy season, when outbreaks intensify. About half of patients require hospitalization, highlighting the urgency of seeking medical care promptly if exposure history and symptoms coincide.

triage.headline_ja: 「土壌熱」タイ保健省が警戒体制を強化 患者752名、死亡者23名を報告 症状は早めにチェック！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目（重症度・管理可能性）が該当。752症例・23死亡という相応の患者数と死亡率が報告されており、シグナルとしてのフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 2026年1月1日～4月18日の累積で752症例・23死亡（致死率3.1%）。タイ保健省による警戒体制強化が公式に発表されている。土壌・水を環境源とする感染経路を持つため、雨季の流行に警告。易感染グループ（糖尿病患者等）での高い死亡リスク。診断遅延による重症化リスクが高い。国際的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 张文宏提醒：气候变化正改写传染病的地理边界
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Zhang Wenhong Warns: Climate Change Is Redrawing the Geographic Range of Infectious Diseases.
article.articleSummary: Zhang Wenhong warns climate change is reshaping the geographic range of infectious diseases. In Shanghai on April 20, 2026, Zhang, dean of Fudan University’s Institute of Infectious Diseases, warned at the NYU Shanghai cross-border climate and health lecture that warming, rainfall changes, expanding mosquito habitats, urbanization, and mobility push pathogens beyond traditional tropical zones. He cited Zika, dengue fever, and chikungunya fever as examples, noting dengue and other vector-borne diseases are now emerging in cooler regions, signaling a shifting global risk boundary. He warned antimicrobial resistance could become a major health threat by 2050 amid aging populations and antibiotic exposure. He called for cross-national, cross-disciplinary collaboration to build real-time surveillance, early warning, diagnostics, treatments, vaccines, and information sharing, aiming for 100 days of preparedness before the next pandemic and warning against unilateral action.

triage.headline_ja: 張文宏氏が警告：気候変動が感染症の地理的境界を書き換えている
triage.triage_reason: 気候変動に伴う感染症リスク変化に関する専門家の警告であり、異常性・予想外性は認められるが、実際の疫学的アウトブレイクではなく、情報が不十分。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際の疫学的発生事例ではなく、感染症専門家（張文宏氏）による気候変動と感染症リスク予測に関する警告・講演記録である。Zika、dengue、chikungunyaが言及されているが、これらは理論的な例示であり、中国での実際の患者発生は記載されていない。シャンハイでの講演開催地が対象国（China）に該当するため verified_locations に追加したが、イベントの性質上、シグナルとしての優先度は低い。今後、実際のアウトブレイク報告が続報された場合は PICKUP に昇格する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: GHIT Fund: Total Investment of Approx. USD 8.5 Million in Malaria and NTD R&D Projects With Partners Including MMV, GSK, Tanabe Pharma, Eisai and DNDi
article.articleSummary: GHIT Fund commits about JPY 1.37 billion (USD 8.5 million) across five malaria and NTD projects, with JPY 700 million (USD 4.4 million) for preclinical development of a new antimalarial drug led by MMV, Tanabe Pharma, and the University of Georgia, including potential long-acting injectable for P. vivax. Another JPY 330 million (USD 2 million) funds multicountry trials in Kenya, Senegal, and India to support regulatory registration of fosravuconazole for eumycetoma, a neglected disease affecting tens of thousands globally (over 100,000 may be living with it; thousands of new cases annually) with major burden in Africa, Asia, and the Latin American “mycetoma belt.” An additional JPY 340 million (USD 2.1 million) backs three projects: Prolyl tRNA synthetase inhibitors (MMV, GSK, Univ of Tokyo); Hit-to-Lead antimalarial (MMV, Daiichi Sankyo); and SHMT inhibitor screening (Eisai, MMV). As of 31 Mar 2026, 42 ongoing projects (20 discovery, 13 preclinical, 9 clinical); total GHIT investments since 2013: JPY 43.9B (USD 274M).

triage.headline_ja: GHIT Fund: マラリアおよびNTD研究開発プロジェクトに約850万米ドルの投資、MMV、GSK、田辺三菱製薬、エーザイ、DNDiなどのパートナーと共同実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究開発資金配分の発表であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクや急性的な公衆衛生上の危機を報告していない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当せず、シグナルレベルのイベントではない。
triage.notes: 記事は資金提供機関（GHIT Fund）による研究開発プロジェクト資金配分の発表である。マラリアおよびNTD（顧みられない熱帯病）の研究を支援するプログラムですが、具体的な感染症イベント（ケース報告、アウトブレイク、流行）の記述はない。言及されている国（ケニア、セネガル、インド）は臨床試験地として挙げられているが、これらの地域での新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。EBS活動のシグナル対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Secretaria da Agricultura emite alerta sanitário para risco de raiva em herbívoros no Noroeste gaúcho - Jornal O Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Agriculture issues sanitary alert for rabies risk in herbivores in northwestern Rio Grande do Sul - Jornal O Sul
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk alert for herbivores in Tiradentes do Sul and São Nicolau, northwestern Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, due to focal rabies linked to hematophagous bats (Desmodus rotundus). Regions at risk include Esperança do Sul, Crissiumal, Derrubadas, Pirapó, Garruchos and Dezesseis de Novembro. Wilson Hoffmeister, coordinator of Seapi's Rabies Control Program, reports teams monitor foci, investigate suspected cases, and implement sanitary measures, including herd vaccination; producers should vaccinate and not attempt to capture roosts, reporting roost locations to the inspectorate. Bat roosts include hollow trees, caves, crevices, burrows, tunnels and abandoned houses. Rabies control nuclei capture bats as needed; positive tests in herbivores trigger regional actions. Avian influenza at Taim Reserve closed on 16 April after 28 days with no new dead birds; 95 surveillance actions within 10 km and 22 poultry farm inspections were conducted. Avoid handling sick or dead birds; report suspicions to Seapi via WhatsApp (51) 98445-2033.

triage.headline_ja: 農業局がリオグランデドスル州北西部の草食動物における狂犬病リスクに対して衛生警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: 動物における狂犬病のアウトブレイク（コウモリ媒介）であり、公衆衛生への直接的な深刻性は限定的（ヒト感染ではなく家畜対象）。鳥インフルエンザも併記されているが、タイム保護区では終息状態。社会的関心はあるが国際的拡大リスクは低い。情報の完全性が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 複数の疾患（狂犬病、鳥インフルエンザ）が報告されているが、狂犬病は動物（ハナブラシムシ属コウモリ由来）の家畜感染に限定。鳥インフルエンザはタイム保護区で終息済み（4月16日に閉鎖、その後28日間新規発見なし）。ヒト感染のリスクは直接的には言及されていない。ブラジルは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: ചൂട് കൂടുന്നു, ഉദരരോഗങ്ങൾ പടരുന്നു: ജാഗ്രത പാലിക്കണമെന്ന് ആരോഗ്യവിദഗ്ധർ | Heatwave triggers stomach infections surge | Madhyamam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Heat is on the rise, stomach diseases are spreading: health experts urge vigilance.
article.articleSummary: Chandigarh faces a surge in stomach illnesses as heat and humidity rise. Hundreds of cases have been reported in ten days at Sector 16 Government Medical Specialty Hospital. Patients show nausea, abdominal pain, vomiting and fever. Doctors attribute a spike in typhoid and gastroenteritis to contaminated water and unhygienic food preparation. Fortis Hospital's Internal Medicine Director, Dr. Vikas Bhutani, warns that heat accelerates bacterial growth in foods such as Salmonella and E. coli, and reduces body fluids, weakening immunity and increasing susceptibility to viruses like influenza. To counteract, authorities urge regular water intake, even without thirst; avoid street-vended cut fruits and unsafe beverages; consume boiled or filtered water and avoid ice; eat only freshly cooked meals and discard perishable items left at room temperature for more than two hours. Health Department Director Dr. Suman Singh advises avoiding heavy meals during extreme heat; seek medical care promptly if symptoms persist.

triage.headline_ja: 気温上昇に伴い胃腸疾患が急増：保健専門家が警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インド・チャンディガル地域で10日間に数百例の胃腸疾患（チフス、腸炎）が報告され、複数の病原体（パラチフス、チフス、大腸菌、インフルエンザ）が検出されている。公衆衛生への影響が深刻であり、異常な発生パターンであるため。
triage.notes: チャンディガル地域での水・食品由来の胃腸感染症の集団発生。気温上昇により細菌増殖が加速し、複数の病原体が同時検出されている。記事は保健当局による公式な警告・対策指示を含んでいる。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh giác biến chứng nặng khi dịch tay-chân-miệng bùng phát
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be vigilant for severe complications during a hand-foot-mouth disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) outbreaks are being reported in Vietnam, with the 108 Military Central Hospital observing a surge in pediatric cases as summer begins. HFMD is caused mainly by Coxsackievirus A16 and Enterovirus 71 (EV71); EV71 is linked to severe complications such as encephalitis, meningitis, myocarditis, and acute pulmonary edema. In a 12‑month‑old admitted to the Pediatrics department, fever to 39.3°C, vesicular lesions on hands and feet, and oral ulcers were documented; diagnosed as HFMD grade 2A and managed with continuous monitoring of heart rate, temperature, respiration, and SpO2, plus infection-control precautions. The disease progresses through incubation (3–7 days), prodrome (1–2 days), and the full stage (3–10 days) with mouth ulcers, drooling, and vesicles on hands, feet, knees, and buttocks. Four severity levels are described; level 3 involves neurologic, cardiovascular, or respiratory complications; level 4 includes shock and pulmonary edema. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, daily bathing, hydration, soft foods, and seeking urgent care for persistent high fever, seizures or altered consciousness, vomiting, or breathing difficulty.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の流行時に重症合併症に注意
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで手足口病（特にEV71）の流行が報告され、小児患者の急増と重症合併症（脳炎、髄膜炎、心筋炎）のリスクが明記されており、IHR基準2項目以上該当、またWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: EV71関連の脳炎・髄膜炎・心筋炎・急性肺水腫などの重症合併症が明示されており、小児患者の急増報告がある。夏季に向けた季節的なリスク増加。記事はベトナム保健当局からの注意喚起の性格。

article.articleHeadline: Đề nghị hỗ trợ hơn 100 tỷ đồng phục vụ phòng, chống dịch trên vật nuôi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proposal for over 100 billion VND to support disease prevention and control in livestock.
article.articleSummary: Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, projects total funding needs of 142.978 billion VND for animal disease prevention and control in 2025 under Decree 116/2025/NĐ-CP. Of this, 134.548 billion VND covers losses from July 25, 2025 to December 31, 2025; 6.276 billion VND covers losses prior to July 25; and 2.154 billion VND funds participants in prevention and control efforts. The package targets damages from African Swine Fever, Lumpy Skin Disease in cattle, and Foot-and-Mouth Disease. To ensure proactive policy implementation, Ha Tinh’s People’s Committee seeks a Ministry of Finance allocation of 100.1 billion VND. The province notes ongoing, complex outbreaks amid constrained local funding. In 2025, African Swine Fever affected 65 communes/wards, leading to culling of over 52,000 pigs and losses of about 142 billion VND.

triage.headline_ja: 家畜疾病の予防・抑制を支援するため100億ドン以上の支援提案
triage.triage_reason: 複数の動物疾病（ASF、LSD、FMD）の同時発生が報告されているが、記事の主眼は資金提案であり、急速な国際的拡大の懸念は明記されていない。情報不足のため経過観察段階とする。
triage.notes: 記事は動物疾病（ASF、LSD、FMD）の同時発生をベトナムのHa Tinh省で報告している。ASFで52,000頭以上の豚が殺処分されるなど深刻な経済的影響がある。ただし記事の主眼は資金支援の提案であり、人間への感染や国際的な感染拡大の具体的な懸念は記述されていない。動物疾病であるため人獣感染（zoonotic）リスクの言及がないことも注視が必要。IHR基準の「国際的拡大リスク」「渡航・貿易制限リスク」は記事から明確に判断できないため、スクリーニング段階での評価としてはWATCHとした。

article.articleHeadline: Xử phạt người đăng tin sai sự thật vụ thịt lợn nhiễm bệnh vào trường học ở Hà Nội
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Punished the person who posted false information about the incident of diseased pork entering a school in Hanoi.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-22, Hanoi's Chuong My Ward Police fined a 38-year-old man 7.5 million VND for posting false, unverified information about African swine fever–infected pork entering a Hanoi school. The administrative violation involved providing or sharing misinformation that damaged the credibility of a government agency and individuals. The case arises amid Hanoi’s ongoing food-safety investigations, including findings that Cuong Phat Food Co., Ltd. supplied pork infected with African swine fever to several city schools, triggering public concern. Before an official conclusion was issued, some online posts propagated unverified content. After counseling, the respondent, T.D.Q., acknowledged the violation, paid the fine, and pledged not to repeat the act, under Decree 15/2020/NĐ-CP (as amended by Decree 14/2022/NĐ-CP), Article 101, Clause 1, Point a.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイの学校への感染豚肉事件に関する虚偽情報を投稿した者に罰金
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱の動物への影響が確認されているが、本記事の主題は虚偽情報投稿への行政罰であり、直接的な新規感染事例報告ではない。ただしハノイでの豚肉感染事例そのものは実在し、食品安全上の潜在的懸念があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は虚偽情報投稿への罰金処分であるが、背景としてCuong Phat Food Co., Ltd.がハノイの複数の学校に豚熱感染豚肉を供給したという実質的な食品安全事象が確認されている。動物への影響カテゴリが付与されているが、ヒト感染のリスクは記事中に明示されていない。アフリカ豚熱は動物疾病であり、ヒト感染リスクは一般的に極めて低い。今後の感染拡大状況に関する続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Suspek Campak Meningkat di Awal 2026, Lebih dari 8.000 Kasus Dilaporkan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Measles Cases Rise in Early 2026, More Than 8,000 Cases Reported.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports early-2026 measles transmission with over 8,000 suspected cases and 21 outbreaks (KLB) in 17 regencies/cities across 11 provinces, with some outbreaks laboratory-confirmed. Dr. Relly Reagen of BRN warns measles is highly contagious and not a mild illness, typically starting with flu-like symptoms (fever, runny nose, cough, fatigue) and muscle pain, followed by a spreading red rash. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets and contaminated objects, with the highest risk to children and the immunocompromised. Complications can be severe, including pneumonia and encephalitis, and death is possible especially in malnourished or young children. Vaccination remains the most effective prevention. Authorities urge strengthened routine and catch-up immunization, enhanced surveillance, and better risk communication to counter vaccine misinformation. Health centers and hospitals must collaborate, while public participation is key amid waning post-pandemic immunization and high mobility.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年初頭に麻疹疑い症例が増加、8,000件以上の症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで麻疹の大規模流行が確認され、8,000件以上の疑い症例と21のアウトブレイク（17郡市、11州）が報告されている。麻疹は高伝播性で重篤合併症（肺炎・脳炎）および死亡のリスクがあり、IHR基準（異常性・重症度）およびWPRO基準（流行性・管理可能性）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア当局（BRN）による公式警告を含み、ワクチン未接種率の上昇とパンデミック後の予防接種率低下を背景としている。複数州にまたがるアウトブレイクであり、ワクチン接種による管理が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh 'sốt đất ' làm 23 người chết tại Thái Lan: Bộ Y tế cảnh báo, đưa ra các biện pháp phòng ngừa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The "soil fever" disease has killed 23 people in Thailand: the Ministry of Health warns and issues preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 732 Whitmore (melioidosis, 'soil fever') cases and 23 deaths as of April 22, 2026, prompting a warning from the Ministry of Public Health. Caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, the disease is environmental—found in soil, mud, and contaminated water—and is not primarily transmitted person-to-person. Endemic across Southeast Asia and northern Australia; Vietnam also records sporadic annual cases, often after heavy rains and flooding. High-risk groups include farmers and persons with diabetes, liver or kidney disease, chronic lung disease, or immune suppression. Clinically, Whitmore presents variably, with pneumonia, organ abscesses, sepsis, or septic shock, and may be fatal without timely treatment. Eight preventive measures emphasize avoiding direct exposure to contaminated soil/water, using protective gear, protecting wounds, good hygiene, safe water and food, tailored precautions for those with comorbidities, and seeking prompt medical care if fever, respiratory symptoms, or soft tissue infections develop after exposure, especially post-disasters.

triage.headline_ja: タイで「土の病気」が23人を死亡させる：保健省が警告し予防措置を発表
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスによる23人の死亡と732例の確認患者がタイで報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）を満たし、該当地域での重症度と管理上の懸念が認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、タイが主要な発生国（732例、23人死亡）であり、ベトナムでも散発例が報告されている。オーストラリアは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーではタイとベトナムが現在の流行地として扱われているため、タイとベトナムのみを verified_locations に含める。メリオイドーシスは環境由来（土壌、泥、汚染水）で人人感染は主要ではないが、集団発生と高い死亡率により公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Jessica Iskandar Demam Tinggi hingga 39 Derajat, Alami Gejala Hepatitis A : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jessica Iskandar Has a Fever as High as 39°C, Experiences Symptoms of Hepatitis A: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Indonesian actress Jessica Iskandar was hospitalized in Jakarta after being diagnosed with symptoms consistent with Hepatitis A. She reported a high fever reaching 39.3°C, occurring nightly for several days, with temperatures fluctuating—rising despite medication, then falling, and rising again. The febrile episodes reportedly happened within the past two months and lasted about three days. Initial blood tests showed no clear indicators, leading clinicians to monitor further; after additional testing and another hospital admission, doctors concluded the presentation matched Hepatitis A symptoms. The report does not provide details on exposure, vaccination status, or the eventual outcome. This health update documents a personal medical episode involving a public figure in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: ジェシカ・イスカンダル39℃の高熱、A型肝炎の症状を経験：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: 個人の有名人の医学的エピソードに関する報告。集団感染の証拠がなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 本報告は有名人（ジェシカ・イスカンダル）の個人的な医学的エピソードであり、集団発生やアウトブレイクの証拠はない。A型肝炎の発生地がインドネシア（ジャカルタ）であることは確認できるが、公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報がないため、シグナルとしてのピックアップは不要。

article.articleHeadline: 衞生防護中心稱登革熱本地傳播風險屬中等　會加強蚊患監測工作 - RTHK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Health Protection says the local dengue fever transmission risk is moderate; will strengthen mosquito surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports the year's first locally acquired dengue case, a 21-year-old man. The Centre for Health Protection says local transmission risk is moderate but controllable. So far this year, 13 dengue cases have been recorded: 12 imported and 1 local, suggesting undiagnosed imported cases may be circulating and transmitted by local mosquitoes. Rising temperatures and the rainy season favor Aedes breeding, with dengue activity in Southeast Asia keeping outbreak risk non-negligible. The local case occurred at a construction site near Zhugao Bay, Lantau Island; authorities are intensifying vector control there. Dengue symptoms include fever, muscle pain, and headache; seek care if symptoms appear after travel. Measles cases total five this year: two imported from Indonesia, one local, and two linked to the local case in an airport cluster. Vaccination coverage exceeds 90%, and seroprevalence is high across ages, suggesting a low large-outbreak risk.

triage.headline_ja: 衞生防護中心稱登革熱本地傳播風險屬中等　會加強蚊患監測工作
triage.triage_reason: 香港でのデング熱の本地感染症例とはしか症例が報告された。本地感染の確認、国際的な広がりリスク（東南アジアでの流行背景）、ベクター媒介感染の継続リスク、および社会的関心が認められ、IHR基準3項目該当しWPRO基準も複数該当するためピックアップ。
triage.notes: 香港は中国に含める（指示の7番ルール）。インドネシアは輸入症例の発生源として記事中で明記されているため verified_locations に含める。デング熱の本地感染は香港では通常でなく、東南アジア地域での継続的な流行背景により国際的リスクが認識される。ワクチンカバレッジが高いため大規模流行リスクは低いとされているが、ベクター媒介感染の継続と気候要因（気温上昇、雨季）による蚊の増殖環境の悪化が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Cao Bằng ngăn dịch tả lợn châu Phi lan rộng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cao Bằng Province Prevents African Swine Fever From Spreading
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) is being contained in Cao Bằng Province, Vietnam, where nearly 400 pigs have been culled since the start of the year, amounting to over 16,000 kg of meat. Infection hotspots include tổ dân phố 1 in phường Nùng Trí Cao and xóm Bản Nha, Bản Thưn in xã Vinh Quý; as of 15 April, six communes/wards remain under 21 days of monitoring. Authorities have rapid-response measures: culling affected pigs, restricting pig purchases and transport, and conducting disinfection spraying to prevent wider spread. Residents are advised to maintain gap controls, isolate cases, and avoid selling sick pigs outside the area; vaccination against other infectious diseases is recommended to bolster biosecurity. Cao Bằng’s Department of Agriculture has distributed over 3,000 liters of disinfectant since the year’s start. Officials warn the risk of re-emergence persists without ongoing vigilance, as Thái Nguyên Province also undertakes proactive, grassroots prevention efforts.

triage.headline_ja: カオバン省がアフリカブタ熱病の蔓延を防止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカブタ熱病（ASF）は動物疾病であり、記事では当局が適切に管理・対応中であることが示されている。ただし、再出現のリスクが存在し、拡大の可能性が完全には排除されていないため、経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病であり、人間への直接的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は記事では示されていない。ただしベトナムでの継続的な流行リスク、越境感染の可能性、地域内での継続的な曝露リスク（WPRO基準2項目該当）があるため、WATCH判定。当局の対応は活発であり管理可能と見られるが、再出現のリスク警告により続報の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 11:46:50香港錄今年首宗登革熱本地個案 歐家榮：本地傳播風險屬中等水平
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11:46:50 Hong Kong records this year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case; Ou Ka-wing: local transmission risk is moderate.
article.articleSummary: First locally transmitted dengue fever case in Hong Kong this year: a 21-year-old man tested positive and is in stable condition. Infection is believed to have occurred near a Tseung Kwan O construction site on Long Hin Road; the patient has no travel history. Dr. Ou Ka-wing, Director of the Centre for Infectious Diseases, says local transmission risk is moderate, with overall risk controllable. Aedes albopictus is present in Hong Kong, and Southeast Asia’s high dengue activity suggests more imported cases. Warmer weather and the rainy season will boost mosquito breeding. The construction site is halted pending vector control and worker health monitoring; Tai Wo Estate Plaza will offer screening and free dengue antibody tests. As of Apr 21, HK has 13 dengue cases this year (12 imported, 1 local). Incubation is 3–14 days; common symptoms include fever, headache, myalgia, retro-orbital pain, rash, vomiting. Residents should remove standing water and use DEET repellents.

triage.headline_ja: 香港、今年初の登革熱ローカル感染例を記録　欧家榮：地元感染リスクは中程度
triage.triage_reason: 香港での登革熱ローカル感染の初例であり異常性・予想外性があり、スクリーニング基準を満たすが、当局が感染リスクを「中程度・制御可能」と評価し、死亡や重症例の報告がなく、国際的拡大の直接的根拠に乏しい。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 香港でのローカル感染確認は異常性が高いが、現段階では個別事例であり死亡・重症例の報告がない。東南アジアの高い流行活動を背景に、今後の輸入例増加と関連感染者の出現が懸念される。蚊媒介対策とサーベイランス強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Campak Meluas di Garut, 35 Kecamatan Terdampak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles cases spread in Garut, 35 districts affected.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Garut, West Java, have spread to 35 subdistricts, with 110 confirmed cases across ages from toddlers to adults, though the trend is waning. A mass immunization drive targets 168,383 children aged 9–59 months and has achieved 81.47% coverage in three weeks, continuing into the second week of May 2026. Health authorities confirm vaccine safety, including syringes used in immunizations. Garut is among 102 districts nationally prioritized for measles control, with accelerated vaccination also underway in Tasikmalaya. Common symptoms include high fever, red skin rash, and sometimes cough and diarrhea, which can lead to complications. Authorities urge caregivers to promptly seek medical care at health facilities to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ガルート地区で麻疹が拡大、35地区で感染
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・ガルート地区での麻疹集団発生。110確認例、35地区に拡大、死亡情報なく管理中だが、全国102地区の優先対象（流行リスク地域）に含まれ、公衆衛生対応が展開されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに示された実際の発生地域はガルート（Garut）、タシクマラヤ（Tasikmalaya）、西ジャワ州（Jawa Barat）であり、いずれもインドネシア国内。110確認例、35地区の地理的拡大、国内102地区での優先対策対象という背景から、WPRO基準の異常性・重症度・流行性・継続的曝露の4つが該当。死亡情報は記載されておらず、予防接種対応が81.47%カバレッジで進行中の管理可能な状況だが、シグナルとして扱う価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首宗本地登革熱　防護中心指本地傳播風險屬中等水平
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case; Centre for Health Protection says local transmission risk is moderate.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports this year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case as of 22 April 2026: a 21-year-old man in stable condition. He was bitten by mosquitoes while working at a roadworks site on Langhin Road, Lantau Island. The Centre for Health Protection's Infectious Disease Office attributes likely local infection to exposure at the work site; nearby areas have undergone environmental sanitation and mosquito control. Local transmission risk is moderate; though most dengue cases in Hong Kong are imported, this incident shows undiagnosed imported infections may circulate locally and infect local mosquitoes. Dengue activity remains high in nearby Southeast Asia, and rising temperatures plus the rainy season may increase imported cases. CHP will maintain surveillance and vector control. Citizens should take anti-mosquito measures and seek medical care for fever and muscle pain, especially after travel.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の地域内感染デング熱　保健防護センターは地域内伝播リスクは中程度と指摘
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の地域内感染事例1件の報告だが、香港当局がリスクを「中程度」と評価しており、重症度情報が限定的（安定状態）。スクリーニング基準の複数項目で情報が不十分なため、続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は香港での地域内感染報告。香港は中国に含める。患者は21歳で安定状態だが、重症度の詳細情報が不明。東南アジアでのデング活動が高く、気温上昇と雨季により輸入症例が増加する可能性について言及されている。香港当局が継続的な監視とベクター管理を実施予定。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh Whitmore tại Thái Lan tăng, Cục Phòng bệnh khuyến cáo 8 biện pháp phòng ngừa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Whitmore's disease on the rise in Thailand, the Department of Disease Prevention recommends 8 preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Whitmore's disease (Melioidosis), caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is linked to soil, mud and contaminated surface water. Transmission occurs via contaminated skin contact, inhalation of dusty droplets, or consumption of polluted water or food. Thailand reported 732 cases and 23 deaths from January–April 2026, with farmers and others in frequent contact with soil and water most affected; authorities consider the outbreak concerning and are maintaining surveillance. The bacterium is environmental and not typically human-to-human, with clinical manifestations ranging from fever and pneumonia to organ abscesses, septicemia, and septic shock, potentially fatal if untreated. Vietnam’s Department of Preventive Medicine lists eight preventive measures: limit exposure to soil, mud and dirty water; wear protective gear; cover wounds; avoid barefoot contact in wet areas; maintain hand hygiene; use clean water and safe food; pay special attention for those with diabetes, liver, kidney or lung disease or immune compromise; seek prompt medical care if symptoms arise after exposure, especially after heavy rains.

triage.headline_ja: タイでホイットモア病（メリオイドーシス）が増加、疾病予防局が8つの予防措置を推奨
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるメリオイドーシスの集団発生（2026年1～4月で732例、23名死亡）が報告され、IHR基準2つ以上を満たし、公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、および国際的な地域的懸念が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事は主にタイの発生状況（732例、23名死亡）に焦点を当てており、ベトナムは予防措置の推奨情報源として言及されているが、ベトナムでの実際の発生事例は記述されていないため、verified_locationsにはタイのみを含める。4月末時点での数値であり、継続的な監視が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: 23 người ở Thái Lan tử vong do bệnh 'sốt đất' , Bộ Y tế Việt Nam ra khuyến cáo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 23 people in Thailand died from melioidosis, Vietnam's Ministry of Health has issued a warning.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis in Thailand: 732 cases and 23 deaths reported in April 2026. Exposure is environmental, with farm workers and others in frequent contact with soil and water; person-to-person transmission is not typical. The disease is common in Southeast Asia and Australia. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health has issued a warning, urging prevention and early recognition. In Vietnam, sporadic cases occur yearly, rising after heavy rains and floods. Authorities list eight measures: minimize direct contact with soil, mud, and contaminated water; wear footwear and gloves when farming or cleaning; cover and care for open wounds; avoid barefoot exposure in wet areas and avoid bathing in contaminated waters; maintain hygiene and wash hands; use safe water and food; pay extra attention for people with diabetes, kidney disease, chronic lung disease, liver disease, and immunosuppression; seek medical care promptly if fever, cough, chest pain, shortness of breath, abscesses, or prolonged infection after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: タイで23人がメリオイドーシスで死亡、ベトナム保健省が警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: タイで732例、23人の死亡を含む重症メリオイドーシス集団発生が報告され、重症度が高く、ベトナムを含む地域での公衆衛生上の懸念から、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）を複数満たす。また社会的関心および行政関心が存在する。
triage.notes: タイにおける集団発生（732例、23死亡）が記事の主題であり、ベトナム保健省による公式警告が発出されている。環境曝露（土壌・水との接触）が主な感染経路で、ヒト-ヒト感染は典型的ではない。東南アジアとオーストラリアで地風土病的に存在するが、タイでの急増と重症度の高さ、ベトナムでの警告体制の発動が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: "जोधपुर में वायरल का अटैक!" क्या आप भी हैं बदलते मौसम से परेशान?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Viral attack in Jodhpur! Are you also troubled by the changing weather?
article.articleSummary: As of 22 April 2026, viral fever cases are rising in Jodhpur, Rajasthan, amid extreme heat and cold winds. Mahatma Gandhi Hospital (MGH) Superintendent Dr. Fateh Singh says seasonal weather shifts temporarily weaken immunity, allowing respiratory viruses and bacteria to attack the system. Patients show high fever with sore throat and mild breathing difficulty; no specific case counts are provided. He urges mask use, covering the mouth while coughing or sneezing, and regular handwashing, and cautions against self-medication, especially for the elderly and children. The report notes dairy products spoil more rapidly in heat, increasing food-poisoning risk; advice emphasizes fresh, easily digestible meals and staying hydrated with lemon water, buttermilk, or coconut water. Preventive steps include avoiding very cold foods, maintaining hydration, exercise, and adequate sleep. Health authorities are monitoring the situation and ensuring medicines and resources in hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: ジョードプルでウイルス攻撃！変わる天気に困っていませんか？
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illnessの季節性ウイルス熱で、具体的な患者数、死亡例、異常な重症度の報告がなく、ルーチンな季節感染症の一般的な注意喚起と判断される。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当が不十分。
triage.notes: 記事は季節変動に伴う一般的なウイルス熱の予防啓発であり、疾患名が『Unknown Illness』と不特定、具体的患者数の報告がなく、重症化事例の記載もない。気象変動による一時的な免疫低下による一般的感染症リスク増加との説明で、公衆衛生危機の兆候には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue fever transmission risk is moderate: CHP - RTHK
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever transmission risk in Hong Kong SAR is moderate as of 2026-04-22 following the year's first local case. A 21-year-old man at a Penny's Bay construction site is suspected to have been bitten by mosquitoes; he is in stable condition in hospital. Twelve other dengue cases this year were acquired outside the city. With rising temperatures and the rainy season, environments favor mosquito breeding, and infection rates in Southeast Asia and neighbouring regions remain high, so outbreak risk cannot be neglected, though overall risk is preventable and manageable. Authorities will maintain monitoring and preventative measures; the construction site operation has been suspended until mosquito control measures are implemented. Separately, Hong Kong has five measles cases this year: one local, two linked to Indonesia, and two connected to one imported case. Two-dose measles vaccine rate exceeds 95%, with high population immunity.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の感染リスクは中程度：香港衛生防護センター
triage.triage_reason: デング熱と麻疹の複合発生で複数のWPRO基準に該当するが、香港当局は状況を管理可能と評価しており、重症度や国際的拡大の直接的兆候が明確でない。情報不足のため経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではデング熱の本発生地は香港特別行政区であり、インドネシアは麻疹症例の関連地として言及されているのみ。香港は対象国リストに含まれないため、China(香港を含む)として verified_locations に含める。インドネシアは麻疹輸入症例の関連地域としてのみ言及され、デング熱の本発生地ではないため除外。当局は状況を「予防可能・管理可能」と評価しており、PICKUP基準には達していないと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Узбекистан ввёл спецрежим из-за нового типа ящура
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uzbekistan has introduced a special regime due to a new type of foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) is a concern in Uzbekistan, where April 18–May 18 has been designated a month of sanitary-epidemiological hygiene in animal husbandry. The World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) notes 48 countries reported new SAT serotype FMD viruses in 2025–2026; this serotype, traditionally African, is spreading to other regions. Vaccines currently used do not offer full protection against SAT, making farmer vigilance essential to prevent spread. In early April, Uzbek social media claimed mass cattle illness in the Fergana Valley; authorities clarified it was stomatitis in cattle linked to rising temperatures, not FMD. Classic FMD symptoms include high fever, ulcers in the mouth and on hooves, and udder lesions. Suspected cases require immediate isolation, quarantine until a veterinarian arrives, and strict biosecurity including milk boiling and disinfection. China subsequently reported FMD near the border with Kazakhstan and Russia.

triage.headline_ja: ウズベキスタンが新型口蹄疫により特別体制を導入
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の新型SAT血清型が中央アジアからアジア地域に拡大しており、ウズベキスタン、カザフスタン、ロシア、中国で確認されている。国際的な拡大リスク、対象国での発生、および家畜産業への重大な影響があり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、ウズベキスタン、カザフスタン、ロシア、中国における口蹄疫SAT血清型の発生が述べられているが、対象国リスト内に該当するのは中国（1814991）のみ。SAT血清型は2025-2026年に48ヶ国で報告され、従来のアフリカ型が他地域に拡大している点が重要。現在のワクチンではSATに対する完全な防御効果がなく、管理難度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Căn bệnh khiến Thái Lan cảnh báo khẩn: Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo người dân 8 biện pháp phòng chống
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Disease prompts urgent warning in Thailand: Ministry of Health recommends eight preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Thailand faces rising Whitmore (melioidosis) activity in January–April, recording 732 cases and 23 deaths. Caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, bacteria inhabit soil, mud, and contaminated water and infect people via skin wounds, contact with contaminated material, inhalation of dust, or consumption of contaminated water or food. Diagnosis is challenging due to diverse presentations; can cause pneumonia, abscesses in multiple organs, septicemia, and septic shock if untreated. High-risk groups include diabetes, liver, kidney, lung diseases, immunodeficiency, and frequent exposure to soil, mud, or water. Transmission is environmental, not typically person-to-person. Thailand’s Health Ministry urges eight preventive measures: minimize contact with soil/water; wear protective gear; cover wounds; avoid barefoot exposure; practice hand hygiene; use clean water and safe foods; protect at-risk individuals; seek medical care promptly if fever, cough, chest pain, boils, or infection after exposure. Whitmore is common in Southeast Asia and Northern Australia; Vietnam reports cases, with higher risk after rains.

triage.headline_ja: タイの緊急警告を促す疾病：保健省が8つの予防措置を国民に推奨
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。タイでの急速な患者増加（732例、23死亡）と政府の公式警告により社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはタイの2026年1月～4月のメリオイドーシス急増を主題としており、732例・23死亡という実質的な患者数増加を報告。タイ保健省が公式に8つの予防措置を推奨。記事ではベトナムも患者報告があると言及されている。オーストラリアはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでは「Southeast Asia and Northern Australia where Whitmore is common」と背景情報として述べられており、現在進行中のイベントの主体ではない。したがって verified_locations はタイとベトナムのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Released palmitic acid-mediated TLR4/NF-κB activation enhances the virulence of Bordetella pertussis MT28 lineage - Nature Communications
article.articleSummary: Whooping cough has resurged globally; in China, the macrolide-resistant Bordetella pertussis MT28 lineage carrying the high-virulence ptxP3 allele (ptxP3 MR-MT28, MT28) has become predominant. This study combines epidemiological surveillance with genomic, phenotypic, and in vitro and in vivo analyses of representative clinical isolates and finds MT28 strains display enhanced colonization and heightened inflammatory potential. Transcriptomic data show upregulation of virulence genes ptxA, fhaB, tcfA, and bvgA, providing molecular grounding for these traits. Lipid-targeted metabolomics and LC-MS identify B. pertussis–derived palmitic acid as a pro-inflammatory mediator that amplifies MT28-driven inflammation via TLR4/NF-κB signaling. Together, these results illuminate a lipid-driven inflammatory pathway contributing to MT28 pathogenicity and pertussis virulence, with implications for surveillance and therapy.

triage.headline_ja: パルミチン酸の遊離によるTLR4/NF-κB活性化がBordetella pertussis MT28株の病原性を増強する - Nature Communications
triage.triage_reason: 中国における百日咳の再流行が報告され、薬剤耐性で高病原性のMT28株の優位化が確認されている。国際的な公衆衛生への関心が高く、分子メカニズムの解明が報告されている。
triage.notes: Nature Communicationsに掲載される査読済み論文であり、科学的信頼性が高い。百日咳の世界的な再流行という背景の中で、中国における薬剤耐性・高病原性株の優位化と分子メカニズムの解明が報告されている。監視と治療戦略への重要な示唆が含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Health Alert: तेजी से फैल रहा ये वायरस, घर-घर पहुंचा बुखार...लगातार बढ़ रहे मामले
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Alert: This virus is spreading rapidly, fever has reached every household... cases are on the rise.
article.articleSummary: Rapidly spreading viral illness linked to changing weather is affecting Jodhpur and the entire state of Rajasthan, with rising cases of fever, cold, and viral fever. Patients show high fever, sore throat, cough, and mild breathing difficulty; hospital admissions are increasing, with Mahatma Gandhi Hospital (MGH) in Jodhpur cited. Health officials urge reintroduction of masks, cover mouths while coughing or sneezing, and strict hand hygiene to curb transmission. The changing climate is said to weaken immunity, fueling spread of respiratory infections; risk of food poisoning rises as dairy products spoil in warmer weather. Practical measures include avoiding cold items like ice cream and cold drinks, staying hydrated with water, lime water, buttermilk, or coconut water, eating fresh home-cooked meals, and maintaining regular exercise and adequate sleep to bolster immunity.

triage.headline_ja: 健康警告：このウイルスが急速に拡大、熱が家々に到達...症例が急増している
triage.triage_reason: インドのラージャスターン州ジョードプルで原因不明の急速に広がるウイルス性疾患が報告されており、複数のWPRO基準に該当するが、疾患の具体的な特定がなく、国際的拡大リスクの確実性が不明な段階。情報が不足しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 疾患が「Unknown Illness」と分類されており、具体的な病原体が特定されていない。記事サマリーでは呼吸器感染症（発熱、咽頭痛、咳、軽度の呼吸困難）と気候変動との関連が述べられている。病院入院が増加しており、公衆衛生官庁からマスク使用などの感染対策が呼びかけられている。IHR基準2つ該当かつWPRO基準4つ該当で、通常はPICKUPとなるべき案件だが、疾患の特異性が不明で、記事が一般的なウイルス性呼吸器感染症の季節的増加の可能性も示唆しており、新規病原体や深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威かどうかが確認できていない。より詳細な情報（病原体特定、国際的な確認、死亡率など）を待つため、WATCHレベルとした。

article.articleHeadline: Cerita Jessica Iskandar Terpapar Hepatitis A karena Imunitas Menurun : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jessica Iskandar's Story: Contracted Hepatitis A Due to Weakened Immunity - Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Jessica Iskandar contracted Hepatitis A, linking the illness to a weakened immune system from prolonged sleep deprivation while exclusively breastfeeding her second child. The Jakarta-based celebrity, speaking in Thamrin, Central Jakarta, says infection may stem from less hygienic food, with exposure thought to occur about two weeks after consumption. The report provides no laboratory confirmation, no case counts, and describes a single case rather than an outbreak. It emphasizes how extended fatigue and poor sleep can heighten susceptibility to infections from contaminated food. No details are given on treatment, vaccination, or public health interventions. Published 2026-04-22, the piece notes the location (Jakarta Pusat/Thamrin) and frames this as an individual incident rather than imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ジェシカ・イスカンダルのストーリー：免疫低下によるA型肝炎感染 - Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: 単一の著名人の個人的な感染事例であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生を示す証拠がない。検査確認、複数症例、流行の兆候がすべて欠落している。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシアの著名人（Jessica Iskandar）の個人的な感染事例を報じたものであり、公衆衛生上の疾病流行（アウトブレイク）ではない。検査確認なし、複数症例の報告なし、集団発生の兆候なし。A型肝炎は一般的な疾患であり、個人事例の報道だけではシグナル検出の対象外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Gripe K: sete em cada dez casos sequenciados são H3N2; Saúde reforça importância da vacina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza K: seven out of ten sequenced cases are H3N2; Health reinforces the importance of the vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Influenza K has emerged in Brazil, with initial cases identified in late 2025, and seven of ten sequenced infections are H3N2, underscoring ongoing viral mutation. Public health officials reiterate that seasonal influenza vaccines are updated annually, and vaccines available through the SUS protect against Influenza K and other circulating strains. The National Vaccination Campaign runs through May 30 across the Northeast, Central-West, South, and Southeast regions, aiming to bolster protection before winter. To date, more than 10 million doses have been administered, including 7.4 million in priority groups (children, pregnant women, and elderly). Influenza K presents with fever, severe muscle pains, sore throat, dry cough, headache, and fatigue, similar to other influenza strains. Health authorities emphasize vaccination as a key preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザK：配列決定された症例の10例中7例がH3N2。保健当局がワクチンの重要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでH3N2亜型のインフルエンザK（季節性インフルエンザ）が報告されているが、既知の季節性ウイルスの変異の範囲内であり、IHR基準の2つ以上に該当しない。ただしウイルス特性と国内対応の進展について情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 既知の季節性インフルエンザH3N2亜型に関する報道であり、ブラジルの公衆衛生当局は予防接種キャンペーンで対応中。10万例超の一般的な重症度報告がなく、緊急の国際的支援の必要性は認められない。ただし、「Influenza K」という名称や新興ウイルス表記の可能性について、今後の遺伝子解析情報と国際的な確認情報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 登革熱疫情升溫 翁章梁率隊掃除積水、斷絕蚊蟲孳生 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever outbreak intensifies as Weng Zhangliang leads team to remove standing water and halt mosquito breeding
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases imported into Taiwan with intensified prevention in Chiayi County as authorities warn ahead of the rainy season. In Chiayi, the Environmental Protection Bureau strengthens surveillance, partnering with the Ministry of the Environment to mobilize civil groups and communities for dengue control. Governor Weng Zhangliang attended a Dengue Vector Clearing Pledge at Yuanshan Temple in Lucao (鹿草圓山宮) to rally local participation. The campaign focuses on eliminating standing water and suppressing Aedes mosquito breeding, with symptoms including fever, orbital pain, and hemorrhagic rash; new tools include telescopic poles for larvicide application on roof eaves without climbing, plus drone patrols and disinfection equipment. Deputy Director Liu Ruixiang notes global dengue totals around 500,000 with over 100 deaths; Asia, notably Indonesia and Cambodia, shows tripled cases. Taiwan emphasizes proactive environmental cleanup and the four actions: patrol, drain, clean, and brush to prevent imported dengue cases.

triage.headline_ja: 登革熱疫情升溫 翁章梁率隊掃除積水、斷絕蚊蟲孳生（デング熱流行が加熱、翁章梁知事がチームを率いて積水を除去し蚊の繁殖を遮断）
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのデング熱輸入症例と防疫強化が報告されているが、具体的な症例数、死亡数、院内感染拡大の有無など重症度の詳細が不明。地域限定的な防疫活動段階の報告であり、現時点では確定的なシグナル化には情報不足。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは台湾、インドネシア、カンボジアが言及されているが、実際の発生地は台湾（嘉義県）の輸入症例と防疫活動が主題。インドネシアとカンボジアは全球的なデング熱動向の文脈として言及されており、これらの国での新規発生報告ではない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため、技術的には verified_locations は空となるべきだが、台湾を中国に含める解釈として記載した。スクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」が該当し、雨季前の予防強化という季節的リスク認識が高いことから WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: WHO kêu gọi hành động lọai trừ bệnh sốt rét để bảo vệ sức khỏe cộng đồng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO calls for action to eradicate malaria to protect public health.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization calls for action to eradicate malaria on World Malaria Day 2026, themed 'No more malaria: We are determined, we can.' Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites and transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes; common symptoms are fever, chills, and sweating. Since 2000, about 2.3 billion malaria cases have been averted and 14 million deaths prevented. Forty-seven countries/territories have achieved malaria-free status; two more eliminated in 2024 and three in 2025. From 2000 to 2024, malaria-endemic countries declined from 108 to 80. Globally, 2024 estimates show 282 million cases and 610,000 deaths, a slight increase year-on-year. A photo caption notes malaria testing in Dak O Commune, Dong Nai Province, Vietnam. Prevention emphasizes environmental management (clearing vegetation, draining water, removing mosquito breeding sites), bed nets, long-sleeved clothing, and insect repellents. Suspected cases should seek prompt medical care for diagnosis and treatment to reduce complications and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、マラリア根絶に向けた行動を呼びかけ、公衆衛生を守る
triage.triage_reason: WHOによるマラリア根絶に向けた一般的な啓発メッセージであり、特定の新規アウトブレイク、異常な事象、または緊急対応を示す具体的なシグナルではない。ベトナムでのマラリア検査言及は地域的な予防活動の例示に過ぎず、新規感染症危機を示す指標ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はWorld Malaria Day 2026に関連したWHOの公開メッセージであり、既知のマラリア流行国での一般的な予防啓発である。新規アウトブレイク、異常な感染者数増加、死亡率の上昇などの具体的なシグナルは含まれていない。マラリアは既知の風土病であり、記事は根絶に向けた継続的な努力の進捗を述べているに過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: Campak di Bandung Barat Meningkat, Dinkes KBB Catat 117 Kasus Positif di 15 Kecamatan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles in West Bandung on the Rise, West Bandung Regency Health Office Records 117 Positive Cases in 15 Districts.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in West Bandung Regency, West Java, with 483 suspected cases and 117 laboratory-confirmed positives across 15 districts as of 22 April 2026. Padalarang district records 22 cases, followed by Ngamprah with 20. Dinas Kesehatan Bandung Barat has implemented vitamin A distribution, catch-up immunization, case tracing, and public education; the government provides free Measles, Mumps, Rubella (MMR) vaccine, usually given at 9–12 months with booster, and available to adults lacking complete immunization. High-risk groups include unvaccinated children, infants under one year, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals; transmission is highly efficient via droplets, airborne spread in enclosed spaces, and contact with contaminated surfaces, especially in crowded settings or with travel to high-incidence areas. Residents are urged to seek care for fever, cough, red eyes, and rash; vaccination and hygiene measures are key to halting spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウェストバンドン地域で麻疹が増加、バンドン西部保健局が15地区で117の陽性症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: 麻疹の多数の確認症例（117件）と広範な地域的広がり（15地区）、高い感染性と脆弱な人口集団（未接種児童、1歳未満の乳児）が存在することから、IHR基準（異常性・重症度・拡大リスク）を複数満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（流行しやすさ・長期曝露・公衆衛生への影響）に該当する。
triage.notes: インドネシア・ウェストバンドン地区での麻疹流行。483疑い例、117確認例（2026年4月22日時点）。パダラランとンガムラで特に高い症例数。高リスク人口（未接種児童、妊婦、免疫不全者）が存在。政府は無料MMRワクチンと予防措置を実施中。麻疹は飛沫・空気感染で極めて高い感染性を持つため、引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế cảnh báo bệnh sốt đất , 732 ca nhiễm và 23 trường hợp tử vong tại Thái Lan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns about melioidosis (soil fever), 732 cases and 23 deaths in Thailand.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (Whitmore), caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is highlighted in Thailand with 732 cases and 23 deaths as of 2026-04-22. The bacterium resides in soil, mud and contaminated surface water; infection occurs via skin contact with contaminated material, inhalation of dust or droplets, or ingestion of contaminated water or food. Clinically diverse and easily mistaken for other illnesses, Whitmore can present as pneumonia, organ abscesses, septicemia and septic shock, with fatal outcomes if untreated. High-risk groups include diabetes, liver or kidney disease, chronic lung disease, immunodeficiency, and those regularly exposed to soil or dirty water; transmission is environmental, not primarily human-to-human. Endemic to Southeast Asia and northern Australia; Thailand faces elevated risk after heavy rains, floods and storms. Preventive actions: wear protective footwear, cover wounds, practice hand hygiene, use safe water and food, and seek prompt medical care for fever, chest pain, shortness of breath, or abscesses after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がメリオイドーシス(土壌熱)について警告 - タイで732例と23死亡例
triage.triage_reason: タイでメリオイドーシスの732例・23死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準「異常性」「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、地域における重大な感染症シグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはタイでのメリオイドーシス発生を主題としており、オーストラリアは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、本記事の実質的な主題ではないため除外。タイは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。732例・23死亡例という具体的な数字、患者グループの明示、雨季・洪水後の発生増加という季節的パターン、予防措置の提示など、公開衛生サーベイランスの文脈が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh tay chân miệng tiếp tục diễn biến phức tạp, cảnh giác biến chứng nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot, and mouth disease continues to have a complicated course; watch out for severe complications.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 April 2026, Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) in Vietnam is rising compared with the same period last year, affecting primarily children under 5 and raising risk of neurological and cardiovascular complications. At 108 Military Central Hospital, pediatric HFMD cases—especially those involving Enterovirus 71 (EV71)—pose threats of meningitis, myocarditis, and acute pulmonary edema, with Coxsackievirus A16 also implicated. A 12‑month‑old presented with 39.3°C fever, cough, vomiting, and vesicles on the hands and feet, diagnosed as HFMD stage 2A with potential circulatory deterioration. Management included continuous vitals monitoring, isolation in a dedicated infectious-disease ward, and supportive care; the patient's condition stabilized. HFMD incubation is 3–7 days, onset 1–2 days, and convalescence 3–10 days, featuring mouth ulcers and extremity vesicles. Preventive guidance emphasizes handwashing, daily bathing, saline mouth rinses, and prompt medical review for persistent high fever, vomiting, or signs of neurologic/respiratory compromise, given EV71 can progress rapidly.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病が複雑な経過をたどり続けており、重症合併症に警戒が必要
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71を含む手足口病がベトナムで前年同期比で増加しており、神経学的・心血管合併症のリスク（髄膜炎、心筋炎、急性肺水腫）が確認されている。異常・予想外であり重症度が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの医療施設における小児HFMD症例の臨床的特徴と合併症リスクに焦点を当てている。EV71による神経学的合併症（髄膜炎）と心血管合併症（心筋炎、急性肺水腫）の発生が明記されており、進行が急速である旨が強調されている。前年同期比での増加傾向が報告されているため、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Amoebic fever alert: Health Department cautions against using contaminated water bodies
article.articleSummary: Primary amoebic meningoencephalitis (PAM) caused by Naegleria fowleri is highlighted in Kerala, India, with a public warning not to bathe, swim, or even wash the face in unclean or stagnant water bodies, including ponds and rock crevices, as children frequent them during summer. The Health Department notes Kerala has repeatedly experienced PAM cases across ages. Early PAM symptoms include fever, headache, nausea/vomiting, neck/back pain, with potential progression to loss of consciousness, seizures, and disoriented speech; seek specialist care promptly if fever persists or symptoms arise after water exposure. Pool hygiene mandates include draining and refilling weekly, scrubbing walls/floor, regular filter cleaning, and proper chlorination (5 g bleaching powder per 1,000 L). Preventive measures also advise nose clips, proper chlorination of water in theme parks, drinking-water storage, tankers, and maintaining 0.5 mg/L chlorine in distribution networks; avoid polluted, non-chlorinated waters.

triage.headline_ja: アメーバ熱警告：保健局が汚染された水域の使用に対し注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーラ州で原発性アメーバ性髄膜脳炎（PAM）が繰り返し発生している異常事象であり、重症度が高く（意識喪失、痙攣、死亡の可能性）、公開警告が発令されている。IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・重症度）該当、かつWPRO基準複数該当のため。
triage.notes: 原発性アメーバ性髄膜脳炎（PAM）はNaegleria fowleriによる水関連感染症で、致死率が非常に高い（90%以上）。ケーラ州では繰り返し発生しており、公式な公開警告が発令されている点が重要。夏季に子どもが頻繁に汚れた水域を使用するという季節的リスク要因もある。

article.articleHeadline: A Korean Skincare Breakthrough Could Help Fight Drug-Resistant Bacteria, Says New Study
article.articleSummary: Madecassic acid, a primary compound in Centella asiatica (Cica), can stop the growth of antibiotic-resistant bacteria, including virulent Escherichia coli, by targeting a bacterial protein that does not exist in humans. The study, published in Frontiers in Medicine, suggests a sniper-like mechanism offering potential for treatments that reduce side effects compared with conventional antibiotics. In skincare contexts, madecassic acid is used at low concentrations to soothe inflammation; translating this into a systemic medicine requires isolating the pure compound and extensive clinical testing. The finding does not imply that face creams treat infections. While promising, years of trials are needed before any prescription drug; the work contributes to the global antimicrobial resistance (AMR) crisis discussion. The article also notes Korea’s skincare prominence and rising Indian interest in Cica products.

triage.headline_ja: 韓国スキンケアの革新が薬剤耐性菌との戦いに役立つ可能性、新しい研究が示唆
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究の成果報告であり、既存の流行疾患のアウトブレイクやイベントではない。臨床応用には数年の試験が必要で、即時の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の流行やアウトブレイクイベントではなく、薬剤耐性菌に対する潜在的な治療成分に関する基礎研究報告である。Bluedot APIが韓国とインドを発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーには具体的な感染症イベント（患者集積、死亡、地理的拡大）が記載されていない。記事は研究成果の発表であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Stomach illness spike in Silchar's Salganga contained; 83 cases reported
article.articleSummary: Stomach illness in Silchar’s Salganga locality, Udharbond, Cachar district, Assam, recorded 83 confirmed cases by April 21, 2026, with a peak on April 18–19. Symptoms include diarrhoea, vomiting, and abdominal pain; no deaths or hospitalizations reported, about 16 patients required OPD care and recovered. Health authorities deployed medical teams, conducted door-to-door surveillance, distributed medicines, and urged hygiene and safe drinking water. Water samples showed no chemical contamination; microbial testing is underway. Officials say the situation has stabilised, with no new cases in the past two days as of April 22. Investigations consider a possible food-borne source linked to local festivities; infection source awaiting microbial analysis results. IDSP surveillance added ~37–38 additional cases to the initial count, bringing total to 83.

triage.headline_ja: シルチャール市サルガンガ地区の胃腸炎集団発生が沈静化；83例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: 胃腸炎の集団発生で複数の軽微なWPRO基準に該当するが、死亡・入院がなく情報が不足しており、記事発表時点で既に沈静化との報告があるため。
triage.notes: インドのアッサム州シルチャール市で胃腸炎（Unknown Illnessに分類）の局所的な集団発生。死亡なし、入院なし。記事発表時点（4月22日）で既に沈静化と報告されており、原因はまだ不明（食中毒の可能性を調査中）。国際的な広がりやリスク上昇の兆候は見られない。微生物検査結果の続報を待つため、WATCH段階での経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: 孕妇因吃剩菜不幸去世 警惕冰箱杀手李斯特菌
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pregnant woman dies after eating leftovers; beware the refrigerator killer Listeria monocytogenes.
article.articleSummary: 2026-04-22: a 35-year-old pregnant woman died shortly after turning 35, after three months of intensive treatment, from leftovers contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes. Listeria monocytogenes, the 'fridge killer,' can grow at about 4°C, so food may be contaminated even when not spoiled. Summer to autumn have higher incidence, with a 6–9 month peak. In adults infection is often mild, but pregnant women and infants are at high risk due to placental transmission, causing fetal growth arrest, preterm birth, or miscarriage; reduced fetal movement warrants urgent care. Listeria is widespread in soil, animals, wastewater and is not detectable by taste or smell. Common contaminated foods include unpasteurized milk, salads, unwashed produce, ready-to-eat deli meats, pre-cut fruit, vacuum-sealed sausages, smoked meats, and machine-churned ice cream. To prevent: heat foods to 70°C for 2–3 minutes; reheat leftovers; fridge ≤4°C; separate raw/cooked foods; avoid overcrowding; check door seals. The fridge is not a safe vault.

triage.headline_ja: 妊婦が残り物を食べて不幸にも死亡 冷蔵庫の殺し屋リステリア菌に警戒
triage.triage_reason: 単一の死亡事例（リステリア感染による妊婦死亡）の報告であり、IHR基準2以上の該当は不明確。ただし公衆衛生教育記事としての社会的関心が存在し、今後の集団発生情報の続報に留意する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は単一の致死症例（35歳妊婦）の報告を軸に、リステリア菌の一般的な公衆衛生教育を行っている。集団発生の兆候（複数症例の報告）は記事に含まれていない。リステリア症は食品由来の予防可能な疾患であり、妊婦・新生児への高リスク性が強調されている。今後、同じ食品製造元からの複数症例報告や医療機関からのクラスター報告があれば、即座にピックアップ対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Sudinkes Jaktim ingatkan risiko diare dari konsumsi ikan sapu-sapu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Jakarta Health Office warns of diarrhea risk from consuming sapu-sapu fish.
article.articleSummary: East Jakarta (Jakarta Timur) health authorities warn of diarrhea risk from consuming sapu-sapu fish living in polluted waters. Sudinkes Jakarta Timur head Herwin Meifendy states diarrhea is the earliest sign, as sapu-sapu can carry dangerous bacteria like E. coli from contaminated environments, including human and animal waste. Fish from rivers or canals with high pollution levels pose greater contamination risk. When eaten without proper cooking, these bacteria can enter the body and cause illness. Symptoms include diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, and abdominal pain; in some cases, condition can worsen if not treated, especially for children and other vulnerable groups. Short-term health issues such as respiratory problems may also occur, though diarrhea remains the most common and rapid sign. Authorities urge caution in sourcing seafood from unclean waters and recommend food hygiene and cooking until fully done.

triage.headline_ja: 東ジャカルタ保健局がサプ・サプ魚の摂取によるジアリア（下痢）リスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: E. coli感染症の警告は公衆衛生上の懸念があるが、記事は予防啓発が主体で具体的な患者発生事例は記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は東ジャカルタ保健局による予防啓発が主体であり、実際の患者集団発生（アウトブレイク）の報告は含まれていない。汚染された水域での継続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）と低衛生環境でのヒト-ヒト感染の可能性（epidemic_prone）があり、WPRO基準2つに該当。ただし具体的な患者数、死亡、または異常な増加パターンが記載されていないため、PICKUP判定には至らず、継続した情報収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada! 117 Kasus Campak Positif Ditemukan di Bandung Barat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert! 117 Positive Measles Cases Detected in West Bandung.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in West Bandung Regency, West Java, Indonesia. Of 483 suspected cases, 117 are confirmed positive. The spread spans 15 districts, with Padalarang reporting 22 cases and Ngamprah 20. Health authorities report ongoing case reports from hospitals and clinics, and the total may rise as new data arrive. Interventions include vitamin A distribution, catch-up immunization campaigns, case tracing, and community education to curb transmission. Measles is highly contagious and can persist in indoor air for hours, enabling transmission without direct contact. The free Measles-Mumps-Rubella (MMR) vaccine is available, with heightened attention for infants, unvaccinated children, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. Reported on 22 April 2026; outbreak likely to continue as surveillance expands.

triage.headline_ja: 警告！西バンドン地域で麻疹の陽性症例117件が検出される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、高い社会的関心。確認症例117件の麻疹アウトブレイクは速やかなRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: 483件の疑い患者から117件の麻疹確認症例。西バンドン県の15地区に広がり、ケース数増加の継続報告あり。インドネシアは対象国であり、記事サマリーも西ジャワ州インドネシアでの発生を明確に示している。高い感染性と空気伝播能力があり、ワクチン接種キャンペーン実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế cảnh báo bệnh Whitmore: Diễn biến nặng, nguy cơ tử vong cao nếu chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns about Whitmore's disease: Severe progression, high risk of death if you are negligent.
article.articleSummary: Whitmore's disease (Melioidosis), caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is a rare but severe infection linked to environmental exposure in soil, mud, and surface water. In Vietnam, sporadic cases are reported annually, with higher incidence after heavy rains, flooding, or storms. Transmission occurs through contact of broken skin with contaminated soil or water, inhalation of contaminated dust or droplets, or ingestion of contaminated water or food; human-to-human spread is not typical. Clinically, it presents variably and is often mistaken for other illnesses, potentially progressing to pneumonia, multifocal abscesses, bacteremia, septic shock, and death if not promptly treated. High-risk groups include diabetes, liver or kidney disease, chronic lung disease, immunosuppression, and frequent exposure to contaminated environments. Preventive measures: wear protective footwear and gloves, cover wounds, avoid barefoot exposure to wet soil, maintain hand hygiene, use safe water and food, and seek care for fever, chest symptoms, or swelling after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がホイットモア病（メリオイドーシス）について警告：重症化、怠慢の場合の高い死亡リスク
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスはベトナムで散発的に報告されている重篤な感染症であり、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度）に該当するが、情報不足と社会的関心の程度が不明確であるため、続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムの保健省による警告であり、メリオイドーシスは散発的に報告される風土病である。人間から人間への感染は典型的ではなく、流行性は低い。環境との関連が強く（土壌・泥・水との接触）、気象条件（大雨・洪水・嵐）に関連して症例が増加する傾向がある。スクリーニング基準では重症度と継続的な曝露リスクで該当し、IHR基準では公衆衛生への影響で1つ該当する。ただし国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクは低い。政府機関の関心がある点は認められるが、国際的支援の必要性は明記されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒6月迎高峰！ 醫警告：成人恐成「無症狀傳播者」 全家中招 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enteroviruses to peak in June! Doctors warn: Adults could become asymptomatic carriers; the whole family could be infected.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports rising enterovirus activity with a mid-June peak expected and outpatient visits possibly exceeding 10,000. Last week enterovirus consultations topped 3,500, up about 16% from the prior week. Coxsackievirus remains the dominant circulating type, usually causing mild illness such as hand-foot-mouth disease, fever, or poor appetite, but infants and children under five are at higher risk for progression. Enterovirus 71 EV71 is the high-risk strain associated with severe neurological complications and deaths in past outbreaks. International outbreaks have occurred in Japan, Vietnam, and Malaysia, raising importation risk since adults may be asymptomatic carriers who transmit to family members. Preventive measures include strict hand hygiene, environmental cleaning, avoiding crowded places, and healthy living. An EV71 vaccine is available; physicians may vaccinate children aged 2 months to 6 years to reduce severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒6月迎高峰！ 醫警告：成人恐成「無症狀傳播者」 全家中招
triage.triage_reason: 腸病毒71(EV71)の国際的な流行リスク、台湾での患者数増加、重症化リスク（特に乳幼児での神経系合併症・死亡）、成人の無症状キャリア化による家族内伝播リスクが示唆されており、IHR基準で「異常性」「重症度」「国際的拡大リスク」「疾病管理可能性」の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではTaiwan、Japan、Malaysia、Vietnamが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはVietnamのみ。台湾は対象国外のため除外。記事は台湾のCDCレポートが主題だが、台湾は評価対象国に含まれていない。EV71は過去に重篤な神経学的合併症と死亡事例を引き起こしており、乳幼児層に対する高いリスク。成人の無症状キャリア化メカニズムが家族内伝播リスクを高める。6月の患者数ピーク予測に基づく継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh Whitmore làm 23 người tử vong tại Thái Lan, Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo gì?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Melioidosis kills 23 people in Thailand; what does the Ministry of Health advise?
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is linked to 23 deaths in Thailand, prompting Vietnam’s Ministry of Health to issue preventive guidance on 22 April 2026. The bacterium persists in soil, mud, and surface water; humans become infected via skin contact with contaminated soil or water, inhalation of contaminated dust or droplets, or consumption of contaminated water or food. Whitmore’s clinical presentation is diverse and often mimics other illnesses, but can progress to pneumonia, focal or multiple abscesses, septicemia, and septic shock if untreated; Whitmore is not typically transmitted from person to person. In Vietnam, cases occur sporadically and surge after heavy rains, floods, and tropical storms; regional high-prevalence areas include Southeast Asia and northern Australia. High-risk groups include people with diabetes, liver or kidney disease, chronic lung disease, immunodeficiency, and those with frequent exposure to soil or mud. Preventive measures include protective footwear and gloves, covering wounds, hand hygiene, safe water and food, and seeking prompt medical care when symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: メリオイドーシスがタイで23人の死亡をもたらす；保健省の勧告は何か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重篤な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）。タイで23人の死亡が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: タイでの23人の死亡は極めて深刻な公衆衛生事象。ベトナムは既にこの事象に対応して4月22日に予防的指導を発出。土壌・泥・水に存在する病原体の特性上、環境媒介のリスクが継続的に存在。雨季・洪水後に症例が急増するパターンは地域特性として重要。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand reports 23 deaths from Whitmore disease, Vietnam issues warning
article.articleSummary: Whitmore disease (melioidosis) caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is environment-driven; Thailand reports 732 infections and 23 deaths, with most cases among agricultural workers in soil and water. Vietnam issues warning after Thailand's figures, urges awareness, early symptom recognition, and prompt care. The infection arises via skin wounds, inhalation of contaminated dust or water, or ingestion; transmission human-to-human is rare. Disease often presents with fever, cough, chest pain, breathing difficulties, abscesses, or prolonged infections; severe forms include pneumonia, multiple organ abscesses, sepsis, septic shock, and death if untreated. Higher risk after heavy rains, floods, or storms. Preventive measures include avoiding contact with soil, mud, stagnating or polluted water; wearing boots and gloves; protecting and cleaning wounds; avoiding barefoot exposure; hand hygiene; safe water/food; and heightened precautions for people with diabetes, kidney, liver, lung disease, or immunosuppression. Seek medical care after exposure if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: タイがホイットモア病（メリオイドーシス）で23人の死亡を報告、ベトナムが警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: タイにおけるメリオイドーシスの732例の感染と23人の死亡報告は、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」と「異常性」を満たし、WPRO基準の「重症度」「地域的曝露」「流行しやすさ」にも該当。隣国ベトナムからの公式警告発出により、地域的な懸念が顕在化している。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスは土壌・水由来の環境感染症であり、大雨や洪水後の発生リスク増加が指摘されている。タイでの732例、23死亡は同国における重要な感染症事象。ベトナムが公式警告を発出した点は地域的な脅威認識を示唆している。農業従事者が主な患者であることから職業的曝露リスクが高い。ヒト-ヒト感染は稀とされているが、複数国での同時報告により監視強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ba người chết vì bệnh dại, TP HCM cảnh báo dịch mùa nóng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three people die of rabies, Ho Chi Minh City warns of a rabies outbreak during the hot season.
article.articleSummary: Three people died of rabies in Ho Chi Minh City in the first four months of 2026, with deaths already exceeding half of last year’s total (5). On April 17, a dog suspected of rabies in Phước Thắng Ward attacked three people; all received prompt wound care and post-exposure vaccination, and remain in stable condition. Officials warn that hot-season heat fosters rabies transmission, calling this a peak period. The city CDC, in coordination with the Department of Livestock and Veterinary, is monitoring epidemiology, conducting public education, and containing outbreaks to prevent animal-to-human spread. Pet owners are urged to follow the “Five Noes”: no unvaccinated pets, no unregistered pets, no free-roaming dogs, no dog bites, and no environmental contamination by pets. In bites or scratches, immediate wound care and medical evaluation with vaccination and rabies immunoglobulin are advised; high-risk groups should consider pre-exposure vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 3人がイヌ咬傷病で死亡、ホーチミン市が熱季の流行に警告
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡事例（3人）が確認されており重症度基準を満たすが、現在のところ患者数は限定的で国際的拡大リスクは低い。情報収集と経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年1月～4月に3人の死亡が確認され、前年同期（5人）のペースを上回っている。ホーチミン市当局は動物咬傷後の感染予防対策を強化中。狂犬病は一度症状が出現すると致死率ほぼ100%だが、暴露後予防（PEP）で予防可能。地域内の動物管理体制の強化と公衆教育が進行中であり、現在のところ国際的な懸念は低い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Rising Flu Concerns in Brazil: Low Vaccination in High-Risk Groups, Surge in Cases and Early H3N2 Mutation Drive Public Health Alerts - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Passo Fundo, Brazil reports only 22% vaccination uptake among high‑risk groups and 10% among children, fueling concern as influenza activity rises nationwide. Early H3N2 activity includes detection of the H3N2 subclade K variant in several states, underscoring the need for annual vaccine updates due to viral mutations. PAHO urged the Americas to strengthen vaccination campaigns, surveillance, and health‑service preparedness for the 2025-2026 influenza season in the Northern Hemisphere amid a global rise in cases. Brazil's Ministry of Health states that influenza vaccination protects against H3N2 and reduces hospitalization risk, prioritizing children, the elderly, pregnant women, and health professionals through SUS. Officials caution against sensational terms like 'supergripe,' emphasizing accurate messaging. Baixada Santista reports early outbreaks; vaccination, hygiene, and early prevention remain essential to reducing infections and severe outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルにおける流感懸念の上昇：高リスク層での低いワクチン接種率、症例急増、早期H3N2変異株がもたらす公衆衛生上の警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでH3N2インフルエンザの活動が全国で増加しており、高リスク群の低いワクチン接種率（22%）とK系統の新規変異株の検出が報告されている。IHR基準3つ（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）およびWPRO基準4つ（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）が該当し、PAHOも米大陸での対応強化を呼びかけている。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（パッソ・フンド、バイシャーダ・サンティスタなど複数州）でのH3N2インフルエンザ活動の増加を主題としており、スペイン（カナリア諸島）はBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではブラジルの状況が焦点であり、スペインは検証ロケーションから除外。PAHOの国際的な警告と高リスク群での低ワクチン接種率が重要なリスク因子。

article.articleHeadline: 国家疾控局：4月以来流感病毒和鼻病毒活动水平呈上升趋势
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: National CDC: Since April, activity levels of influenza viruses and rhinoviruses have been on the rise.
article.articleSummary: Since April 2026, influenza viruses and rhinoviruses activity has risen in China, according to a National CDC briefing on recent infectious disease trends and health risk tips. Respiratory infections fluctuate with increasing activity in these pathogens. As the May Day holiday approaches, greater travel and gatherings are expected, heightening transmission risk. Authorities highlight heightened attention to dengue fever and chikungunya (mosquito-borne illnesses) and to norovirus infections and hand-foot-and-mouth disease (enteric infections). The briefing provides risk awareness but does not present specific case counts, laboratory confirmations, or formal outbreak reports. The overall message emphasizes continued vigilance for respiratory pathogens and preparedness during periods of elevated human mobility.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾控局：4月以来流感病毒と鼻病毒の活動レベルが上昇傾向を示している
triage.triage_reason: 中国における複数の呼吸器・腸管系病原体の活動増加が報告されているが、具体的な患者数、検査確認例、正式な流行宣言がなく、情報が限定的。続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は国家疾控局の公式ブリーフィングに基づくものであり、複数病原体（インフルエンザ、ノロウイルス、手足口病、デング熱、チクングニア）の活動増加を報告。ただし具体的な症例数、重症度、確認例の詳細がなく、警戒勧告の性質が強い。ゴールデンウィーク時期の人口移動増加に伴う感染拡大リスクが言及されている。情報が部分的であるため、疫学的詳細を含む続報の入手を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Virus marino: fa il salto di specie e può provocare cecità
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marine virus: crosses the species barrier and can cause blindness.
article.articleSummary: Covert Mortality Nodavirus (CMNV), previously a marine pathogen causing high mortality in fish and crustaceans (up to 80-90% in shrimp), has spilled over to humans, linked to a new ocular disease: Persistent Ocular Hypertensive Viral Anterior Uveitis (POH-VAU). In Nature Microbiology, researchers identified CMNV in human ocular tissues and documented seroconversion in 70 POH-VAU patients, with exposure frequency, number of heavy exposures, and exposure severity correlating with POH-VAU risk. CMNV is now detected in 49 aquatic species—crustaceans, fish, mollusks—across Asia, Africa, Europe, Antarctica, and the Americas, indicating broad zoonotic potential beyond China. Transmission likely occurs via small skin abrasions during handling of seafood or consumption of raw or undercooked products, triggering intense ocular inflammation and elevated intraocular pressure that can damage the optic nerve and cause permanent blindness if untreated. Lin-Fa Wang of Duke-NUS led the study; a related One Health commentary stresses integrated surveillance and seafood hygiene. The article is published on 2026-04-22.

triage.headline_ja: 海洋ウイルス：種間超越し失明を引き起こす可能性
triage.triage_reason: 新規の人獣共通感染症スピルオーバーイベント（海洋病原体から人への感染確認）で、新規眼疾患POH-VAUが記載され、すでに70例の血清転換患者が確認されている。複数大陸（アジア、アフリカ、ヨーロッパ）での検出により国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは「中国を超えた広範な人獣共通感染可能性」と述べられ、複数大陸での検出が確認されているが、具体的な感染イベントの主体的発生国は中国（Duke-NUS研究チームが研究）と判断。アンタルクティカ、スペイン等は検出地域として含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。食料品ハンドリング時の小傷からの経皮感染が主要な伝播経路とされ、失明リスク有。生食もしくは加熱不十分な海産物摂取との関連が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh cảnh báo gia tăng bệnh dại trong thời tiết nắng nóng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City warns of rising rabies cases in hot weather.
article.articleSummary: Rabies deaths in Ho Chi Minh City rise in 2026, with 3 fatalities recorded from January to April, accounting for over half of the total 5 deaths in 2025. A dog bite incident in Phuoc Thang Ward involved an unvaccinated female dog with newborn pups that became aggressive between April 13–17, biting four other dogs and three neighbors; the dog died on April 17. The three bite victims received wound care and timely rabies vaccination; their conditions are stable. At the City Hospital of Tropical Diseases, 8 rabies cases have been admitted in 2026, all following animal bites and all resulting in death. Nearly 9,000 rabies vaccine injections were administered in Q1 2026, predominantly due to dog bites (over 5,800). Authorities link hot weather to transmission, strengthen inter-agency surveillance and education, and advise immediate wound care, vaccination, and immunoglobulin when exposed. The “5 no’s” guide dog/cat ownership to curb spread; vaccination advised for high-risk groups and travelers to endemic areas.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市が猛暑時期における狂犬病患者増加に警告
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の既知の地域流行であり、IHR基準は2つ未満。ただしWPRO基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、社会的関心と政府対応（サーベイランス強化）が確認されるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病はベトナムの既知の地域風土病であり、予想外ではない。死亡率100%（8例全員死亡）と重症度は高いが、2026年の3死亡は2025年全体の5死亡に対する増加を示しており、通常の流行パターン内と考えられる。ホーチミン市当局の警告と積極的なサーベイランス強化・ワクチン接種キャンペーンが報告されている。国際的拡大やIHR通知要件は現時点で見当たらない。

article.articleHeadline:
15:11
                  国家疾控局：4月以来流感病毒和鼻病毒活动水平呈上升趋势
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 15:11 National Center for Disease Control and Prevention: Since April, activity levels of influenza viruses and rhinoviruses have shown an upward trend.
article.articleSummary: Since April, influenza viruses and rhinoviruses have shown rising activity in China, according to a press briefing by the National Center for Disease Control and Prevention. With the May Day holiday near, increased travel and gatherings heighten vigilance for mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue fever and chikungunya, and enteric infections like norovirus and hand-foot-and-mouth disease. Public health officials note variable spring–summer weather and advise adjusting clothing, checking destination outbreak information, and maintaining safe food and drinking water hygiene. Outdoors, practice mosquito and tick precautions; avoid close contact with marmots encountered in the wild. Emphasize health monitoring, especially for the elderly and young children, and seek medical care promptly if unwell. No specific local outbreak figures are provided, but respiratory-virus activity is trending upward.

triage.headline_ja: 国家疾病管理局：4月以降、インフルエンザウイルスとライノウイルスの活動水準が上昇傾向を示している
triage.triage_reason: 中国での複数呼吸器ウイルス（インフルエンザ、ライノウイルス）および蚊媒介・経口感染症の活動水準が上昇傾向を示しており、スクリーニング基準で「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」が該当するが、具体的な症例数・死亡情報の記載がなく、国境外への拡大リスクについても明確でないため。
triage.notes: 記事は中国国家疾病管理局の公式発表に基づく。複数の病原体（インフルエンザ、ライノウイルス、デング熱、チクングニア熱、ノロウイルス、手足口病、エンテロウイルス71）が列挙されているが、具体的な患者数、重症度、死亡例に関する数値情報が記載されていない。5月連休に向けた旅行・集会増加への警戒喚起であり、政府機関の関心は高い。国際的拡大リスクについては明記されていないため、IHR基準の「国際的拡大」は「不明」と評価。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Todesfällen und 35 Infizierte: Unbekanntes Virus grassiert - Mediziner besorgt über Lage in Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five fatalities and 35 infected: Unknown virus is sweeping through Africa — doctors concerned about the situation.
