article.articleSummary: Unknown virus in Burundi has caused five deaths and at least 35 infections in the northern Mpanda district near the border with the Democratic Republic of Congo. The causative agent remains unidentified. Laboratory tests for Ebola, Rift Valley Fever, Yellow Fever, and Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever all returned negative results. On March 31, 2026, Health Minister Dr. Lydwine Badarahana warned close contacts of affected individuals. In severe cases, jaundice and anemia have been observed, and several patients required hospitalization. A specialized team from Burundi’s National Emergency Centre for Public Health and the state reference laboratory has been deployed; WHO is supporting field operations, including disease surveillance, on-site investigations, medical care, laboratory diagnostics, and infection prevention and control. All reported cases remain confined to this region; no exported infections have been identified. Investigations to determine the source continue.

triage.headline_ja: 5人の死亡と35人の感染者：未知のウイルスがアフリカで蔓延 — 医師が状況を懸念
triage.triage_reason: 未知の出血熱様疾患による死亡例と複数感染例が報告され、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高い。WHOも支援を開始し、国際的な懸念が生じている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではブルンジでの発生が主題だが、対象国リストにブルンジは含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCは国境近くであり、記事で明示的に言及されている。既知の致死的出血熱（エボラ、RVF、黄熱、CCHF）は検査で除外されており、未知の病原体による発生である点が極めて懸念される。WHOの支援体制から国際的関心も明確。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh "sốt đất" khiến 23 người ở Thái Lan tử vong: Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The 'soil fever' disease kills 23 people in Thailand: Ministry of Health warns.
article.articleSummary: Whitmore disease (melioidosis) in Thailand has caused 23 deaths among 732 cases reported up to 16 April 2026. Northeast Thailand is hardest hit, with Khon Kaen Region 7 reporting 68 cases and 2 deaths, and Region 9 recording 129 cases and 8 deaths. Burkholderia pseudomallei survives in soil, mud, and contaminated surface water; humans acquire infection through skin wounds, inhalation, or ingestion of contaminated water or food, especially after heavy rain and floods. The illness is clinically diverse, often mimicking other diseases; pneumonia, organ abscesses, septicemia, and septic shock can occur, with high mortality if untreated. At-risk groups include diabetes, liver or kidney disease, chronic lung disease, immunodeficiency, and frequent soil/water exposure. Transmission is environmental, not typically person-to-person. Public Health guidance: protective footwear/gloves, wound care, hand hygiene, safe water and food, and prompt medical evaluation if fever or respiratory or skin symptoms after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: タイの「土壌熱病」で23人が死亡：保健省が警告
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスによる23人の死亡（732例中）は深刻な公衆衛生影響を示し、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。環境媒介感染で長期曝露リスクがあり、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスは環境媒介感染であり、洪水・豪雨後の流行が報告されている。タイ北東部（コンケン地域）で集中的に発生。糖尿病や免疫不全などの基礎疾患を持つ患者が高リスク。治療を受けない場合の死亡率が高い。人-人感染ではないが環境汚染による継続的曝露リスクが高く、長期的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор создаст в Республике Конго центр изучения и борьбы с инфекциями
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor will establish in the Republic of the Congo a center for the study and control of infectious diseases.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-22, the Republic of the Congo and Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor signed a Memorandum of Intent in Brazzaville to establish the Russian-Congolese Center for Epidemiology and Infectious Disease Prevention, aiming to secure Congo’s biosafety sovereignty through enhanced surveillance, study, and control of infectious diseases. Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, also visited the Congolese Ministry of Health laboratory in Brazzaville to review capabilities. The agreement builds on a 2023 framework for sanitary-epidemiological cooperation, and follows Russia’s August 2025 assistance in curbing a cholera outbreak at Congo’s request. Support included an anti-epidemic laboratory based on a Kamaz platform delivered to Brazzaville in February 2025, and Russian diagnostic tools capable of identifying pathogens of several dangerous infections within 60 minutes.

triage.headline_ja: ロスポトレブナゾル、コンゴ共和国に感染症研究・対策センターを設立
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ共和国でのコレラ流行への対応と国際的な協力体制の構築に関する記事だが、現在の流行の重症度・規模・進展状況に関する具体的情報が不足しており、シグナルとして確定するには続報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコレラに言及しているが、主要内容はロシアとコンゴ共和国間の協力枠組み（2025年8月の過去の流行対応と、今後の公式な研究・対策センター設立に関するMoI署名）に関するもの。現在進行中の流行の具体的な患者数、死亡数、地理的拡大、制御状況などが記載されていない。DRCがBluedot APIで検出されているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ共和国（Republic of the Congo）でのロシア-コンゴ協力であり、DRCでの実際の流行の有無は記事から判然としない。ロシアのRospotrebnadzorが署名者として挙げられており、地政学的文脈の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 中国4月以来流感病毒活动水平呈上升趋势
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza activity in China has been on the rise since April.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in China has risen since April, driven by influenza viruses and rhinoviruses nationwide. At a China Center for Disease Control and Prevention (China CDC) press briefing, spokesperson Xi Jingjing said respiratory infectious disease activity fluctuated this April, with rising trends as the May Day holiday approaches and travel/gatherings increase. The briefing urged vigilance for dengue fever and chikungunya (mosquito-borne diseases), as well as norovirus infections and hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD) to prevent enteric illness surges. The discussion summarized recent epidemic dynamics and health risk tips, emphasizing ongoing surveillance and preventive measures. The last influenza peak occurred last winter, and Beijing has entered a high-incidence period for respiratory diseases, underscoring public health preparedness during holiday travel.

triage.headline_ja: 中国4月以来流感病毒活动水平呈上升趋势
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器感染症の同時活動上昇が報告されており、WPRO基準では異常性と流行リスクが認められるが、IHR基準の達成は不明確。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国における複数呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザ、ライノウイルス、ノロウイルス、手足口病）と蚊媒介疾患（デング熱、チクングニア）の同時活動上昇を報告。中国CDCからの公式警告であり政府関心は高い。ただし具体的な患者数、死亡者数、入院数が記載されておらず重症度の評価が困難。五一連休による移動増加に伴う拡大リスクが指摘されている。北京市の呼吸器疾患高発生期への言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: กรมวิทยาศาสตร์การแพทย์ เตือนช่วงหน้าฝนมีความเสี่ยงติดเชื้อไข้ดินได้ง่าย ยันมีความพร้อมตรวจหาเชื้อก่อโรคแบบครบวงจร
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Department of Medical Sciences Warns of a Heightened Risk of Melioidosis During the Rainy Season and Reaffirms Its Readiness for Comprehensive Pathogen Detection.
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis risk in Thailand rises during the rainy season as Burkholderia pseudomallei persists in soil and water nationwide. The Department of Medical Sciences reports comprehensive diagnostic capacity: rapid serology, culture, real-time PCR, genome sequencing, and antimicrobial susceptibility testing, with clinical assessment guiding treatment. In FY 2568, the Public Health Science Research Institute processed 177 suspected samples, 38 confirmed infections (21.5%); among 110 male samples, 23 positives (20.9%), and 67 female samples, 15 positives (23.4%). Over FY 2564–2567, total submissions reached 542 with 40 confirmed infections (7.4%), indicating rising incidence. Real-time PCR can be performed directly on blood, serum/plasma, and hemoculture specimens, speeding confirmation. Genome analysis is offered at no cost for confirmation and precise strain typing, with drug-resistance surveillance. At-risk individuals with persistent fever and soil/water exposure should seek prompt medical care; hospitals can contact the Lab Analysis and Surveillance Coordination Center at 0-2951-0000 ext 98340/99614 or regional centers.

triage.headline_ja: 医科学部門がモンスーン期のメリオイドーシス感染リスク増加を警告、包括的な病原体検査体制を確認
triage.triage_reason: タイで既知の風土病であるメリオイドーシスが雨季に増加するという季節的なリスク警告。診断能力や症例数の増加傾向は報告されているが、国際的拡大の直接的な証拠や急性の深刻な危機を示す情報は現時点では不明。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスはタイの風土病であり、雨季の増加は予見可能な季節的現象。記事は公衆衛生当局による予防警告と診断体制の強化を報告している。FY2568で38例確認（前年比増加傾向）、長期的な土壌・水への曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染は限定的。国内対応体制は整備されており国際支援の必要性は記載されていない。続報で症例増加傾向や新規クラスターの発生動向を注視する価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: 5 lưu ý về bệnh tay chân miệng do virus EV71
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five things to know about hand, foot, and mouth disease caused by the EV71 virus
article.articleSummary: EV71-driven hand, foot, and mouth disease in Vietnam: Since January 2026, about 26,000 HFMD cases and 8 deaths have been reported; March saw higher weekly incidence than February. EV71 strains (B3, B4, B5, C1, C4, C5) can present with subtle or hidden skin lesions (between fingers, buttocks, genitals), making early recognition challenging. Most children recover in 7–10 days, but EV71 can rapidly progress to encephalitis, meningitis, autonomic dysfunction, and cardiovascular/respiratory failure, with death possible within 24 hours if untreated. Encephalitis is the most common central nervous system complication, accounting for about 58% of CNS cases. Reinfections with different EV71 subtypes are possible, typically within 12–36 months. A persistent fever >39°C for ≥48 hours or fever unresponsive to antipyretics signals high risk and requires urgent evaluation. Prevention centers on hygiene, isolation, and not sharing items; an EV71 vaccine for children aged 2 months to under 6 years, licensed for protection against severe disease (~97%), is to be introduced and deployed by the VNVC system.

triage.headline_ja: EV71ウイルスによる手足口病に関する5つの重要なポイント
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。2026年1月以降ベトナムで26,000件の患者と8件の死亡が報告されており、EV71による重篤な神経系合併症のリスクが確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事はEV71による手足口病の大規模流行をカバーしており、複数の神経系合併症（脳炎58%、髄膜炎、自律神経障害）の報告と24時間以内の死亡可能性が記載されている。ワクチン導入計画も述べられており、ベトナム政府の対応が進行中である。全WPRO基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: Ẩn mình trong bùn đất, tấn công bất ngờ, Whitmore có thể trở nặng chỉ sau vài ngày
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hiding in mud, striking suddenly, Whitmore can worsen within just a few days.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Department of Disease Prevention, under the Ministry of Health, has issued a warning about Whitmore (melioidosis), an infectious disease caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei. The organism is commonly found in soil, mud, and contaminated surface water, posing transmission risk in environmental exposures. The advisory highlights that Whitmore can deteriorate within just a few days, underscoring the need for rapid recognition and public awareness. The report does not specify local case counts, outbreaks, or laboratory-confirmed cases, nor details on imported or exported cases. Published on 22 April 2026 at 14:48 by journalist Van Hien of Nha bao va Cong luan. Geography referenced is Vietnam, with general environmental sources of infection noted. The article emphasizes environmental reservoirs as the primary infection source.

triage.headline_ja: 泥に潜み、突然襲撃するWhitmore（メリオイドーシス）は数日で重篤化する可能性
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム保健省による公式警告であり社会的・政治的関心が高いが、具体的な患者数、アウトブレイク確認、または検査確認症例の報告がないため情報が不足している。異常性と流行可能性が認識されているため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに「症例数、アウトブレイク、または検査確認症例が報告されていない」と明記されている。これは公衆衛生当局による予防的警告（awareness campaign）であり、進行中のアウトブレイクではなく環境リスク啓発である。メリオイドーシスは実在する重篤な病原体であり、ベトナムは風土病地域であるため、今後の患者報告が急速に増加する可能性がある場合は速やかにPICKUPに昇格する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: TP Hồ Chí Minh: khuyến cáo nóng sau 3 ca tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: Urgent warning after 3 rabies-related deaths.
article.articleSummary: Three rabies-related deaths have occurred in Ho Chi Minh City from the start of 2026 up to April 20, accounting for more than half of the city’s total rabies deaths in 2025, according to the HCMC Department of Health (HCDC). A suspected rabid dog in Phuoc Thang Ward’s hamlet 6 bit three people, was unvaccinated, about five years old, and killed four of its puppies before dying on April 17; a neighbor reportedly burned its carcass. Separately, a man in Phuoc Thang Ward’s hamlet 7 reported a bite on April 12, with the dog dying on April 19. A third bite was investigated in Phuoc Thang Ward’s hamlet 3. Long Son Commune Health Station recorded three dog/cat bite events in April (April 7, 12, 19). Wounds were treated with rabies vaccination; authorities urge vaccination and adherence to the “5 no” rules, noting hot weather raises rabies risk and calling for intensified surveillance and public awareness, especially for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：狂犬病関連の3件の死亡後に緊急警告
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による複数の死亡（3件）と動物咬傷クラスターが確認され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。当局による積極的な監視と啓発活動が実施されており、IHR基準2項目以上該当かつWPRO基準3項目以上該当するシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムのホーチミン市で発生した狂犬病クラスターを報道。2026年1月～4月20日までに3件の死亡が確認され、これは2025年通年の死亡数の半数以上に相当。複数の動物咬傷イベント（Phuoc Thang Ward内複数の地区及びLong Son Commune）が関連。当局は監視強化と予防接種推進を呼びかけており、公式な対応が進行中。狂犬病は100%致命的疾患であり、死亡事例の発生と動物咬傷の継続的リスクから高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 威尔朗：计算接种比例 两周掌握狂犬病情况 - 地方 - 南砂
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Weilang: Calculate Vaccination Coverage; Two Weeks to Grasp the Rabies Situation - Local - Nansha
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination coverage assessment underway in Nansha. Weilang, a global veterinary service organization, completed the first round of household surveys last week in Deshaweila and Shijiao and will continue surveys this weekend to evaluate vaccination effectiveness. An oral rabies vaccine pilot is being conducted at the Minda Market. The surveys aim to estimate dog populations (owned and stray), calculate overall vaccine coverage, and determine the proportion of vaccinated dogs, while collecting bite incident reports to gauge local rabies risk. A two-week evaluation will sample enough households to produce representative data. More team members will join to understand public attitudes and experiences for future planning. Random visits will ensure regional representativeness; monitoring of survey progress and coverage is tracked through the Global Veterinary Service Organization app, used in multiple countries.

triage.headline_ja: ウェイラン：ワクチン接種率を計算、2週間で狂犬病の状況を把握 - 地方 - 南砂
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病ワクチン接種カバレッジの調査・評価活動であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響を示す確認症例や死亡報告がなく、IHR基準の該当数が不十分。リスク評価フェーズではなく監視・評価段階の活動報告。
triage.notes: 記事は中国広東省南砂地区での狂犬病ワクチン接種カバレッジの調査プロジェクトの実施内容を報告しており、既存の動物疫学的リスク管理活動の枠組みで進行している予防活動である。新規感染症イベント（ヒト感染例、異常な発生、流行兆候）の報告ではない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: В Украине зафиксирован первый случай коронавируса "Цикада"  --  какие у него симптомы - sud.ua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Ukraine, the first case of the "Cicada" coronavirus has been recorded — what are its symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Ukraine confirmed a case of the new Omicron subvariant BA.3.2, named 'Cicada', identified by the Center for Public Health during sequencing, illustrating the system's ability to detect new variants promptly. Globally, Cicada was first reported in late 2024 and is now recorded in about 23 countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, Hong Kong, and Mozambique. The World Health Organization is monitoring BA.3.2 but indicates no evidence of increased epidemic risk or a potential for a large new wave. Symptoms do not differ from other COVID-19 variants. Vaccination remains the best defense against severe disease and complications. Preliminary data from New York suggest children may be infected more often than adults with BA.3.2, though further analysis is needed.

triage.headline_ja: ウクライナで新型コロナウイルス「シカダ」の初症例が確認される — その症状は何か
triage.triage_reason: BA.3.2は既知のオミクロン亜系統であり、WHOは増加した流行リスクの証拠はないと明示している。ウクライナは対象監視国ではなく、既存の検査体制内での検出である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは既知亜系統BA.3.2の検出について述べており、WHOが「増加した流行リスクの証拠はない」と明記している。これは日常的なサーベイランスの一環である。対象国ではウクライナ（監視対象外）が主題だが、香港とモザンビークは記事で言及されている。ただしいずれも新規の懸念イベントを示唆していない。

article.articleHeadline: Vi khuẩn từ thịt lợn khiến người đàn ông rơi vào nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bacteria from pork meat put a man in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis (pig streptococcus) caused a rapidly progressive infection in a man admitted to the Intensive Care Unit of People’s Hospital 115, Vietnam, on 22 April 2026. Within two days of fever and fatigue, he developed septic shock, multiorgan dysfunction, and disseminated intravascular coagulation; blood cultures later confirmed Streptococcus suis as the causative agent. Exposure history showed prior purchase of raw pork and bones, with risk from handling raw meat and consuming undercooked dishes such as tiết canh. After aggressive supportive care and targeted antimicrobial therapy, he stabilized and was discharged after 21 days in the ICU. This case highlights the danger of S. suis, a zoonotic infection common in Vietnam that can cause septicemia, meningitis, and death; prevention includes avoiding undercooked pork products, wearing gloves when handling raw meat, and seeking prompt medical care after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 豚肉の細菌で男性が危機的状態に
triage.triage_reason: Streptococcus suisによる重症感染症の個別症例報告であり、重症度は高いが、現在のところ単一症例の報告に留まる。人獣共通感染症として既知の病原体であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクについては情報不足。
triage.notes: Streptococcus suisはベトナムで周知の人獣共通感染症であり、本事例は急速進行性の重症感染を示す個別症例。複数症例の流行や異常な増加パターンについては記事で述べられていない。生食文化（tiết canh）との関連性が指摘されており、地域的な食文化要因がリスク。疫学的データ（発症数、死亡率等）の欠如のため、スクリーニング基準5（管理可能性）は「No」と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Вирус от скариди засяга хората, протича тежко и има риск за зрението и кръвното
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A shrimp virus affects people, has a severe course, and poses a risk to vision and blood pressure.
article.articleSummary: China reports an increase in cases of severe, recurrent viral anterior uveitis with markedly elevated intraocular pressure, mimicking glaucoma, in patients testing negative for known human viruses. Doctors identify viral particles in ocular tissue that resemble CMNV, the crustacean hidden mortality virus, with genetic analysis showing near-perfect match to the marine pathogen previously confined to aquaculture. The disease course is heavy, with repeated high intraocular pressure episodes risking irreversible optic nerve damage and vision loss. Lifestyle analysis shows most affected individuals had direct contact with raw seafood or consumed undercooked shellfish, suggesting foodborne or handling routes. CMNV has already been detected in dozens of marine species worldwide, including Europe and the Americas. Although researchers urge caution, there is no basis for panic; further studies are needed to establish a confirmed human–CMNV link. Protective measures for handling raw seafood are advised.

triage.headline_ja: エビから由来するウイルスが人間に感染、重篤な経過で視力と血圧へのリスクあり
triage.triage_reason: 新規の人獣共通感染症（CMNV）の可能性を示唆する報告。中国で原因不明の重度の眼内炎患者から海洋病原体と一致するウイルスが同定され、国際的な水産物流通を通じた拡大リスクと公衆衛生への影響が懸念される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した『Playa de las Américas』『Canary Islands』『Kingdom of Spain』は記事サマリー上では直接的な発生地ではなく、CMNVが検出されている「ヨーロッパとアメリカ」の一般的な言及と考えられる。対象国リストに該当するのはChinaのみ。原文ブルガリア語の記事URLはスペイン関連だが、サマリーの主題はChina（中国）での症例報告であることを優先した。海産物を介した国際的な感染リスク、および原因不明だった重度眼疾患の新規病因同定という点でシグナル価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 3 ca tử vong do bệnh dại, TPHCM khuyến cáo phòng dịch mùa cao điểm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three deaths from rabies; Ho Chi Minh City urges disease prevention during the peak season.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Ho Chi Minh City: 3 deaths recorded January–April 20, 2026, more than half of the 2025 total (5). A dog suspected of rabies bit three people in Phước Thắng Ward; wounds were treated and post-exposure vaccines administered; health status remains stable. City authorities are tightening vaccination and pet-ownership rules; HCDC will work with the Department of Health and veterinary sectors to boost surveillance and outbreak response. Citizens are urged to follow the '5 no' guidelines: no unvaccinated pets, no unregistered pets, no roaming animals, no pets biting people, and no pets polluting the environment. Vaccination is advised for high-risk groups (veterinary staff, lab workers, dog-slaughter workers, residents or travelers in enzootic areas). Wounds should be washed with soap for at least 15 minutes, disinfected, and medical care sought promptly for vaccines and rabies immunoglobulin if needed; avoid folk remedies. Rabies remains 100% fatal after symptoms but preventable.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病による3人の死亡；ホーチミン市が流行期の疾病予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による3人の死亡が記録され、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行リスク）に該当する。対象国ベトナムでの実際の発生イベントであり、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: ベトナムはIHRスクリーニング基準で2基準以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡例3件＋2025年全体の5件をすでに超過；異常性：流行期のピーク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5基準全て該当（重症度：死亡100%；流行易感染性：犬咬傷によるヒト感染、未登録ペット、狂犬病予防接種不十分な環境；管理可能性：当局が能動的に対応）。ホーチミン市当局による積極的な公式警告および予防施策の強化が記録されており、社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: 4月以来，我国呼吸道传染病疫情有所波动_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Since April, the respiratory infectious disease epidemic situation in China has fluctuated.
article.articleSummary: Since April, China has seen fluctuations in respiratory infectious disease activity, with influenza viruses and rhinoviruses rising. As the May Day holiday approaches and travel surges, vigilance is urged for outbreaks of mosquito-borne dengue fever and chikungunya fever, as well as enteric infections like norovirus and hand-foot-and-mouth disease. The National Health Commission advises adapting to variable spring-summer weather, dressing accordingly, and checking destination outbreak information; maintain food and water hygiene to reduce illness risk. Outdoors, take protection against mosquitoes and ticks, and avoid close contact with marmots encountered in the wild. Emphasis on health monitoring for high-risk groups, especially the elderly and young children; seek medical care promptly if unwell. Source: Beijing Daily App.

triage.headline_ja: 4月以来、中国の呼吸道伝染病の疫学状況に変動がみられる
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（インフルエンザ、ノロウイルス、手足口病、デング熱、チクングニア熱、エンテロウイルス71）が同時に報告されており、公式保健機関（国家衛生委員会）による公開警告と予防勧告がなされている。人口移動期（5月連休）との関連性が指摘されており、異常性と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 複数の呼吸道および消化器系感染症が同時報告されており、季節的変動と大型連休による人口移動が増幅要因として指摘されている。国家衛生委員会による公式警告と具体的予防措置の呼びかけが確認されている。蚊媒介性疾患（デング熱、チクungニア熱）と肠道感染症の同時注視が求められている点が特徴的。

article.articleHeadline: Comércio de animais impulsiona propagação de doenças - 22/04/2026 - Ciência - Folha
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Animal trade drives the spread of diseases - April 22, 2026 - Science - Folha
article.articleSummary: Global wildlife trade drives zoonotic disease spread from animals to people, according to a Science study published April 9, 2026. Analyzing thousands of wild mammal species and 40 years of trade records, researchers found that species sold in international wildlife markets—live animals and products—were 50% more likely to share pathogens with humans than non-traded species. The risk rose with duration in trade: for every additional decade a species was traded (1980–2019), it shared one more human pathogen. Among mammals, 41% of traded species harbored at least one pathogen known to infect humans, versus 6% of non-traded species. The study used import/export and seizure data to identify over 2,000 species (~25% of mammals). Live markets and illegal trade amplify risks; spillover pathogens such as Ebola and mpox are noted, and COVID-19 may have first spilled over in a Wuhan live-animal market.

triage.headline_ja: 動物取引が病気の拡散を推進 - 2026年4月22日 - 科学 - フォーリャ
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物取引と人畜感染症（Ebola、mpox、COVID-19）の関連性に関する学術研究報告。武漢の生きた動物市場がCOVID-19の初期流出地点である可能性に言及しており、Chinaが該当地域。ただし、具体的な現在進行中のアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、学術的分析が主体のため、情報不足で要経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な現在発生中のアウトブレイクではなく、2026年4月9日に発表された学術研究（Science誌）の報道。武漢の生きた動物市場とCOVID-19の初期流出の関連可能性に言及しているが、確定的な報告ではない。野生動物取引の長期的なリスク構造に関する予防的懸念を扱う報道であり、シグナルとしてのフルRRA対象には未到達。

article.articleHeadline: Kalender Jawa 22 April 2026 Weton Rabu Wage, Diperingati sebagai Hari Demam Berdarah Nasional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Javanese Calendar April 22, 2026 Weton Wednesday Wage, Observed as National Dengue Fever Day
article.articleSummary: On 22 April 2026, Indonesia observes National Dengue Fever Day, complementing Earth Day globally. Dengue fever (DBD) is highlighted as a continuing public health threat, transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. In Indonesia, as of 28 October 2025, there were 131,393 dengue cases and 544 deaths, a CFR of 0.41%. The disease affected people across 471 regencies/cities in 36 provinces, with fatalities reported in 196 regions. The productive age group 15–44 years has been most affected in the past five years. The Health Ministry's Directorate General for Disease Prevention and Control tracks and reports these figures. The observance aims to raise awareness of dengue prevention and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年4月22日ジャワ暦 水曜日ウェイジ、全国デング熱の日として祝われる
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのデング熱の継続的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示す情報であるが、記事は国家啓発日の観察が主題であり、新規の疾病イベントや異常な発生を報告していない。既知の流行状況の定期的な報告と位置づけられる。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアの全国デング熱啓発日の観察報告であり、2025年10月28日時点での既知統計（131,393例、544死亡、CFR 0.41%、36州471地域における発生）を提示している。新規の異常な発生パターンではなく、既知の風土病の継続的な公衆衛生対応を示唆している。社会政治的関心は高いが、即座のフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）進行の必要性は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: 香港現今年首宗本地登革熱病例　整體傳播風險可控　　16:43
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong's first locally transmitted dengue fever case of the year; overall transmission risk is under control; 16:43.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports the year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case, with infection by a mosquito bite near the Tap Kwong Bay construction site. The Centre for Health Protection says local transmission risk is moderate and the overall risk is controllable. As of April 21, the city has 13 dengue cases this year, 12 imported and 1 local. The Tap Kwong Bay area shows natural greenery and potential breeding sites; authorities ordered work halt and intensified vector control. Aedes albopictus, capable of transmitting dengue, is present, and the dengue peak season is April–August, with continued importations from Southeast Asia and nearby regions. Citizens returning from travel should seek medical care if fever, headache, or muscle pain occurs within a 3–14 day incubation. For measles, 5 cases this year (2 imported from Indonesia, 1 local, 2 linked to an imported case); vaccination is advised for high‑risk groups and travelers to outbreak areas.

triage.headline_ja: 香港、今年初の本地感染デング熱症例を報告　全体的な感染リスクは制御可能
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の本地感染事例の報告と麻疹症例の記述がみられるが、香港保健当局が感染リスク「中等度・制御可能」と評価し、死亡・重症化の記載がなく、感染症の重篤性が明確でない。情報不足により経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは香港でのデング熱本地感染事例が主題。麻疹についても言及されており、インドネシアからの輸入事例との関連があるが、記事の主焦点は香港。IHR基準では「予想外」のみ該当（1件）。WPROスクリーニングでは「異常/予想外」「長期曝露（デング熱の流行期は4月～8月で継続的リスク）」「流行しやすさ（蚊媒介感染で東南アジアからの輸入例継続）」の3基準該当。ただし当局の「制御可能」評価と死亡・重症者の記載がないため、重症度評価が困難。続報にて患者数増加や重症化の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Pune: World Malaria Day To Be Observed On April 25; Health Department Intensifies Awareness Drive
article.articleSummary: Pune District Health Office observes World Malaria Day on April 25, 2026, under National Insect-Borne Disease Control Programme, aiming for zero malaria by 2030. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium and spreads via infected female Anopheles mosquitoes. Symptoms include chills, fever, sweating and headache; falciparum malaria can cause cerebral malaria with high fever, vomiting, seizures or unconsciousness if untreated. Free diagnosis and treatment are available at government facilities. The department has intensified surveillance across rural and urban areas, with health workers and ASHA volunteers conducting visits to identify fever cases and collect blood samples. Vector control includes insecticide spraying, larval source management and release of guppy fish. Dengue and chikungunya samples go to NIV Pune; fogging and disinfection are underway. Pregnant women with fever are screened for Zika; elephantiasis is monitored. Public awareness campaigns and preventive steps—eliminate water stagnation, keep surroundings clean, cover water storage, use nets, seek prompt care.

triage.headline_ja: プネ: 4月25日にマラリア世界デーが観察される。保健部門は認識向上キャンペーンを強化
triage.triage_reason: 記事は主にマラリア予防啓発イベント（World Malaria Day）の報道であり、アクティブな発生報告ではない。複数の蚊媒介感染症が言及されているが、具体的な症例数や異常な発生パターンに関する情報は不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はWHO/マラリア世界デー関連の啓発活動レポートとして、既存の蚊媒介感染症サーベイランス枠組みの強化を述べている。Nipah も疾患名に含まれているが、記事サマリーではニパウイルスについての言及がないため、タグ付けの誤りの可能性あり。現在のところ新規発生クラスター、異常な死亡率、国際的拡大リスクの明確な証拠がないため WATCH 判定。続報での症例数増加や異常パターン出現の監視を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Health authority warns of rising flu, disease risks ahead of May Day holiday
article.articleSummary: Influenza and rhinovirus activity in China has trended upward since early April, prompting officials to warn of rising risks ahead of the five-day May Day holiday starting May 1. Dengue fever and chikungunya fever, along with norovirus infection and hand, foot and mouth disease, are highlighted for heightened vigilance during travel and large gatherings. Xi Jingjing of the National Disease Control and Prevention Administration said the spring-to-summer weather transition varies, so people should adjust clothing, check epidemic status at travel destinations, and maintain food and water hygiene. Public health guidance includes preventing mosquito and tick bites during outdoor activities and avoiding close contact with marmots in the wild. Authorities also urge monitoring health, especially among older adults and children, and prompt medical care if symptoms develop.

triage.headline_ja: 保健当局、5月の連休を前に流感と疾病リスク上昇を警告
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器系・媒介感染症が中国で上昇傾向を示しており、IHR基準で異常性と重症度の可能性が認められるが、具体的な患者数・死亡数・国際拡大の直接的証拠が記事に記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性の呼吸器疾患（インフルエンザ・ライノウイルス）と媒介感染症（デング热・チクングニア）、消化器疾患（ノロウイルス・手足口病）の複数疾患による同時警告。5月の大型連休（人口移動増加）を背景としており、感染拡大リスクが存在する。ただし、具体的な患者数、重症度、死亡数の記載がなく、国際拡大の直接的リスク表現も不明。WPRO基準は3項目該当するが、深刻度・管理可能性に関する具体情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Onderzoekersechtpaar steelt virussen uit streng beveiligd lab
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researcher Couple Steals Viruses from a Highly Secure Lab.
article.articleSummary: Two researchers at Unicamp in Campinas, Brazil, virologist Soledad Palameta Miller and her partner Michael Miller, were implicated in theft of viral samples from a BSL-3 facility. Since February 13, routine checks flagged missing virus stocks; by March 23 Palameta Miller was caught destroying evidence. Security footage showed them visiting the lab at odd hours and carrying boxes out of the facility. Authorities say about 24 virus types, including influenza, chikungunya, Zika, herpes, COVID-19, and dengue, were compromised and later recovered from multiple campus sites—the tropical diseases lab, the cell biology lab, and a freezer 300 meters away in the Faculty of Food Technology. The couple run Agrotrix Brasil. Motive remains unclear; officials say terrorism is unlikely since materials did not leave campus. Brazil is building a new BSL-4 lab, Orion, near Unicamp, due to open in 2028 to study pathogens such as the Sabiá virus.

triage.headline_ja: 研究者夫妻が厳重に警備されたラボからウイルスを盗む
triage.triage_reason: BSL-3施設からの複数ウイルス株の盗難は異常かつ深刻な事象であるが、記事では「テロの可能性は低い、キャンパス内に留まる」と当局が述べており、直接的な公衆衛生上の即時的な脅威の実証がない。情報不足により経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: IHR基準で2つ以上該当する深刻な事象（ウイルス盗難）であるが、報道では「キャンパス内に留まり、テロの可能性は低い」と当局が述べており、現時点での直接的な流行リスクの顕在化が不明。盗まれたウイルスの行き先、実際の感染リスク、および管理可能性について情報が不足しており、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Drought Fueled Third Plague Pandemic on Tibetan Plateau
article.articleSummary: Yersinia pestis-driven plague originated on the Tibetan Plateau during a late-19th-century drought, with the Third Plague Pandemic extending into the 20th century. In a study published in Communications Earth & Environment, researchers integrate paleoclimatic data, archival records, and pathogen-evolution models to show how environmental stress and social upheaval amplified transmission along inland routes. Prolonged drought disrupted water and pasture productivity, triggering food shortages, economic strain, and population displacements that destabilized governance and increased mobility, creating conditions for epidemic spread. High-resolution genomic analyses of Yersinia pestis from historical and modern sources reveal a genetic signature linking pandemic strains to the plateau, supporting a reservoir disturbance and spillover. The pandemic began in the mid-19th century and caused tens of millions of deaths globally, with inland ecological and social dynamics highlighted as pivotal. The work connects climate extremes to zoonotic spillovers and pandemic preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 干ばつが引き起こしたチベット高原の第3次ペスト大流行
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は19世紀後半から20世紀にかけての歴史的なペスト大流行に関する学術研究報告であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。現代のアウトブレイク情報を含まない。
triage.notes: 本イベント情報は過去の歴史的パンデミック（19-20世紀）に関する学術研究であり、現在のEBS対象イベントではない。チベット高原はChina領域に含まれるが、現在進行中の感染症イベントの報告がないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Một người đàn ông bán thịt chó ở Đồng Tháp chết do mắc bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man who sells dog meat in Đồng Tháp died of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death reported in Dong Thap Province, Vietnam. The victim, Nguyen Ngoc Son, 58, a dog-meat trader, died after laboratory-confirmed rabies; no dog bite history. He was admitted on 15 April at Tien Giang General Hospital with dizziness and unilateral weakness, initially diagnosed as neurological illness and hypertension; the illness rapidly progressed with hydrophobia and dysphagia, and he was transferred on 17 April to Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases for rabies monitoring. Laboratory tests later confirmed rabies virus infection; he died on the evening of 20 April. Investigations suggest exposure via contact with blood or secretions from infected dogs during slaughter/processing. Authorities conducted epidemiological tracing, advised vaccination for close contacts, partnered with animal health to locate the source at slaughter facilities, and intensified public awareness about rabies risk in handling and processing animals.

triage.headline_ja: ドン・タップ州で犬肉を販売していた男性が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例が確認され、職業的曝露による感染の可能性が示唆されている。WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性（職業的曝露による狂犬病死亡）、重症度（致死性）、長期曝露リスク（動物処理従事者への継続的な曝露）が認められ、公衆衛生上の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の職業的曝露（犬肉処理業者）は公衆衛生上重要。記事サマリーでは咬傷歴がないとされているが、処理中の血液・分泌物への接触が推定曝露経路。当局による疫学調査と予防接種推奨が実施されている。散発的死亡であるが、動物処理業の従事者に対する継続的なリスク管理と啓発が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Báo động tình trạng trẻ hóa nhiễm HIV trong cộng đồng MSM tại TP Hồ Chí Minh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming trend of HIV infection among the MSM community in Ho Chi Minh City
article.articleSummary: Over 10,000 new HIV infections reported, with pronounced rises in southern provinces, according to Dr. Tra Anh Duy of the Men’s Health Center. In Ho Chi Minh City, men who have sex with men (MSM) bear a high HIV burden, with a clear youth trend and often asymptomatic progression that delays diagnosis. Many patients are found when treated for other sexually transmitted infections or non-specific symptoms; examples include a 19-year-old with fever and inguinal lymphadenopathy who tested HIV-positive with hepatitis B, and reports of HIV in individuals as young as 15–16. Key drivers include early sexual debut, insufficient protective practices, and rapid encounters via dating apps; social stigma also delays testing. Recommendations: proactive prevention (consistent condom use, periodic HIV testing, PrEP), routine STI screening (syphilis, gonorrhea, chlamydia) and hepatitis B/C; HPV vaccination is advised given HPV-related genital warts in 18–23-year-olds. Seek early care and avoid self-treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市のMSM(男性同性愛者)コミュニティにおけるHIV感染の若年化が懸念
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム全土で年間10,000件以上の新規HIV感染報告があり、ホーチミン市でMSMコミュニティにおける若年層のHIV感染が急増している。複数の性感染症(肝炎B、梅毒、淋病)の同時発症例が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムのホーチミン市におけるMSMコミュニティでのHIV感染の若年化傾向を報告している。年間10,000件以上の新規感染、15-16歳の若年感染者の報告、肝炎B・梅毒・淋病などの複合感染が特徴。スクリーニング基準5項目全てに該当し、IHR基準2項目以上該当のため、フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Lạng Sơn siết chặt kiểm soát, phòng dịch bệnh trên tuyến biên giới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lạng Sơn tightens border controls and epidemic prevention measures along the border.
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) SAT1 serotype poses incursion risk along Vietnam’s Lang Son border. Lang Son Province—bordering China with over 231 km of frontier—has not detected SAT1, but regional outbreaks prompt heightened vigilance and preemptive measures. At the Chi Ma border gate, Border Guard units conduct 24/7 patrols targeting illicit animal movement and animal-product trafficking, coordinating with veterinary and local authorities to prevent incursions. Veterinary quarantine at crossings enforces disinfection and strict documentation; vehicles are disinfected and consignments inspected. Lang Son’s livestock population exceeds 250,000 head (cattle, buffalo, pigs). Authorities emphasize vaccination, barn hygiene, routine disinfection, and continuous surveillance to mitigate risk. Public awareness campaigns in both standard and local languages educate residents on signs and reporting. Agencies are coordinating sampling, risk assessment, and rapid containment for suspected cases to curb cross-border transmission of SAT1.

triage.headline_ja: ラングソン省が国境沿いの感染症対策を強化し、国境管理を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫SAT1血清型による越境侵入リスクが指摘されており、異常・予想外の事象として認識されている。しかし、ベトナム国内ではまだ確認されておらず、現在のところ予防的措置と監視段階である。動物への影響が主体であり、人間への直接的な脅威は不明な点が多い。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナムのラングソン省における口蹄疫SAT1の越境侵入リスクに関するもの。Bluedot APIは中国も検出地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーでは地域的なアウトブレイクへの言及があるものの、中国での具体的なFMD発生確認は明記されていない。ベトナム国内での検出例はまだなく、現在は予防的段階である。動物健康上の脅hydration は明確だが、人間への感染症学的脅威は記事から特定不能。越境リスク管理と地域警戒の観点から情報継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ca mắc não mô cầu phía Nam tăng mạnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of meningococcal meningitis rise sharply in the South
article.articleSummary: By mid-April the Southern region of Vietnam reported 18 meningococcal meningitis cases, up 13 from the same period last year, with Ho Chi Minh City accounting for 10 cases since the start of the year and one death in a two-year-old. On 22 April, Ho Chi Minh City Hospital of Tropical Diseases and the city’s CDC held training on diagnosis, treatment, and prevention amid rising cases. Serogroup B predominates: data from Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City (2013–2026) show all tested strains are serogroup B, and military surveillance (2014–2021) reports 91.3% serogroup B. Transmission is via respiratory droplets, with asymptomatic carriage in 5–25% of healthy people, higher among youths. Outbreak risk is higher in crowded settings such as schools, dormitories, prisons, and military camps. Incubation is 2–10 days; infectious before symptoms and up to 24 hours after antibiotics. Case fatality 10–20%; 11–19% of survivors have long-term sequelae. Symptoms include abrupt fever, headache, fatigue, and in severe cases vomiting, neck stiffness, altered consciousness, and purpuric rash.

triage.headline_ja: 南部での髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の発症数が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク）。ベトナム南部での髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の急増（前年同期比+13件）、死亡例あり、高い致命率（10-20%）、呼吸器飛沫感染でアウトブレイク懸念あり。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（異常/予想外、重症度、流行しやすさ）。フルRRA進行推奨。
triage.notes: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎はレポーター対象疾患（IHR Annex2）。ベトナム南部での明らかな増加傾向（2026年4月中旬時点で18例、前年同期+13例）。ホーチミン市で10例、死亡1例（2歳児）。血清群Bが優勢（2013-2026年で全て血清群B、軍事サーベイランスで91.3%）。呼吸器飛沫感染で学校・兵営などでのアウトブレイク懸念。致命率10-20%、生存者の11-19%に長期後遺症。保健当局（トロピカル病院CDC）が診断・治療・予防研修を実施中で、政府対応を確認。国際的拡大リスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Moga में डेंगू ने दी दस्तक, स्वास्थ्य विभाग को मिले 3 डेंगू पॉजीटिव मरीज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue makes its presence felt in Moga; 3 dengue-positive patients reported to the Health Department.
article.articleSummary: Three dengue-positive cases confirmed in Moga district over the past two days, including a 50-year-old woman, a 21-year-old woman, and a 62-year-old Bagapurana resident who tested dengue-positive at a hospital in Faridkot. Civil Surgeon Dr. Ramandeep Singla and District Epidemiologist Dr. Naresh Anwala said special teams have been deployed to survey neighborhoods around the positives and collect samples from suspected cases. Health authorities are intensifying dengue, malaria, and chikungunya awareness in both urban and rural areas, with doctors and medical teams disseminating preventive guidance. Officials urge residents with fever lasting five days or more, or experiencing weakness, to visit nearby health centers for free evaluation and treatment to prevent progression to severe illness.

triage.headline_ja: Moga町でデング熱が出現、保健部門により3人のデング熱陽性患者が報告される
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の確定症例3例がインドのMoga地区で報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」に該当する可能性がある。ただし症例数が限定的で、重症度、流行リスク、国際拡大リスク等の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報による情報確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、インドのPunjab州Moga地区でのデング熱確定症例3例の報告と確認。マラリア、チクングニアの同時サーベイランスも実施中。症例数が限定的であり、重症度情報がないため、IHR基準2つ以上の該当には至らず。WPROスクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」の3基準に該当するが、公式な確認と詳細情報の充実を待つ必要あり。

locations.name: Independent State of Papua New Guinea

article.articleHeadline: Tips Bagi Pelancong atau Traveller Terhindar Penyakit Malaria Ditularkan Nyamuk Anopheles
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tips for Travellers to Avoid Malaria Transmitted by Anopheles Mosquitoes
article.articleSummary: Malaria is a parasitic disease transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes. The article provides travel tips to avoid malaria in endemic regions. In Indonesia, eastern regions—Indonesia Timur, including Papua, Maluku, and parts of Nusa Tenggara—remain endemic, with 21% of the country affected and 79% malaria-free. In 2021, more than 40% of Indonesia’s malaria cases occurred in Papua. Globally, 247 million malaria cases were reported in 84 endemic countries (World Malaria Report 2022). Symptoms include fever, chills, headache, and fatigue; early detection enables prompt prevention and treatment. Risk in other regions (Africa Sub-Saharan, Indian subcontinent, Southeast Asia) is tied to geography and the May–December travel season.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊によるマラリア感染を避けるための旅行者向けのヒント
triage.triage_reason: マラリア対策の一般的な旅行情報記事で、新規アウトブレイク、異常な発生パターン、または急速な国際拡大を示す証拠がない。既知の風土病地域における標準的な予防啓発コンテンツ。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病地域（インドネシア東部、パプア、マルク州など）でのマラリア予防に関する一般的な旅行ガイダンスを提供している。アウトブレイク、異常な発生、または緊急事態の兆候は記載されていない。2021年のデータを参照しているが、新規情報ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Bareilly:कामगार परदेस से लौटे मगर एचआईवी संक्रमण साथ लेकर
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bareilly: Workers returning from abroad, but carrying HIV infection.
article.articleSummary: Bareilly division reports rising HIV infections among migrant workers returning from abroad. Since 2012, 7,015 people across four districts—Bareilly (3,382), Badaun (1,304), Shahjahanpur (978), Pilibhit (875)—have tested HIV positive; all are on ART at Bareilly District Hospital's ART center. Median age 25–45, with the highest transmission in this group; men predominate over women. Nearly 85% of counseling cases attribute infection to unsafe sex; children with drug use-related infections have been seen. The old city area shows a concentration of cases in three sensitive mohallas; routine camps and online data sharing for monitoring are underway. About 150+ known HIV-positive individuals are not in ongoing counseling or treatment and are being traced. Transmission pathways include sexual contact, injecting drug use, and mother-to-child. Prevention emphasized includes condom use, avoiding unscreened blood transfusions, and avoiding pregnancies among infected women.

triage.headline_ja: Bareilly: 海外から帰国した労働者がHIV感染を持ち込む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上に該当（異常性・予想外性、長期的な公衆衛生影響）。4地区にまたがる7,015人のHIV陽性者報告は深刻な公衆衛生影響を示し、移民労働者からの感染伝播は国際的広がりのリスクがある。
triage.notes: 海外からの帰国労働者によるHIV導入は国境を越えた感染の顕著なリスク要因。4地区での大規模感染、治療中断者150+ 名の存在、複数の感染経路（性的接触、注射薬物使用、母子感染）が存在することから、管理能力の強化が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 163 Suspek Campak di Triwulan Pertama, Dinkes Kabupaten Malang Kejar Imunisasi Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 163 Suspected Measles Cases in the First Quarter, Malang Regency Health Office Pursues Measles Immunization.
article.articleSummary: Malang Regency Health Office accelerates measles–rubella (MR) vaccination to curb Morbillivirus spread, targeting 87,279 under-five children for MR doses 1 and 2. In Q1 2026, 162 suspected measles cases were recorded (January–March). By March 2026, only 16.7% had been immunized (14,574), with 7,231 children receiving MR dose 1 and 7,343 dose 2. Last year, 63,106 children completed MR. The drive prioritizes zero-dose and dropout children, plus sweeping by name and address and public education. If a child is suspected, the Dinkes Malang will conduct epidemiological investigations, collect specimens for laboratory confirmation, perform contact tracing, and isolate suspected cases. Collaboration with TPMB and private hospitals will help accelerate immunization.

triage.headline_ja: 第1四半期に麻疹疑い例163件、マランク県保健局が麻疹予防接種を推進
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（マランク県）で麻疹の疑い例163件が報告されており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度の可能性・流行しやすさ）に該当する可能性があるが、確認例数・死亡・重症度の詳細が不明であり、情報が不十分であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の疑い例数（163件）を報告しているが、確定例数、重症度、死亡者数が記載されていない。予防接種キャンペーン実施中であり、管理可能性は高いと考えられるが、確定診断と臨床的重症度の情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ситуация с оспой обезьян в мире трудная, заявила Попова
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The global monkeypox situation is difficult, Popova said.
article.articleSummary: Brazzaville, April 22, 2026 — The global monkeypox situation remains tense. Imports into the Russian Federation may occur, but there is currently no risk of spread within Russia, according to Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor. She told reporters that the agency identifies every monkeypox case and acts promptly to contain potential threats. The update emphasizes ongoing international epidemiological uncertainty while noting that domestic transmission is not indicated. No domestic case counts are reported in the article. The statement highlights Russia's readiness to monitor incoming cases and implement measures quickly, even as international conditions remain unsettled.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的なサル痘の状況は困難と述べたポポワ氏
triage.triage_reason: サル痘の国際的な流行が確認されており複数の基準に該当するが、本記事はロシア当局の声明に焦点が当たっており、対象国内での実質的な感染件数やアウトブレイクの詳細が記載されていない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラザビルおよび複数地域を言及しているが、サマリー内容の主眼はロシア当局（Rospotrebnadzor）による国際的な状況評価であり、特定の対象国内での実際のアウトブレイク詳細は記載されていない。DRCは発生地域に含まれており、サル痘の既知の流行地域として対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に登録した。スクリーニング基準3項目該当で政府関心も高いが、本記事は主に当局の監視能力表明であり、新規アウトブレイク情報としての具体性に欠ける。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh 'sốt đất' đang lan rộng ở Thái Lan là bệnh gì?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What disease is the 'soil fever' spreading in Thailand?
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis, or soil fever, caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is spreading in Thailand with hundreds of cases reported in early 2026 and high mortality, especially when diagnosed late or in people with underlying conditions. Transmission is environmental and mainly occurs through direct contact with mud or soil (via skin cuts during farming), inhalation of dusty soil, or via contaminated water. Symptoms are diverse: early fever, malaise, myalgia or headache; can progress to pneumonia with cough and dyspnea or septicemia with shock and altered consciousness; the bacterium may form abscesses in liver, spleen, lungs, or disseminate. High-risk groups include diabetes, chronic kidney or liver disease, alcohol use, and immunosuppression. Treatment requires prolonged antibiotics: initial IV therapy for acute infection, followed by weeks to months of oral antibiotics to eradicate the pathogen and prevent relapse. Prevention includes PPE, avoiding mud with wounds, hand hygiene, and safe water. Seek hospital care for persistent fever, cough, or respiratory symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: タイで流行している『土からの熱病』は何か？
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスが2026年初期にタイで数百症例報告され、高い死亡率を示しており、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスク・重症度が認められ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスは環境由来の感染症で、土壌・泥への曝露が主要な伝播経路。糖尿病や慢性腎臓病などの基礎疾患を有する人が高リスク。早期発見時でも高い死亡率が特徴。地理的なリスク層（タイを含む南東アジア）への国際拡大の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ cơ sở bán thịt chó tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog-meat shop owner dies of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death in Đồng Tháp Province, Vietnam: a 58-year-old dog meat shop owner, Nguyễn Ngọc S., of Mỹ Trường, Mỹ Tịnh An commune, Đồng Tháp, died 20 April 2026 after 15–16 April onset of dizziness, right‑sided weakness, and later hydrophobia and dysphagia. He had no reported dog bite but kept a 2–3 month‑old dog at home, vaccinated for rabies within the past year; the dog remained asymptomatic. PCR testing confirmed rabies virus. The patient was initially diagnosed with benign paroxysmal positional vertigo and hypertension; later diagnosed with rabies with severe respiratory failure and died at home on 20 April after discharge from Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases on 17 April. Public health authorities conducted contact tracing, advised immediate post‑exposure vaccination for close contacts, and coordinated with veterinary services to investigate animal sources and nearby slaughterhouses. Emphasis on rabies risk and preventive vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: 犬肉販売店主が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける散発的な狂犬病死亡例。IHR基準は2つ未満（国際拡大のリスク低い）だが、WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・流行性を満たし、情報は限定的。続報を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事に明記されている発生地はĐồng Tháp Province（ホーチミン市の記載は医療機関への入院地）。PCR確認による確定診断あり。接触者の追跡調査と予防接種が実施されている。狂犬病は散発的感染が多く、個別死亡例としては国際的拡大リスク低いが、動物由来感染症の検出として関連当局の対応が確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: 3 người bị chó dại cắn tử vong, TPHCM cảnh báo nóng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three people die after being bitten by rabid dogs; Ho Chi Minh City issues urgent warning.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in Ho Chi Minh City prompts warning after three people were bitten by dogs in Phước Thắng ward on 17 April; all victims received wound care and rabies vaccination and are stable. As of 20 April 2026, the city had three rabies deaths this year, compared with five cases in all of 2025, signaling a concerning upsurge during hot weather and the season of highest transmission. Health authorities warn that controlling animal sources is critical to prevent outbreaks. The Department of Health has issued a strengthened rabies prevention directive, with HCDC and the Livestock and Veterinary department coordinating surveillance, public education, and outbreak response. Rabies is a viral disease transmitted from animals via bites, scratches, or saliva; once symptoms appear, it is nearly 100% fatal. Prevention emphasizes the '5 nos' for pets, vaccination for high-risk groups, and immediate wound care (wash 15 minutes, then disinfection) and prompt medical care.

triage.headline_ja: 3人が狂犬病の犬に咬まれて死亡、ホーチミン市が緊急警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム（ホーチミン市）で狂犬病による3人の死亡が確認され、2025年全体の5例と比べて2026年既に3例の発生は懸念される増加傾向。致死率がほぼ100%で重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、IHR基準を複数満たし、ローカルレベルでも社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率がほぼ100%で、記事では季節的な増加パターン（高温期・最高伝播時期）が指摘されている。ベトナムの保健当局は強化された狂犬病予防対策指令を発令しており、管理体制が機能していることが示唆される。国際的拡大リスクは低いが、地域的には重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: 中國疾控局：流感病毒活躍度上升 | 兩岸 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China CDC: Influenza virus activity on the rise | Cross-Strait | CNA
article.articleSummary: China CDC reports rising influenza and rhinovirus activity since April, with increased transmission as the May Day holidays approach and travel/gatherings surge. In a briefing, spokesperson Xi Jingjing noted respiratory infections fluctuating in April, with both influenza viruses and rhinovirus activity on the rise. Surveillance shows Week 14 (Mar 30–Apr 5) influenza test positivity up for the third consecutive week, driven mainly by influenza B; Week 15 (Apr 6–12) then eased slightly. Public health guidance urges protective measures, including mask-wearing in crowded places and on public transport. The agency also flags vigilance for mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue fever and chikungunya, as well as enteric infections like norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease.

triage.headline_ja: 中国疾病対策予防センター：インフルエンザウイルス活動度が上昇
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器系・ベクター媒介感染症が中国で同時活動中であり、5月連休の大型イベント・人流増加に伴う拡大リスクが明確。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク該当、WPROスクリーニング基準で流行易易性・管理性等複数該当。
triage.notes: 複数病原体（インフルエンザA/B、ノロウイルス、デング、チクングニア、エンテロウイルス71等）の同時活動が報告されている。5月連休に向けた人流増加と国際的な春節後の移動パターンが国際拡大リスクを高める。公衆衛生上の懸念と政府レベルでの対応が既に実施されている点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Slow Foot-and-Mouth vaccination pace: Farmers warn of impending disaster for economy
article.articleSummary: South Africa faces a looming economic and food-security crisis as Foot-and-Mouth Disease vaccination proceeds at a slow pace. Industry groups warn that a six-to-eight-week mass campaign is the only proven path to herd immunity, aiming to vaccinate 14 million cattle and halt transmission. As of 2026-04-22, government procurement stands at 4 million doses with plans for a further 7 million, but there is little detail on how vaccines will reach farmers or be deployed, raising concerns about ongoing circulation and potential virus mutation. FMD Response SA and over 250 producers urge private-sector involvement, proposing private procurement, fast-tracked import permits for high-quality vaccines, and independent distribution to bypass state bottlenecks. DDG Dipepeneneng Serage indicated readiness to work with large commercial farmers and facilitate private import permits. Citing Brazil and Argentina, supporters argue intensive, short campaigns can eradicate FMD; without swift action, the economy and food security will suffer.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫ワクチン接種ペースの遅さ：農業関係者が経済危機の到来を警告
triage.triage_reason: 動物由来疾患（口蹄疫）による経済・食糧安全保障への深刻な影響が予想され、国家レベルでの対応が急務とされている。南アフリカで確認されたシグナルは、IHR基準2つ以上に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も満たす。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが南アフリカ、ブラジル、アルゼンチンを発生地域として報告しているが、記事サマリーの主題は南アフリカの口蹄疫対応危機である。ただし、南アフリカは対象国リスト（CEPR EBS対象国）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。動物由来疾患であり、IHR(2005) Annex2の直接的な人間の感染症ではないが、経済・食糧安全保障への深刻な影響とステークホルダーの高い関心から、トリアージはPICKUPと判定。継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Angka Tuberkulosis di Solo Tembus 405 Kasus, Dinkes Catat 20 Persen Pasien Tak Patuh Minum Obat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis cases in Solo reach 405; Health Office notes that 20 percent of patients are not adherent to TB treatment.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 April 2026, Solo (Surakarta), Indonesia, reported 405 tuberculosis cases, with 80 percent of patients adherent to anti-TB medication and 20 percent non-adherent. Health officials warn that incomplete treatment risks disease progression and higher transmission. TB is a bacterial infection that is curable when patients complete the prescribed regimen. The City Health Office (Dinas Kesehatan Kota Surakarta) is strengthening integrated TB tracing as a national priority to locate cases and their close contacts more quickly. One key measure is the Kelurahan Peduli TB program, implemented across all urban villages to enable community-level case finding, treatment, and prevention. Officials also urged adherence to healthy living behaviors (PHBS) and improvements to home environments, noting damp, shaded homes can foster bacterial growth. The initiative was highlighted during World TB Day events in Jebres district office.

triage.headline_ja: ソロ市の結核患者数が405人に達する、保健局は患者の20％が抗結核薬の服用を遵守していないと記録
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の風土病であり、単一都市での報告は異常性に欠ける。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも満たさず、国際的な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 結核はインドネシアの風土病であり、単一都市（ソロ）での405例の報告は疫学的に予期される範囲内と考えられる。治療遵守率の低さ（20％が非遵守）は地域的な保健課題であるが、国家的優先事項として対応されており、公式な予防・追跡プログラムが実施されている。国際的な懸念事項はない。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Kasaï : plus d'un million d'enfants attendus pour la vaccination contre la poliomyélite | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Kasai: more than a million children expected for polio vaccination | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign launched in Kasai region, Democratic Republic of Congo, targeting about 1.28 million children aged 0-59 months across 18 health zones, beginning 22 April 2026. The campaign aims to boost immunity and catch up children inadequately vaccinated. It combines simultaneous administration of NVPO2 and bivalent oral polio vaccine (VPO bivalent) to strengthen interruption of poliovirus circulation. Launch event held at Kalonda-Ouest by the interim governor, who urged parents to vaccinate all children. Organized with support from WHO and UNICEF, the campaign follows a postponement due to logistical constraints. No disease outbreak figures provided; focus is on routine eradication effort and cross-border/import considerations not specified. The effort emphasizes vaccination coverage, disease prevention, and international partner coordination to accelerate control of poliovirus transmission in Kasai.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | カサイ：ポリオ予防接種キャンペーンで100万人以上の児童対象 | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施に関するニュースであり、疾病の流行・アウトブレイクではなく、公衆衛生対策の報道である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、社会的関心も限定的。
triage.notes: 本件はポリオ予防接種キャンペーンの実施報道であり、感染症の流行や異常な発症事例を示すものではない。記事サマリーに「No disease outbreak figures provided」と明記されており、定期的な根絶努力の一環である。したがってシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒月底竄升　醫警告「成人無症狀感染」恐害全家中招 | ETtoday健康雲 | ETtoday新聞雲
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enteroviruses Surge by Month's End; Doctors Warn That Asymptomatic Infections in Adults Could Strike the Whole Family
article.articleSummary: Enteroviruses pose an escalating risk in Taiwan, with the Disease Control Agency forecasting a rapid rise by late April and an epidemic by June, as last week’s enterovirus-related ED visits reached 3,526 (up from 3,027). Four-week laboratory surveillance shows Coxsackie A6 predominant, followed by A4 and A16; EV71 is not yet detected domestically. Travel can import infections, as adults may be asymptomatic and transmit the virus at home. Domestic severe enterovirus cases tally four this year: EV-D68 (two cases) and Coxsackie A4 and A16 (one each), higher than 2022–2024. Taiwan has an EV71 vaccine for infants. High-risk groups are children under five; warning signs of severe disease include lethargy, altered consciousness, poor vitality, limb weakness or paralysis, muscle twitching or convulsions, persistent vomiting, and rapid breathing or tachycardia—prompt hospital care is advised. Notable neighboring outbreaks occur in Vietnam (Ho Chi Minh City and southern provinces) with EV71-linked severe disease and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒月底竄升　醫警告「成人無症狀感染」恐害全家中招
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのエンテロウイルス71の流行予測と、ベトナム南部での重症例・死亡報告が確認された。IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行容易性）により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 台湾では現在EV71は国内検出なしだが、ベトナム南部（ホーチミン市および周辺州）ではEV71関連の重症例および死亡が報告されている。成人の無症状感染による家庭内感染の危険性が医療専門家から警告されており、渡航によるウイルス輸入の懸念がある。台湾での4月末から6月のエピデミック予測があり、5歳未満児が高リスク群として特定されている。2026年の国内重症例は過去3年平均より増加傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Takeda Viet Nam's journey highlighted in dengue prevention
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Vietnam: Takeda Viet Nam's DeRIGHT-V campaign demystifies dengue via short videos, the Mosquito Beat Drop, and an interactive dengue complications station at the Saigon Zoo (Ho Chi Minh City). In 2026 it won the Healthcare Asia Pharma Awards' Marketing & Communications Initiative of the Year; 2025 saw the TVC of the Year at Van Xuan Awards. The campaign delivered over 733 million impressions and 78 million views, with an 11-fold rise in dengue- and dengue-vaccination searches versus the prior two years. Vietnam records over 100,000 dengue cases annually, with year-round transmission nationwide and hospitalizations common. Takeda collaborates with local Centers for Disease Control and media to share official epidemiological information. Over two years, 1,000+ educational activities reached 7,000 healthcare professionals; Viet Nam Dengue Summit 2025 hosted 700+ experts. The dengue vaccine is WHO-recommended for high-burden countries, approved in 40+ nations with 21 million doses distributed.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱予防におけるタケダベトナムの取り組みが強調される
triage.triage_reason: 記事はベトナムのデング熱啓発キャンペーンと公衆衛生教育イニシアチブに焦点を当てており、新規の感染症クラスタ発生やアウトブレイク検知ではなく、既知の風土病に対する予防キャンペーンである。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は製薬企業の公衆衛生キャンペーンについての広報記事であり、新規感染症イベント（新規クラスタ、異常な増加、未知の病原体など）を報告していない。ベトナムが既知のデング熱風土病を抱える地域であることは事実だが、本記事は教育・啓発活動の成果報告であり、シグナル検知対象外と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: 4月以来中国流感病毒和鼻病毒活动水平呈上升趋势
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Since April, the activity levels of influenza viruses and rhinoviruses in China have shown an upward trend.
article.articleSummary: Influenza viruses and rhinoviruses have risen in activity in China since April. At a Beijing press briefing on 22 April, National Health Commission officials urged vaccination as the most effective defense amid rising respiratory illness. With May Day travel increasing, authorities urged vigilance for mosquito-borne and gastrointestinal infections, but no outbreaks are reported. China is expanding its immunization program: HPV vaccine was added in 2025 and will be a free service for eligible girls in 2026. Guidance: HPV for women aged 9–45; influenza vaccine for those 6 months and older; pneumococcal and shingles vaccines for seniors. Childhood vaccination rates under the national program exceed 90%, helping push down measles, rubella, meningococcal meningitis, Japanese encephalitis, and hepatitis A, and contributing to the elimination of neonatal tetanus.

triage.headline_ja: 4月以来、中国におけるインフルエンザウイルスとライノウイルスの活動水準が上昇傾向を示している
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザとライノウイルスの活動増加が報告されているが、現在のところ外部支援を要する爆発的な流行や重大な公衆衛生上の危機の兆候はない。今後の動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はインフルエンザ・ライノウイルスの活動増加を報告しているが、現在のところ流行宣言や深刻な患者数増加は明記されていない。中国の予防接種プログラムが充実しており、麻疹・風疹・髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎などが抑制されている。5月の大型連休による移動増加に伴う注視が促されている。今後の症例数報告を継続的に監視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 23 người ở Thái Lan tử vong do bệnh sốt đất , Bộ Y tế Việt Nam ra khuyến cáo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 23 people in Thailand have died from land fever; Vietnam's Ministry of Health has issued a warning.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 23 fatalities from melioidosis (Whitmore), prompting Vietnam's Ministry of Health to issue a warning. Melioidosis is an infectious disease caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, a bacterium native to soil, mud, and contaminated surface water. Humans acquire infection through contact with contaminated soil, mud, or water via cuts or wounds; inhalation of dust or contaminated droplets; or consumption of contaminated water or food. The disease presents with diverse clinical manifestations and is often misdiagnosed early. Severe forms include pneumonia, abscesses in multiple organs, septicemia, and septic shock, with high risk of death if not detected and treated promptly. High-risk groups include individuals with diabetes, liver disease, kidney disease, chronic lung disease, immunodeficiency, and those with frequent exposure to soil, mud, or dirty water.

triage.headline_ja: タイで23人がメリオイドーシス（土の熱病）で死亡、ベトナム保健省が警告を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での報告と高い致死率により、WPRO基準も複数項目で該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: タイで23人の死亡が報告され、ベトナム保健省が正式警告を発表。メリオイドーシスは土壌由来の感染症で、複数の高リスク群（糖尿病、肝疾患、免疫不全など）が存在。早期診断・治療が困難で予後不良な点が懸念材料。地理的近接性と環境媒介性により、地域内での感染拡大リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Agro.- El alto riesgo de PPA se amplía a Castellbisbal (Barcelona) y...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agro.- The high risk of African Swine Fever expands to Castellbisbal (Barcelona) and....
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (PPA) high-risk zone expanded to Castellbisbal (Barcelona) after a positive wild boar case, bringing the total of positive wild boar findings to 284 with 16 new positives reported last week. Zone 2 now covers 19 municipalities, with mobility restrictions in Castellbisbal and nine initial sanctions for breaches of access prohibitions. Authorities warn against night access to areas like Collserola Park where culling drives occur, to protect public safety. An emergency 7 million euro contract was activated to reinforce PPA controls, adding 170 personnel, over 50 vehicles, and 50 traps. Pork prices have recovered to about 0.03 euros lower than before the first cases, and exports of new pork products to China—one of Catalonia’s major pork importers—have reopened, signaling renewed sector confidence amid ongoing surveillance and enforcement.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱（PPA）の高リスク地域がバルセロナのカステルビスバルに拡大、ザンビア地域の2ゾーンで合計284頭の野生イノシシが陽性、新たに16頭が報告される
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は家畜動物への感染症であり、人間への感染リスク、国際的な公衆衛生への急性的脅威が限定的。スペイン国内の動物疾患管理イベントであり、対象国での発生ではない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはスペイン（カタルーニャ州）での家畜動物疾患であり、対象国リストに該当する国での発生ではない。Bluedot APIが China を記載しているのは豚肉輸出市場言及に基づくものと考えられるが、記事サマリーは中国での感染発生を述べていない。IHR基準および WPRO スクリーニング基準の該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: El chikungunya reaparece en boletín epidemiológico en plena alerta regional - Runrun.es: En defensa de tus derechos humanos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya reappears in an epidemiological bulletin amid a regional alert - Runrun.es: In defense of your human rights
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya reappears in Venezuela’s epidemiological bulletin for week 14 (April 5–14, 2026), with four laboratory-confirmed cases since week 49, 2025: one in Sucre (2025) and three in Distrito Capital (parishes Sucre and San Agustín). Transmission by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus; symptoms include high fever and severe, often disabling joint pain; no vaccine; endemic since 2014 with spikes linked to rainfall and vector proliferation. The World Health Organization/PAHO issued a February 10, 2026 regional alert urging intensified surveillance and vector control. The bulletin notes data gaps for Oropouche fever. Malaria totals reach 29,283 cases in 2026 (up 7.4% vs 2025 week 1–14), concentrated in Bolívar, Amazonas, Apure, Lara, Carabobo, Delta Amacuro, Monagas. Yellow fever: 40 human cases (June 2025–Mar 2026) with 21 deaths (50% CFR) across 14 states. Epizootics in nonhuman primates total 116 events, concentrated in Aragua and central Venezuela, signaling spillover risk to humans via vectors.

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア熱がベネズエラの疫学速報に再出現、地域警報の最中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。複数の高リスク感染症（黄熱病、チクングニア熱、マラリア、オロポウシュ熱）の同時流行、高い死亡率（黄熱病50% CFR）、霊長類でのエピゾーティック116件による人獣共通感染リスク、WHO/PAHO地域警報発令により、即座のフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ベネズエラが主要発生国だが、対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めない。ブラジルは発生地域に記載されており、ベネズエラとの境界地域（アマゾナス州など）での感染拡大リスクを考慮して含める。WHO/PAHO地域警報（2026年2月10日）により、既に地域レベルの公衆衛生対応が進行中。黄熱病の高い致命率（21/40=52.5%）と霊長類エピゾーティック116件は人への感染拡大の警告信号。

article.articleHeadline: Попова заявила о росте случаев заражения оспой обезьян в мире
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Popova said there is a rise in monkeypox cases worldwide.
article.articleSummary: Russia currently has no risk of monkeypox spread, according to Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, despite a globally tense situation. She noted that while imports into the Russian Federation are possible, there is no ongoing domestic transmission risk. Rospotrebnadzor identifies every case and promptly implements measures. Indian researchers reported that the monkeypox virus genome has mutated, enabling immune evasion and easier entry into humans, a change that could increase transmission while potentially easing disease severity. In early April, monkeypox was detected in one patient at a Domodedovo hospital; a contact tested negative for the virus.

triage.headline_ja: ポポヴァ氏が世界中でサル痘感染例が増加していることを発表
triage.triage_reason: インドでのゲノム変異報告により流行可能性が懸念されるが、具体的な症例数や重症度が不明確。ロシアでの国内伝播リスクは低いと当局が評価。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: ロシアはBluedot APIで発生地域として列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はインドでのゲノム変異報告とロシアのリスク評価（低リスク）であり、ロシアでの実質的なアウトブレイクではない。IHR基準2つ以上該当し PICKUP 候補だが、WPRO対象国がインド（未確認ケース）のみで、検証可能な具体的症例情報と重症度評価が不足しているため WATCH に留める。
