article.articleHeadline: Casos de Gripe K avançam pelo país, e Ministério da Saúde alerta sobre importância da vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cases of Flu K advance across the country, and the Ministry of Health warns about the importance of vaccination.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-22, the Ministry of Health reports that the H3N2 influenza variant, termed Flu AK, accounts for about 70% of influenza infections across the country since its identification late last year. The national vaccination campaign began 28 March and runs through 30 May, with annual vaccine updates needed due to frequent influenza mutations. About 10 million doses have been administered, aiming to immunize roughly 90% of the priority population—a group totaling nearly 80 million people. The brief provides no laboratory-confirmed outbreak data or death counts. The report emphasizes vaccination as a critical measure to curb transmission nationwide as Flu AK continues to drive infections.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザKの感染例が国中に拡大、保健省がワクチン接種の重要性を警告
triage.triage_reason: H3N2インフルエンザ（Flu AK）が70%の感染を占める流行が国内で進行中だが、死亡者数や重症例の明確な記載がなく、情報不足。スクリーニング基準では該当する可能性があるが、詳細な疫学情報がないため段階的な確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザA(H3N2)の継続的流行を報じている。死亡例や入院数などの重症度指標が記載されていないため、公衆衛生への影響の程度が判断困難。保健省による国家予防接種キャンペーンが進行中であり、政府・公的関心は高い。通常の季節性インフルエンザ対応の範囲内と判断されるため、追加情報の収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Superbactéria causa morte de bebê e fecha UTI de hospital em Porto Alegre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Superbug causes baby's death and closes hospital ICU in Porto Alegre
article.articleSummary: Pan-resistant bacterium detected in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) at Hospital Fêmina in Porto Alegre, prompting maximum safety protocols. Contamination identified on 16 April 2026 led to a temporary closure of the NICU to new admissions and total isolation of the affected area. Of 34 inpatients, four tested positive for the pathogen. Among them, an extremely premature newborn at 26 weeks gestation died. The remaining three positives are stable and isolated under exclusive care, with no contact to other hospital areas. Grupo Hospitalar Conceição (GHC) alerted municipal and state health authorities to monitor the situation. The Municipal Health Secretariat redirected high-risk pregnant women to other maternities in the city as a precaution. The hospital is conducting disinfection and restricting internal movements to contain spread; all babies in the unit remain under continuous monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーバクテリアがポルトアレグレの病院のICUで乳児の死亡を引き起こし閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: パンレジスタント菌による新生児ICU内での院内感染、乳児死亡、複数の陽性患者が確認された。IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と予想外性に該当し、医療施設内感染の可能性で国際的関心が高まるリスクがある。
triage.notes: パンレジスタント菌による院内感染のため、薬剤耐性菌（AMR）関連のシグナルとして重要。新生児ICUという高リスク環境での発生が懸念される。国家および地域保健当局が既に関与している。ポルトアレグレはブラジル南部リオグランデドスル州の主要都市。

article.articleHeadline: La peste porcina se expande y ya son 19 municipios barceloneses los que prohíben el acceso al medio rural
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine fever is spreading, and 19 Barcelona-area municipalities now ban access to the countryside.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) continues to spread among wild boars in the Barcelona region, with 284 confirmed cases since the outbreak began in November, including 16 new positives in the last week. The outbreak now spans 19 municipalities, notably Castellbisbal, triggering a ban on access to natural areas in Castellbisbal and ongoing restrictions in Barcelona and surrounding towns. Authorities say the access bans are preventive, with nine fines issued so far and enforcement to deter violations. An emergency contract worth seven million euros will bolster ASF control, adding 170 personnel, more than 50 vehicles, and 50 traps, alongside intensified surveillance of access points and nocturnal culling efforts in Collserola Park. Despite ongoing delays to market openings, pork prices have modestly recovered, and exports of new pork products to China have reopened, supporting Catalonia’s pork sector.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱が拡大、バルセロナ地域の19の自治体が田舎地域へのアクセスを禁止
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は人獣共通感染症ではなく豚の病気であり、IHR/WPRO基準における公衆衛生への直接的な影響は限定的である。ただし、対象国外での発生（スペイン）であり、284確認例と継続的な拡大傾向は経過観察に値する。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱は動物疾病であり、IHR規定対象外である。ただし、記事で中国への豚肉輸出再開が言及されており、China（1814991）を検証済み地域として含めた。スペイン（対象国リストに非含）での発生であるため、PICKUP基準には達しないが、国際的な豚肉貿易への影響が明示されているため、継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Virus dai pesci all'uomo (Cmnv), lo Zooprofilattico delle Venezie: "Dati insufficienti per parlare di salto di specie" - AboutPharma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fish-to-human virus (CMNV), the Venezie Experimental Zooprophylactic Institute: "Insufficient data to speak of a species jump" - AboutPharma.
article.articleSummary: Covert mortality nodavirus (CMNV), a marine Nodavirus known to devastate shrimp and some fish, has been linked in a Nature Microbiology study to human ocular infection, triggering questions about seafood safety. However, the Veneto-based Istituto Zooprofilattico Sperimentale delle Venezie warns current data are insufficient to support a true species jump. No robust evidence of zoonotic spillover exists; observations are limited and need replication. CMNV was first identified in 2014 in China, mainly affecting shrimp farms, with later detections in some farmed and wild fish in Asia. Transmission hypotheses include handling infected crustaceans without protection or consumption of raw seafood; exposed groups may include aquaculture workers, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals with repeated exposure. Italy currently has no evidence of CMNV risk; the virus has not been reported in Europe. Further research and cautious communication are needed.

triage.headline_ja: 魚からヒトへのウイルス（CMNV）、ベネチアの実験的動物衛生研究所：「種の越界について語るにはデータが不十分」
triage.triage_reason: 未知の感染症（CMNV）と人獣共通感染症の可能性が報告されているが、現時点では種の越界を支持する確固たる証拠がなく、ヨーロッパでの発生報告もない。情報の確実性が低く、追加情報の収集が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にイタリアが含まれているが、記事サマリーではイタリアは単に研究機関の所在地・コメント提供機関として位置付けられており、CMNVの実際の発生地はアジア地域（特に中国）。ヨーロッパでの発生報告はなし。対象国リストに該当するのはChinaのみ。現段階では仮説的な段階であり、確実な人獣共通感染症の証拠が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD Meningkat, RS Pandan Rawat 193 Pasien dalam Beberapa Bulan Terakhir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever Cases on the Rise; Pandan Hospital Treats 193 Patients in Recent Months.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Tapanuli Tengah, Indonesia, are rising, with Pandan Hospital treating 193 patients in recent months. Most cases originate from Sipange and Pandan. There has been one death among the patients, underscoring severity. Pandan Hospital operates without a dedicated dengue isolation room, managing patients through vital signs assessment and ancillary tests; when dengue is suspected, inpatient care is advised. The hospital continues to coordinate with the local health department to strengthen response, while advising the public to adopt clean-living habits (PHBS) and to eliminate standing water to curb mosquito breeding. Official data are incomplete; the head of the Tapanuli Tengah Health Office, Lisnawati Panjaitan, has not commented on total cases, geographic distribution, fogging, facility readiness, or whether a Dengue Outbreak (KLB) has been declared as of 22 April 2026, fueling public calls for transparency.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者数が増加、パンダン病院が過去数ヶ月間に193人の患者を治療
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのタパヌリテンガ地区でデング熱の患者数が増加し、1例の死亡を含む重症例が報告されている。IHR基準では異常性と重症度が確認され、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡例あり）と地域内での継続的な曝露リスクが該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、タパヌリテンガ地区（インドネシア）でのデング熱集積が確認される。193例の患者、1例の死亡、蚊媒介感染の継続的リスク、公式データの不透明性が確認されている。病院の感染対策体制の課題（専用隔離室の不備）も管理可能性の問題として認識される。

article.articleHeadline: Puluhan nakes di Maros dilatih respons cepat KLB campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dozens of health workers in Maros trained in rapid response to a measles outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 22 April 2026, in Makassar, health workers from 14 puskesmas in Maros Regency attended a rapid-response workshop for an extraordinary measles outbreak (PD3I). The joint effort of the Maros Health Office and UNICEF aims to strengthen frontline capacity to manage the outbreak. Officials analyzed rising suspected and confirmed measles cases, noting exposure despite vaccination and gaps where vaccines were due but not administered. The training also emphasized vaccine logistics from provincial to district to puskesmas and maintaining the cold chain to ensure vaccine efficacy, along with community education to complete immunizations. Maros Health Office reports 31 children confirmed positive for measles; active case-finding and contact tracing are ongoing. UNICEF Health Specialist Badwi M Amin framed the activity as preparedness to bolster public health resilience.

triage.headline_ja: マロス県の数十人の医療従事者が麻疹アウトブレイク迅速対応訓練を受ける
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・マロス県で確認麻疹患者31人を含むアウトブレイク（PD3I）が発生しており、予防接種ギャップに関わる異常事態。WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性・重症度・管理能力について複数該当し、確認症例と流行対応の公開報告がなされている。
triage.notes: マロス県で31人の確認麻疹患者が報告されており、予防接種ギャップが明確に指摘されている。UNICEFも関与した強化対応体制が構築されている。アウトブレイク（PD3I：Penyakit Luar Biasa）として当局が正式認定している。

article.articleHeadline: Virus From Marine Animals Causing Rare Eye Disease, Medicos Ring Alarm Bells
article.articleSummary: CMNV—Covert Mortality Nodavirus—linked to Persistent Ocular Hypertension Viral Anterior Uveitis (POH-VAU), a rare human eye disease caused by a marine animal virus spillover. A Nature Microbiology study from 2022–2025 of 70 infected individuals in China found all tested positive for CMNV, with symptoms of extremely elevated intraocular pressure and recurrent uveitis risking irreversible glaucoma and vision loss. Researchers report cross-species transmission evidence: CMNV infection and seroconversion in patients exposed to seafood, and 49 virus species identified overall. While initial cases were in China, India faces potential risk due to seafood handling and consumption of raw/undercooked shrimp and fish; no officially reported Indian cases to date and no evidence of human-to-human spread. Experts urge surveillance, thoroughly cooking seafood, and academic vigilance, not panic. India’s seafood-rich states (West Bengal, Kerala, Goa) and fisheries sector (28 million livelihoods) underscore exposure relevance, though outbreak level concerns are not warranted.

triage.headline_ja: 海の動物由来ウイルスがまれな眼疾患を引き起こす、医学専門家が警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: 未知の病原体（CMNV）による異常な眼疾患の報告であり、動物由来ウイルス感染の可能性と人間への影響が示唆されているが、インドでの公式報告例がなく、人間対人間感染の証拠もない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではCMNVは中国で確認された疾患であり、インドは「潜在的リスク」地域として位置付けられている。公式報告例はインドにはなく、人間対人間感染の証拠もない。シーフード取扱いと加熱不十分な調理に関連した職業的・食品関連曝露リスクが存在する。情報不足（確認症例数、重症度の詳細、封じ込め状況など）が多くWATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế cảnh báo bệnh Whitmore, khuyến cáo phòng "sốt đất
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns about Whitmore's disease, advises preventing 'soil fever'.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-22, Thailand reports 732 melioidosis cases and 23 deaths; Vietnam's Ministry of Health Preventive Medicine Department warns about Whitmore's disease (melioidosis), also known as 'soil fever', caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei in polluted mud, soil, and water. The disease is mainly environmental and not commonly spread person-to-person. In Vietnam, sporadic annual cases, rising after heavy rains or floods. Transmission occurs via wounds, inhalation of contaminated dust, or ingestion of contaminated water or food. High-risk groups include diabetics, chronic liver, kidney, or lung disease, and immunocompromised individuals; agricultural workers in muddy environments are especially at risk. Prevention urges avoiding contact with stagnant water and mud; wear gloves, boots, and protective gear when farming or cleaning; cover wounds; maintain hygiene, use clean water and safe food. Seek medical care promptly if fever, cough, chest pain, or skin infection after exposure to dirty water or mud to enable early treatment and prevent severe complications.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がホイットモア病（メリオイドーシス）について警告、「土の熱」の予防を勧告
triage.triage_reason: タイで732例の患者と23人の死亡が報告されており、ベトナムでも健康警告が発行されている。IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常/予想外」に該当し、両国での事例確認により国際的懸念が示唆される。
triage.notes: タイでの732例は顕著な患者数である。両国での同時警告は地域的な流行パターンを示唆。メリオイドーシスは環境由来疾患だが、重症化リスクが高い高危険群が定義されている。洪水や大雨後に増加するパターンは季節性がある可能性を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Lymphocyte-mediated immune responses to Leishmania infection - Nature Reviews Immunology
article.articleSummary: Leishmaniasis elicits lymphocyte responses across cutaneous, visceral, and PKDL forms. Protective CD4 T cell–derived IFN-γ drives parasite control, correlating with positive leishmanin skin tests, antigen-specific IFN-γ production, and IFN-γ–inducible programs in healing lesions, yet these T1 pathways can fuel mucosal and severe cutaneous pathology. The IL-12–IFN-γ axis is central to T cell differentiation; defects associate with severe, recurrent cutaneous leishmaniasis, while visceral leishmaniasis GWAS highlight MHC class II involvement. In visceral disease, adjunctive IFN-γ improves outcomes; ex vivo blockade of IFN-γ or HLA-DR increases parasite growth. IL-10–producing type I regulatory T cells—driven by IL-27 and BLIMP1—restrain T cell and antigen-presenting cell functions, protecting tissues but allowing persistent infection. Plasma cells populate leishmaniasis skin lesions and PKDL; lack of lesional plasma cells prognostic of treatment success, with early links between plasma cells and necrosis. Brazil-linked studies tie wound-healing/regulatory genes to cutaneous disease.

triage.headline_ja: リーシュマニア感染に対するリンパ球介在性免疫応答 - Nature Reviews Immunology
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術レビュー論文であり、特定の新規流行事例や疾患集積の報告ではなく、生物学的メカニズムの総説である。IHRおよびWPRO基準に該当する急性の公衆衛生的懸念は認識されない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature Reviews Immunologyの査読済み学術論文であり、リーシュマニア症の免疫メカニズムに関する総説である。サマリーはブラジルを含む複数国の研究を参照しているが、特定の新規流行事例や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。Bluedot APIが検出した理由は学術的な関連性と考えられるが、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta no RS: doença grave transmitida por morcegos preocupa região
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Rio Grande do Sul: a serious disease transmitted by bats concerns the region.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-22, Rio Grande do Sul issued a sanitary alert for herbivorous rabies after focal cases in Tiradentes do Sul and São Nicolau, in the Northwest and Missões regions near the Argentina border. The State Department of Agriculture aims to bolster vaccination and expand preventive measures to protect livestock. Coordinator Wilson Hoffmeister reports field teams are surveying affected areas for bat refuges, the primary transmission source, which threatens cattle and other livestock. Refuges have not yet been located, elevating concern for possible spread to nearby municipalities. Producers are advised not to capture bats; if potential hideouts are identified (hollow trees, caves, tunnels, abandoned houses), report immediately to the Municipal Inspectorate or the Office of Agricultural Defense. Prompt action aims to reduce risk to herds and safeguard agricultural livelihoods.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスルでの警報：コウモリが媒介する重篤な病気が地域に懸念をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: ウシの草食性狂犬病（herbivorous rabies）の局所的な複数事例がブラジル南部で報告されており、スクリーニング基準では異常性と重症度が該当するが、現時点では対象国内での地域的な家畜関連の事例に留まっており、人への影響や国際的拡大の具体的根拠に乏しいため。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのリオグランデドスル州における草食性狂犬病の家畜での発生に関するものであり、人への影響や死亡例の記述はない。コウモリからの継続的な曝露リスクが懸念される。アルゼンチン国境付近での報告であるが、アルゼンチンは対象国ではないため除外。続報で人への感染や国際的拡大の動きを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TBC Masih Tinggi, DKK Solo Intensifkan Pemeriksaan Kontak Erat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB cases remain high, Solo Health Office intensifies close contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: Solo City Health Office intensifies tuberculosis control by tracing 100 close contacts of TB patients in Mojosongo and Jebres; tracing conducted at Jebres Sub-district Office on 22 April 2026 and integrated with the Free Health Check program to reach wider communities. The effort targets interrupting transmission in high-risk settings, with collaboration among pulmonology specialists, academics, and health associations. In 2025, Solo reported 2,269 TB cases; by March 2026, 405 new cases were detected. Diagnosed patients will receive treatment per Ministry of Health standards, while asymptomatic contacts will be given Tuberculosis Preventive Therapy (TPT). TB transmission occurs via respiratory droplets from coughing, sneezing, or speaking, and environmental factors—damp, poorly ventilated, sun-limited homes—may support bacterial survival. The initiative emphasizes early detection, treatment, and community involvement to reduce transmission and improve cure rates.

triage.headline_ja: 結核患者が依然多く、ソロ保健局が濃厚接触者トレーシングを強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核の継続的な患者報告であるが、急速な国際拡大の兆候は明確でなく、情報が限定的。地域内での対策強化は確認されるが、IHR基準2つ以上の該当またはWPRO基準との組み合わせでシグナル化には至らない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア・ソロ市における既知の結核の継続的発生報告である。濃厚接触者のトレーシングと予防療法の提供は地域レベルの公衆衛生対応を示唆するが、新規の異常な集団発生や国際的拡大の兆候は記載されていない。WPRO基準では長期曝露と流行しやすさに該当するが、事象の異常性や重症度の記載が限定的であり、続報注視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: A Virus From Farmed Seafood Is Causing A New Eye Disease In People
article.articleSummary: CMNV (covert mortality nodavirus), a single-stranded RNA virus first identified in Chinese farmed shrimp (2014), is linked to a new human eye disease: persistent ocular hypertensive viral anterior uveitis (POH-VAU). A March 2026 Nature Microbiology study in 70 patients found viral particles in iris tissue by electron microscopy, with CMNV antibodies in all cases; mouse models reproduced disease after CMNV exposure, showing elevated intraocular pressure and damage to cornea, iris, and retina. Clinically, POH-VAU features keratic precipitates, iris atrophy, recurrent high intraocular pressure, and treatment resistance; about one-third required antiglaucoma surgery, with one case of permanent vision loss. Most patients were 45–70; high risk linked to severe aquatic-animal exposure over two years, including >50% handling seafood bare-handed and 17% consuming raw products; 16% were close contacts, suggesting possible human transmission. Asia shows high CMNV prevalence in seafood (35% shrimp, 40% fish); detections extend to the Americas, Africa, and Antarctica; Chinese markets reported 33–62% positives. Heat inactivates CMNV, but occupational exposure remains the key risk; prior WOAH assessments listing zoonotic risk as None are now outdated.

triage.headline_ja: 養殖水産物からのウイルスが人における新しい眼疾患を引き起こしている
triage.triage_reason: 新規の人獣共通感染症（CMNV由来の眼疾患POH-VAU）で、国際的な水産物汚染（アジア、米国、アフリカ、南極で検出）、人から人への伝播の可能性、臨床的重症性（失明例あり）が示唆され、IHR基準3項目以上、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: CMNV（隠蔽死亡性ノダウイルス）は2014年に中国養殖エビで初同定。2026年3月のNature Microbiology論文で70名患者における新規眼疾患POH-VAU（持続性眼圧上昇性ウイルス性前ブドウ膜炎）と関連付けられた。アジアでの高い普及率（エビ35%、魚40%）、国際的な水産物供給網での広がり、約16%での人から人への伝播可能性の示唆により、国際的なバイオセキュリティ上の懸念あり。ただし、サマリーの記述からは具体的な患者発生地が中国に限定されているため、verified_locationsはChinaのみとした。他地域（スペイン・カナリア諸島など）への言及は検出地点（水産物中のウイルス検出）であり、臨床患者発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ quán bán thịt chó tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog-meat shop owner dies of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death of a 58-year-old dog-meat shop owner in Mỹ Trường, Mỹ Tịnh An, Đồng Tháp Province, Vietnam. On 15 April, N.N.S. was admitted to Tiền Giang General Hospital with dizziness and right-side weakness; initial diagnosis was benign paroxysmal positional vertigo and hypertension. His condition worsened with dysphagia, limb weakness, and later speech impairment, and he developed hydrophobia. He was transferred to Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases on 17 April. Laboratory tests later confirmed rabies virus infection; he died on the evening of 20 April. The patient did not report a dog bite; he kept a 2–3 month-old vaccinated dog with frequent contact and occasional light scratches. He butchered and processed prepared dog meat for sale. Health authorities suspect infection via blood or secretions from contaminated meat entering skin breaks during processing; close contacts are being identified for post-exposure vaccination, and veterinary authorities are tracing the source.

triage.headline_ja: 犬肉販売店主が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡事例であり、人畜共通感染症の動物由来感染を示唆する unusual な感染経路（肉処理時の接触）を含む。死亡事例あり、感染源トレース必要、公衆衛生影響あり。
triage.notes: 感染経路が非典型的（咬傷なし、肉処理時の血液・分泌物接触疑い）であり、食品安全と職業曝露の観点で公衆衛生的価値あり。濃厚接触者の特定と動物源トレースが進行中。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Эксперт ответила, есть ли риск распространения в России оспы обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An expert answered whether there is a risk of monkeypox spreading in Russia.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox poses no risk of wide spread in Russia at present, according to Anna Popova, head of Rospotrebnadzor, who spoke at the opening of the Second Russia–African International Conference on Infectious Diseases in Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo. Russian specialists are collaborating with colleagues in countries with high monkeypox incidence to monitor the situation and potential viral mutations. Russians traveling abroad were previously advised on prevention, notably avoiding contact with animals that may carry the virus, especially rodents and primates. The disease's symptoms include high fever, headache and muscle aches, severe fatigue, swollen lymph nodes, followed by a rash on parts of the body and mucous membranes within one to three days. The article emphasizes surveillance rather than active transmission, with no mention of confirmed cases in Russia.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健当局の専門家が、ロシアへのサル痘感染拡大リスクはないと述べた
triage.triage_reason: サル痘（Mpox Clade I/II）の地域的な懸念があり、複数国での言及と国際的な監視体制が示されているが、ロシアでの確定症例なく、現時点での深刻な公衆衛生脅威や異常な流行の兆候は認められない。情報不足により経過観察対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはロシア連邦が含まれているが、記事サマリーではロシアでの確認症例は報告されておらず、むしろロシアの当局者がブラザヴィルの国際会議でコンゴ民主共和国での発生について言及している構図と読まれる。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Mpox Clade I/IIの複数系統言及は地域的な多様性を示唆しているが、詳細な発生状況や症例数等の具体的情報は記事サマリーに含まれていない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Cientistas usam ultrassom para estourar vírus da influenza A e da COVID-19
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists use ultrasound to burst influenza A and COVID-19 viruses.
article.articleSummary: Researchers at the University of São Paulo (USP), Brazil, report that high-frequency ultrasound fosters resonance acoustic that can inactivate enveloped viruses, including SARS-CoV-2 and H1N1. Published in Scientific Reports, the study shows ultrasound in the 3–20 MHz range couples to the viral envelope, exciting internal vibrations that rupture and deform the envelope, inactivating the virus without harming human cells. The effect is geometry-dependent: spherical enveloped viruses absorb energy more readily and 'pop' under the pulse, whereas other shapes may not. The mechanism does not rely on mutations and variants like Omicron/Delta are not expected to affect efficacy. Not intended for clinical use or decontamination; described as a promising, green antiviral approach since it avoids chemical antivirals and environmental residues. Collaborative work involved IFSC, CRID, FMRP-USP, Unesp groups, and Charles Rice of Rockefeller University providing fluorescent viruses.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者がウルトラサウンドを使用してインフルエンザAおよびCOVID-19ウイルスを破裂させる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症イベント（発生・流行）ではなく、ウイルス不活化技術に関する基礎研究の発表である。実際の患者発生や疫学的脅威を示していない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは São Paulo および Brazil を発生地域として検出したが、記事サマリーを精読すると、これはサンパウロ大学の研究グループによる基礎研究論文（Scientific Reports掲載）の報道であり、実際の感染症イベント（患者集積、流行、アウトブレイク）の発生報告ではない。ウイルス不活化メカニズムの実験室研究であることから、シグナルトリアージの対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Người bán thịt chó tử vong vì bệnh dại, cơ quan chức năng truy vết nguồn lây
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog meat seller dies of rabies; authorities trace the source of infection.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death reported in Dong Thap Province, Vietnam. A 58-year-old man, a dog-meat seller from My Truong Hamlet, My Tinh An Commune, Dong Thap, died after rabies was confirmed by PCR on 20 April. He was hospitalized on 15 April with dizziness and right-sided numbness; by 17 April he developed hydrophobia and difficulty swallowing water and was transferred to Ho Chi Minh City Infectious Diseases Hospital. He died at 20:00 on 20 April. He kept dogs vaccinated within the past year and had frequent scratches from animals; he also purchased dog meat for processing. The infection source remains undetermined. Health authorities are conducting epidemiological investigations, listing contacts for post-exposure vaccination, and coordinating with veterinary services to trace the source and implement control measures. Transmission risk may involve contact with blood or secretions from infected animals via skin breaches.

triage.headline_ja: 犬肉売人が狂犬病で死亡、当局が感染源を追跡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による確定死亡例（PCR確認）が報告されたもので、IHR基準「深刻な公衆衛生影響」と「異常性」に該当。感染源未特定であり、動物由来感染症としての拡大リスクとヒト-ヒト感染リスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病による死亡確定例（2026年4月20日）。感染源未特定により追加的なヒト感染や動物由来感染のリスク存在。患者は犬肉売人で動物との頻繁な接触歴あり。当局による疫学調査と接触者追跡調査が実施中。WPROスクリーニング基準全5項目に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ quán thịt cầy bất ngờ sợ nước, sợ gió rồi tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Civet meat shop owner suddenly afraid of water and wind, then died of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death reported in Dong Thap Province, Vietnam. A 1968-born man, N.N.S., owner of a civet meat shop in Mỹ Tịnh An commune, Đồng Tháp, died after rabies. Onset April 15 with dizziness and right-sided numbness; by April 18–20 he developed altered consciousness, hydrophobia and aerophobia, and refused to eat, dying April 20. PCR at Dong Thap CDC confirmed rabies virus infection; clinical diagnosis noted hypertension and respiratory failure. The patient repeatedly interacted with a 3-month-old dog in the family; the dog was vaccinated against rabies and asymptomatic, but the man was often scratched and played with the animal. Authorities traced close contacts from April 15 onward, providing post-exposure vaccination and monitoring. Local authorities urged those involved in dog-meat trade or recent slaughterhouse activity in Mỹ Tịnh An to contact health services; public health messaging was intensified, and infection sources in animals and slaughterhouses are under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: シベットミート店のオーナーが突然、水と風を恐れ始め、狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 確定死亡例（PCR確認）を含む狂犬病発生であり、IHR基準で異常性・重症度が該当。ベトナムにおける狂犬病死亡例は公衆衛生上重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 狂犬病確定症例（PCR確認）の死亡事例。動物（犬）との直接接触による感染と考えられる。接触者追跡と予防接種が実施されており、動物側の感染源調査も進行中。犬肉・野生動物貿易に関連した継続的な曝露リスクがあるため、WPRO基準で複数該当。

article.articleHeadline: SA's fight against Foot and Mouth Disease bolstered by 2 million vaccine doses from Turkey
article.articleSummary: Two million Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) vaccine doses from Turkey's Dollvet arrive in South Africa, the first tranche of a six-million-dose order as authorities scale vaccination to contain outbreaks and restore export access. Doses, distributed via Dunevax, supplement 4 million delivered since February 2026, enabling about 2.1 million animals to be vaccinated. A further five million doses from Argentina's Biogénesis Bagó are pending SAHPRA approval and will be supplied through Onderstepoort Biological Products. Vaccination is prioritized in KwaZulu-Natal, Eastern Cape, Free State, North West, Gauteng, Mpumalanga, Western Cape, Limpopo and Northern Cape, with targeted allocations for dairy, feedlots and pig production and a 239,000-dose emergency reserve. The goal is WOAH recognition of FMD-free status with vaccination to reopen export markets; improved surveillance supports rapid response. SAT 1 topotype 3 strain is circulating regionally; outbreaks are reported in Europe and Asia-Pacific, including Greece, China, Cyprus, Israel and Germany.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカのFMD対策、トルコから200万用量のワクチン供給で強化
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は家畜感染症で国際的に重大な経済・貿易影響を有し、複数国での同時流行（ギリシャ、キプロス、イスラエル、ドイツ、中国）が報告されている。南アフリカでの大規模ワクチン接種キャンペーンは公開衛生政策上の重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事は南アフリカの口蹄疫対策を主題としているが、対象国リスト内では中国のみが明示的に流行国として記載されている。南アフリカ、トルコ、アルゼンチン、ギリシャ、キプロス、イスラエル、ドイツは対象国リストに含まれていない。口蹄疫は動物感染症だが、国際貿易制限と複数国での同時発生によりシグナルトリアージ価値は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ quán thịt chó tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog Meat Shop Owner Dies from Rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death in Dong Thap Province, Vietnam. A 1968-born dog-meat shop owner, Nguyen Ngoc S., from My Tinh An Commune, Đồng Tháp, died on 20 April after hospital treatment for rabies. He first sought care on 15 April at Tien Giang General Hospital with dizziness and right-sided numbness, was transferred to Ho Chi Minh City’s Tropical Diseases Hospital on 16–17 April where rabies was confirmed. He died at home on 20 April. He kept a 2–3 month-old dog at home (vaccinated, leashed) that occasionally scratched him; the dog remains healthy. He bought pre-processed dog meat for sale from slaughterhouses in Phường Mỹ Tho (Đồng Tháp) and Tây Ninh Province; supplier details and invoices are unclear. Đồng Tháp CDC deems the most likely infection source to be blood and secretions from rabid dog meat, transmitted via skin abrasions. Investigations with veterinary authorities are tracing animal sources and processing facilities, and contacts in the household and hospital are being monitored for vaccination status.

triage.headline_ja: 犬肉店主、狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例であり重症度は高いが、単発の人間感染で限定的な流行リスク、国際拡大リスクは低い。ただし食用動物からの感染という異常性と公衆衛生上の関心から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: IHR基準2つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性）でPICKUP条件を満たすが、WPROスクリーニング基準でも2つ該当している。しかし本事例は単発の死亡例で、持続的な曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）や流行の容易性（epidemic_prone）が限定的であり、管理可能と判断される（接触者監視体制が構築されている）。食用動物からの感染という公衆衛生上の異常性と、ベトナム国内での公的関心の高まりは認められるが、国際的拡大リスクは低い。引き続き情報収集して単発例か拡大兆候かを確認するため、WATCHランクでの経過観察推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis B & C: Preventable Diseases Still Killing Millions Worldwide
article.articleSummary: Advanced liver disease from hepatitis B or C remains widespread worldwide, with many patients presenting late after long asymptomatic periods. Early signs are often absent, so diagnosis is frequently incidental; by the time symptoms appear, fibrosis can have progressed to cirrhosis, liver failure, or cancer. Hepatitis B spreads through blood and body fluids, including mother-to-child transmission; hepatitis C is mainly transmitted via blood exposure from unsafe transfusions, injections, or procedures. A reliable hepatitis B vaccine exists, but adult awareness and vaccination coverage remain inadequate. Hepatitis C now has simpler, effective treatments that can clear infection if identified early. Early testing with a basic blood test enables timely follow-up and treatment, reducing later complications. Prevention hinges on safe medical practices, screened blood, vaccination, and risk-awareness, but gaps in awareness and timely intervention persist. By Dr. Akash Chaudhary, CARE Hospitals, Hyderabad.

triage.headline_ja: B型肝炎とC型肝炎：世界中でなお数百万人を殺している予防可能な疾患
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は予防可能な肝炎疾患の一般的な公衆衛生情報・啓発記事であり、特定の新規感染症アウトブレイク、異常な流行、または急性的な公衆衛生危機を報告していない。疾患負荷の長期的な課題に関する教育的内容であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はハイデラバード（テランガーナ州、インド）の医療機関の医師による一般的な啓発記事であり、新規アウトブレイク、急性感染症危機、異常な流行などを報告していない。既知の慢性感染症の長期的な公衆衛生課題に関する教育的コンテンツであるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Một trường hợp ở Đồng Tháp tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A case in Dong Thap Province dies of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies case in Dong Thap Province, Vietnam: Nguyễn Ngọc Sơn, born 1968, from Mỹ Trường Hamlet, Mỹ Tịnh An Commune, Dong Tháp, sells dog meat. He was hospitalized on 15 April 2026 at Tiền Giang General Hospital with dizziness and weakness, initially diagnosed as neurological disease and hypertension. The illness progressed with hydrophobia and difficulty drinking water. On 17 April 2026 he was transferred to Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases, and rabies virus infection was laboratory-confirmed. He died on 20 April 2026 after family brought him home. Dong Thap CDC notes no dog bite history, but occupational exposure to dog meat could have allowed transmission via blood or secretions entering through skin abrasions. Local authorities conducted contact tracing, offered vaccination to close contacts, and coordinated with veterinary services to trace the infection source from slaughter facilities, with intensified public messaging on risks in handling animals.

triage.headline_ja: ドンタップ省の症例が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでの狂犬病死亡例（確定診断）であり、IHR基準2つ以上に該当。職業的曝露による感染、接触者追跡実施、予防接種対応など公衆衛生対応が実施されており、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: 確定診断された狂犬病死亡例。患者は犬肉販売業従事者で職業的曝露の可能性。咬傷歴なしながら皮膚擦過傷からの血液・分泌物を介した感染と推定。地方当局により接触者追跡、ワクチン接種、獣医サービスとの連携が実施されている。WPRO基準5項目全てに該当。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura intensifica vacinação antirrábica após morcego infectado ser encontrado em Montes Claros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall intensifies rabies vaccination after a rabies-infected bat was found in Montes Claros.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination is being intensified in Montes Claros, Minas Gerais, after an infected bat was found in the Funcionários neighborhood. The drive targets dogs and cats over three months old that have not been vaccinated in the last six months. Vaccination runs 22–24 April, from 8:00 to 16:00, at Praça Champagnat (São Luiz) and Praça Nossa Senhora das Graças / Paróquia São Norberto (Sagrada Família). Rabies is a severe infectious disease caused by Lyssavirus of the Rhabdoviridae family, affecting mammals including humans. Transmission occurs mainly through bites, via saliva, though scratches or licking can also transmit. Almost all infections are fatal, due to encephalitis of the central nervous system. In case of possible exposure, immediately wash the wound with running water and soap, and seek medical care to receive rabies vaccine and immunoglobulin; vaccination has no contraindication.

triage.headline_ja: 感染した動物が発見されたためモンテス・クラロス市が狂犬病ワクチン接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病は高致命率の重篤疾患だが、本事例は単一の感染コウモリの発見に対する予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、ヒト感染例の報告がない。情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ミナスジェライス州モンテス・クラロス市でのコウモリ由来狂犬病検出を報告しています。ヒト感染例は記載されておらず、市当局による予防的なワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されています。狂犬病は動物由来で高致命率ですが、本事例は予防段階です。新規ヒト症例報告時には再評価が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: แพทย์เตือน 'ไวรัสตับอักเสบเอ' มากับอาหาร-น้ำดื่ม แพร่เชื้อง่ายกว่าที่คิด
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn that the Hepatitis A virus is transmitted through food and drinking water, spreading more easily than expected.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A virus (HAV) infection causes hepatitis by destroying liver cells, impairing liver function, according to a gastroenterology professor at Chiang Mai University, Thailand. HAV spreads via ingestion of food or water contaminated with the virus. Common sources include raw or undercooked seafood and other unsanitary foods, as well as fecal-oral transmission from inadequate hand hygiene. The report emphasizes everyday sanitation as a key risk factor and notes that HAV can spread more easily than expected. It calls for safe food handling, clean drinking water, and public awareness to prevent HAV infection in Thailand. The article is based on statements from Thailand's Chiang Mai University medical faculty.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が警告：A型肝炎ウイルスは食べ物・飲料水を通じて感染し、予想より容易に拡散する
triage.triage_reason: タイのチェンマイ地域でA型肝炎の注意喚起報道であり、スクリーニング基準1つ以上該当。ただし、具体的な患者数、死亡例、進行中の流行規模が記載されていない情報不足のため経過観察判定。
triage.notes: 記事はタイの医学教授による食水介してのA型肝炎拡散リスクに関する警告・啓発内容。具体的な現在の患者発生、流行状況、死亡例などの情報が示されていないため、完全なRRA前の段階では経過観察が適切。今後、具体的な患者数増加やアウトブレイク報告があれば再評価推奨。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Новий коронавірус "Цикада"  --  вже в Україні: чим відрізняється та як його лікувати
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New coronavirus 'Cicada' — already in Ukraine: how it differs and how to treat it.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 April 2026, Ukraine reports its first case of the new Omicron subvariant Cicada (BA.3.2) of SARS-CoV-2, detected by the Ministry of Health's Center for Public Health through genomic sequencing. The World Health Organization classifies Cicada as monitored with low public health risk. Symptoms mirror other SARS-CoV-2 infections: runny nose, cough, fever, fatigue, headache, and loss of smell or taste. Vaccination remains the most effective protection against severe disease; individuals with symptoms should seek medical care. Globally, BA.3.2 has been detected in 23 countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, Hong Kong, and Mozambique. CDC reports infections across 25 US states, and wastewater surveillance has identified 132 positive samples. New York data suggest higher positivity in children, possibly due to lower pediatric immunity or immune-evading mutations. Vaccines still work, and continued genomic surveillance is emphasized as COVID-19 remains among common respiratory infections.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルス「シカダ」がウクライナでも検出―特徴と治療方法について
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の新規亜系統（BA.3.2）の検出は公開情報であり、WHOが低公衆衛生リスクと分類している。対象国ではない（Ukraine、US、UK、Mozambique、Hong Kong/China）が、情報不足のため継続監視推奨。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウクライナ、米国、英国、モザンビークが含まれているが、評価対象国（CEPR対象）はChina（香港）のみ。WHO がBA.3.2を「低リスク監視対象」と明示しており、重症度懸念は限定的。ワクチン有効性が維持されている点から深刻度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Flu and rhinovirus activity rises in April: China's disease control authorities
article.articleSummary: Influenza and rhinovirus activity rises in April across China, with authorities warning of heightened risks from dengue fever and chikungunya as May Day travel surges. The National Disease Control and Prevention Administration urged vigilance for mosquito-borne diseases and enteric infections, including norovirus and hand-foot-mouth disease, amid rising mobility. Guangzhou-based expert Zhuang Shilihe noted southern China typically shows influenza peaks in summer and winter, while northern regions peak in winter; spring travel can cause fluctuations, though current levels are lower than last December’s peak. No new pathogens have been identified; vulnerable groups should take protective measures when traveling or in crowds. National Children's Vaccination Day on April 25 underscores vaccination as the most cost-effective protection. China maintains over 90 percent vaccination coverage for age-eligible children, reducing vaccine-preventable diseases to historic lows and eliminating neonatal tetanus; HPV vaccine was added in 2025, with free vaccination for age-eligible girls expanded in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 4月にインフルエンザとライノウイルスの活動が増加：中国の疾病管理当局
triage.triage_reason: 複数の呼吸器・媒介感染症が同時に報告されており、ゴールデンウィーク期間の人口移動に伴うリスクが指摘されているが、現在のレベルは昨年12月のピークより低く、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は中国における季節性のインフルエンザ・ライノウイルス活動の通常の状況説明であり、新型病原体の発見はなく、死亡や重症化の具体的報告もない。公式な警告は出されているが、対策は既存のワクチン接種推奨に基づく標準的な感染対策である。ゴールデンウィーク期間の人口移動に伴う媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア）のリスク言及があるため、続報を注視する価値はある。

article.articleHeadline: Rumah Lembap Tingkatkan Risiko Penularan TBC, Dinkes Solo Tekankan Bahaya Lingkungan Tak Sehat
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Damp Housing Increases TB Transmission Risk, Solo Health Office Emphasizes the Danger of Unhealthy Environments.
article.articleSummary: Surakarta, Indonesia—The City Health Office warns that damp, dark, and poorly ventilated housing increases Tuberculosis (TB) transmission risk, prompting intensified housing-health interventions. During World TB Day at the Jebres subdistrict office on 22 April 2026, Health Department Director Retno Erawati said indoor conditions can sustain TB bacilli, especially where patients live with family members. From January to March 2026, Solo reported 405 TB cases, with about 20% of patients not adhering to their medication; overall adherence sits at roughly 80%. To curb transmission, the city is expanding the Kelurahan Peduli TB program and implementing integrated contact tracing across all districts. Retno emphasized that TB is curable with consistent medication, and adherence is key to treatment success. The initiative aims to accelerate case finding, prevention, and treatment completion across Surakarta.

triage.headline_ja: 湿った住環境が結核の伝播リスクを高める、スラカルタ保健局が不健全な環境の危険性を強調
triage.triage_reason: 結核の既知疾患であり、治療遵守率が約80%と概ね良好な状況。ただし405症例が報告されており、環境因子への取り組みが進行中であるため、進展を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 結核は既知の慢性感染症であり、スラカルタ市では3ヶ月で405症例が報告されている。治療遵守率は80%と良好であるが、貧困層における湿った住環境が持続的な曝露源となっている。WHOの世界結核デー（4月22日）に合わせた啓発活動が実施されており、地域的な取り組みは進行中。IHR基準は2つ以上該当していないが、WPRO基準の「長期曝露」および「流行しやすさ」に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高いため、WATCH判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Preparing For The Next Pandemic: Countries With The Biggest Risks
article.articleSummary: ALLFED’s Risk Analysis study uses a country-level spatial SIR model based on global travel networks and risk measures for emerging infections and high-containment lab leaks (BSL-3+/4) to project the first 30 days of a pandemic. Model outputs indicate infections are most impacted at day 30 in India, the United States, and China for both emerging diseases and lab leaks. For emerging diseases, infections shift from Africa-origin hotspots around day 10 toward the USA, India, and China; for lab leaks, the USA and India start with high leak potential. Wealthy, large countries exert outsized influence on pandemic risk from both sources, highlighting the need for global mitigation and preparedness. triage.headline_ja: 次のパンデミックに備える：最大のリスクを抱える国々
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は仮定的なモデリング研究に基づいた将来予測の論説記事であり、実際の進行中の感染症アウトブレイクを報告していない。現在の実際の公衆衛生危機ではなく、予防・準備に関する分析的な内容である。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術的なモデリング研究（ALLFED）に基づいた仮説的な将来パンデミック予測の論説であり、実際の発生中の感染症イベント報告ではない。COVID-19、ペスト、インフルエンザは言及されているが、これらは現在進行中の実際の流行ではなく、モデル上の予測シナリオの例として使用されているのみである。シグナルトリアージの対象となる実際のアウトブレイク情報ではないため、見送り判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: Появились новые данные о начале пандемии коронавируса
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New data have emerged about the onset of the coronavirus pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Science published a new analysis arguing that a 2021 WeChat post about the Wuhan Huanan Seafood Market contains clues about the origin of SARS-CoV-2, suggesting China did not disclose early animal and human cases. The piece, titled 'A Forgotten Social Media Post May Contain Key Clues to the Origin of COVID-19,' compares the anonymous post’s market maps with official WHO data and identifies three maps never disclosed by Chinese authorities. One map marks four stalls with human infections and two with environmental detections (floor and sewer). It also notes antibodies to SARS-CoV-2 among 17 traders and 18 animals from one stall testing positive. The analysis argues these details would bolster natural zoonosis over lab leak and imply earlier, broader spread. It cites epidemiologist Maria van Kerkhove and CNRS geneticist Florence Debar, and resonates with 2023–2025 assessments favoring zoonotic origin.

triage.headline_ja: 新型コロナウイルスパンデミック発症に関する新たなデータが明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2021年の過去のWeChat投稿に関する学術分析であり、現在の新規感染症イベントではなく、COVID-19の発生源に関する学術的な議論である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去のCOVID-19パンデミック発症に関する学術分析（2021年のWeChat投稿の再検討）であり、現在進行中の新規感染症イベントではない。発生源の議論は疫学的関心を喚起するかもしれないが、シグナルトリアージの対象外。配信日が2026年4月であることに注意（将来日付の記事）。

article.articleHeadline: 美國丹麥爆高致病性H5N1　港暫停進口禽類產品
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreaks of Highly Pathogenic H5N1 in the United States and Denmark; Hong Kong suspends imports of poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza H5N1 outbreaks as of 22 April 2026 have been reported in Guldborgsund Municipality, Denmark, and in Adams County, Indiana, U.S., as well as in Hunterdon County, New Jersey, and Bucks County, Pennsylvania. In response, Hong Kong's Centre for Food Safety suspended imports of poultry meat, poultry products, and eggs from these affected areas to safeguard public health. The Centre has notified Danish and U.S. authorities and will closely monitor updates from the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) and relevant authorities, adjusting measures as local outbreaks evolve. Hong Kong last year imported about 450 tonnes of chilled poultry meat and around 210,000 eggs from Denmark, and about 54,830 tonnes of frozen/chilled poultry meat alongside roughly 4.33 million eggs from the United States. No human case details are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 米国とデンマークで高病原性H5N1が流行　香港は家禽製品の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性鳥インフルエンザH5N1の複数国・複数州での同時多発的な発生であり、国際貿易への直接的な影響（香港による輸入禁止）と国際的な拡大リスクを示唆している。IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはデンマークと米国での鳥インフルエンザ発生を主報していますが、対象国リストに該当するのは香港（中国に含める）のみです。香港が措置を講じた主体として記事に登場しており、WPRO地域への関連性が高い。動物の感染症であるが、食品供給チェーン及び公衆衛生への潜在的影響は顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes gencarkan CKG di Pati guna cegah penularan TB
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health ramps up CKG in Pati to prevent TB transmission.
article.articleSummary: In Pati Regency, Indonesia, the Ministry of Health intensified Free Health Checks (CKG) at 120 sites to curb tuberculosis transmission. Last year, Pati reported 2,658 TB cases, prompting central action. At Kutoharjo Village Hall in Pati District, screening includes health checks and chest X-rays for early TB detection, with the program extending to villages via posyandu and dewan pedukuhan. The national agenda focuses on stunting reduction and TB elimination, offering preventive therapy to those not yet ill and providing immediate treatment to diagnosed patients. A housing renovation program for TB patients living in substandard housing is planned, with 34 houses registered for renovation to improve ventilation and reduce spread. Acting Regent Risma Ardhi Chandra states a re-survey of all TB patients within 10 calendar days, including re-screening of families, and will report results to the Ministry of Health. Cross-sector collaboration remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がパティ県でCKG（無料健康診断）を強化し、結核感染を防止
triage.triage_reason: 結核は既知の感染症であり、記事は地域の予防対策強化を報じているが、新規流行や国際的拡大の危機を示す明確な証拠がない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 結核は周知の疾患であり、記事はインドネシア（パティ県）での既知流行への対策強化を報じている。前年2,658例の報告がある既存流行であり、新規シグナルではない。ただし長期曝露と流行感染性の観点からWPRO基準に該当。政府レベルの対応が確認されているが、国際的な支援必要性や異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Marília elimina focos de dengue em ação na zona Norte - Diário de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marília eliminates dengue hotspots in action in the North Zone - Diário de Notícias
article.articleSummary: Marília, Brazil, targets dengue reduction in the North Zone through Blocking of Breeding Sites. Health agents and veterinary students inspected over 1,000 properties in the Palmital and Castelo Branco neighborhoods, covering 35 blocks. On Saturday (18th), the teams eliminated 11 Aedes aegypti breeding sites. The operation logged 1,064 technical visits with access to 536 properties; others were closed or refused entry. Nineteen agents and University of Marília (Unimar) students participated, aiming to reinforce guidance to residents and merchants during the holiday period. Divisão de Zoonoses notes population engagement is key to sustaining lower infestation. Epidemiological Surveillance Center reports 56 confirmed dengue cases in the city this year, a drop exceeding 99.5% versus the same period last year. For vector information, call (14) 3401-2054.

triage.headline_ja: マリーリア市、北部地域のデング熱対策強化 - 繁殖地の排除活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例数は前年同期比で99.5%以上減少しており、公衆衛生への重大な影響は認められない。記事は予防活動の成功事例であり、IHR基準および社会的関心の観点からもシグナルとして識別される基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・マリーリア市において実施されたデング熱対策キャンペーンの成功を報じたものであり、年間確認症例は56件で前年同期比99.5%以上の減少を達成している。これは疾病の抑制・管理が機能している事例であり、感染症の急速な蔓延や国際的リスク拡大の兆候は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Morte de menina por meningite B em Sinop reacende alerta para vacina de até R$ 800 fora do SUS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a girl from meningitis B in Sinop rekindles warning about a vaccine costing up to R$800 outside the SUS.
article.articleSummary: Death of a girl from meningitis B in Sinop, Brazil, rekindles warnings that vaccines can cost up to R$800 outside the SUS. Brazil’s Unified Health System (SUS) provides seven vaccines for children under 1 year and additional vaccines for high‑risk groups. BCG protects against tuberculous meningitis (birth dose). Meningococcal C conjugate guards against serogroup C meningitis (3, 5, and 12 months). Meningococcal ACWY conjugate covers serogroups A, C, W, Y, with a booster at 11–12 years depending on status. Pneumococcal 10‑valent conjugate prevents invasive pneumococcal disease including meningitis (2 and 4 months; booster at 12 months). Pneumococcal 23‑valent polysaccharide provides protection for indigenous people above 5 years (single dose; special revaccination rules for 60+ institutionalized after 5 years). Pneumococcal 13‑valent conjugate is available at CRIEs for special groups (>5 years: HIV/AIDS, cancer, organ or stem cell transplants). Pentavalent Hib vaccine protects against Hib meningitis with doses at 2, 4, and 6 months.

triage.headline_ja: シノップでB型髄膜炎により女児が死亡、SUS外で最大800レアルの予防接種の警告が再燃
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおける髄膜炎Bによる死亡報告であり、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」および「公衆衛生への影響」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡例）と流行しやすさ（髄膜炎は高感染性）が明確。社会的・政治的関心も高い（ワクチン価格問題を含む）。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのシノップ市におけるB型髄膜炎による死亡事例を主題としており、ブラジル国内での髄膜炎感染症と予防接種プログラムに関する問題を扱っている。対象国リストにブラジルが含まれるため verified_locations に含める。他の報告された疾患（肺炎球菌、インフルエンザ菌）はサマリーの背景情報であり、事例の主体ではない。

article.articleHeadline: म्हशीला रेबीज, ३० जणांना टोचावे लागले इंजेक्शन! प्रकरण ऐकाल तर हादरून जाल
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies in a cow; 30 people had to be given injections! You'll be shocked to hear the case.
article.articleSummary: Rabies from a cow in Gorakhpur district, Uttar Pradesh, prompted anti-rabies injections for 30 people. A cow in Basahni village, Urwa area, was bitten two months earlier by a rabid dog; milk from the cow was consumed by 30 people—15 from Abhay Nath’s family and 15 from Sant Yadav’s family—for two months. On April 16 the cow stopped eating and behaved unusually; veterinary examination confirmed rabies, and the cow died on April 17. Following the death, health workers at Urwa Primary Health Centre administered anti-rabies injections to the exposed individuals to prevent transmission. Officials advised that milk that is properly heated or boiled reduces risk, but those who drank raw milk should seek medical advice. All 30 exposures have completed treatment; the incident has raised concern in the rural community.

triage.headline_ja: 牛の狂犬病；30人が注射を打たれた！この事件を聞いたらショックを受ける
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の動物感染事例で、人への曝露がありますが、既に30人全員が治療を完了しており、現在の継続的な危機は限定的です。情報が部分的で、地域的影響の深刻度と国際的拡大リスクが不明なため、WATCH段階での継続監視が適切です。
triage.notes: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州ゴーラクプル地区での狂犬病事例。動物から人への曝露により30人が治療を受けましたが、全員治療完了。狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染は極めて稀（主に臓器移植時）であり、本事例は局所的な動物関連事象です。継続情報として、類似事例の多発や治療後の症状発生を監視する必要があります。

article.articleHeadline: Lạng Sơn chủ động ngăn dịch lở mồm long móng xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lang Son Proactively Prevents Foot-and-Mouth Disease From Entering
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) SAT1 poses transboundary risk as Lang Son Province, Vietnam, tightens preventive measures after China reported in early April 2026 more than 200 SAT1 infections in cattle in Gansu and Xinjiang. Vietnam vaccines cover serotypes O, A and Asia1 only; SAT1 remains unprotected, increasing outbreak risk via border movement of cattle and animal products. Lang Son authorities implement integrated controls: 24/7 border patrols; veterinary inspections at border gates; vehicle disinfection; strict import-export paperwork; and crackdown on illicit cattle movement. Public outreach emphasizes biosecurity and reporting suspicious activity. The Department of Agriculture and Rural Development urges proactive on-farm surveillance, rapid sampling to identify virus type, and readiness to isolate and eradicate outbreaks, coordinating with markets, police, and other agencies to curb cross-border trade of animals and products.

triage.headline_ja: ラングソン省が口蹄疫の侵入を積極的に予防
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準でも異常性、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の3項目が該当。ベトナムと中国の国境を越えた疾病リスクと既存の予防体制の限界が顕著。
triage.notes: 中国甘粛省とウイグル自治区で2026年4月初旬に200頭以上の口蹄疫SAT1感染が報告。ベトナムの既存ワクチンはO、A、Asia1型のみをカバーしており、SAT1に対する防御がない。国境を越えた家畜移動による高いリスク。ベトナム側の積極的な国境対策が実施されているが、既存ワクチン・防疫体制の根本的な限界がある点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: UK poultry-product imports from bird flu-free regions to resume - BusinessWorld Online
article.articleSummary: UK poultry-product imports from bird flu-free UK regions resume. The Philippines Department of Agriculture approves entry of poultry and other bird products from UK zones certified as free of Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI), after the Bureau of Animal Industry found UK veterinary controls and disease mitigation measures keep contamination risk low in approved areas. Department Circular No. 17 formalizes regionalization, allowing live birds, day-old chicks, hatching eggs, and poultry meat to originate only from UK regions cleared of HPAI. The scheme aims to avoid blanket bans during animal disease outbreaks by restricting restrictions to affected areas, maintaining continuity of supply while protecting the domestic poultry industry. Imports remain subject to current veterinary and food safety requirements and bilateral import conditions. Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel, Jr. highlighted that regionalization strengthens food security by ensuring a steady, safe supply even when outbreaks occur abroad.

triage.headline_ja: 英国から鳥インフルエンザフリー地域の家禽製品輸入を再開
triage.triage_reason: 記事は英国と フィリピン間の家禽製品輸入許可に関する行政通達であり、新たな感染症イベント（ヒト感染確認やアウトブレイク）ではなく、既存の制限解除に関する貿易・規制のニュースです。人への公衆衛生的脅威は記述されていません。
triage.notes: 本記事は鳥インフルエンザ関連の疾患カテゴリが含まれていますが、実質的には英国からのHPAI非検出地域からの家禽製品輸入再開を認める行政通達です。新たなアウトブレイクやヒト感染事例の報告ではなく、既存の疫学的状況を前提とした貿易規制の見直しに関するニュースであるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外です。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD Muncul di Gunung Putri Natuna: Warga Ditelantarkan Jaga Lingkungan dari Jentik Nyamuk - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) cases emerge in Gunung Putri, Natuna District, Kepulauan Riau, with 17 residents infected as of 2026-04-22. Natuna District Health Office (Dinkes) warns dengue must not be taken lightly and urges residents to maintain clean environments to prevent transmission. Frequent rainfall creates breeding sites as Aedes aegypti mosquitoes thrive in clean, stagnant water found in containers such as bathtubs, buckets, flower pots, and discarded items. Authorities stress environmental hygiene as the most effective preventive measure. The 3M strategy—draining water containers, tightly covering water storage, and recycling or repurposing items that can hold water—is emphasized for community-wide reduction of transmission. Residents are advised to routinely drain, cover, or repurpose containers, particularly during daytime hours when mosquitoes are most active. Dinkes monitors the situation and collaborates with local institutions to strengthen prevention and awareness efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ナツナ県グヌン・プトリにおけるデング熱（DBD）患者発生：環境衛生維持と蚊の幼虫対策が急務
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の地域的発生であるが、現在のところ17例の感染が報告されている段階であり、国際的な拡大リスクや重症度に関する具体的情報が不足している。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: インドネシア・ナツナ県（北スマトラ州）におけるデング熱の局地的発生。17例の感染が報告されており、地方保健局が積極的に対応している。デング熱は蚊媒介性疾患であり地域的な流行可能性があるが、現時点では規模や重症度が限定的と考えられる。降雨による蚊の繁殖環境の形成により、今後の拡大の可能性は注視を要する。

article.articleHeadline: বার্ড ফ্লু-র টিকা তৈরি করে ফেলল মডার্না, ইনফ্লুয়েঞ্জার যে কোনও প্রতিরূপকে কাবু করতে পারবে বলে দাবি
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Moderna has developed an avian influenza vaccine, claiming it could defeat any influenza strain.
article.articleSummary: Moderna has developed an avian influenza vaccine (MRNA-1018) that could counter multiple influenza strains, including H5N1. The Phase 3 trials are underway with roughly 1,400 adults, with broader testing planned if results are favorable. Bird flu is highly contagious, spreading among poultry and migratory birds and now infecting humans in several countries, including West Bengal, India. Transmission can occur via sneezing, coughing, saliva, and feces, posing risk to poultry workers, poultry sellers of raw meat, and pet birds that can transmit to people. India has detected two avian influenza strains, H5N1 and H7N9. Moderna claims the vaccine could reduce influenza risk beyond avian strains, and if trials succeed, regulatory approval would be sought soon.

triage.headline_ja: モデルナが鳥インフルエンザワクチンを開発、インフルエンザの任意の変異株に対抗できると主張
triage.triage_reason: インドでの鳥インフルエンザ（H5N1、H7N9）検出は確認されているが、記事の主体はModernaのワクチン開発進捗であり、新規感染症イベントではない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容はModernaのワクチン開発進捗報告であり、インド西ベンガル州での鳥インフルエンザ検出は背景情報として言及されている。H5N1とH7N9の検出実績は記載されているが、新規の感染事例数・重症度などの具体情報は不明。ワクチン開発が進行中である点で公的関心はあるが、これ自体は公衆衛生上の緊急イベントではない。

article.articleHeadline: Врачи предупреждают: в Украину пришел новый штамм COVID
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn: a new COVID-19 strain has arrived in Ukraine.
article.articleSummary: Ukraine has identified for the first time a new SARS-CoV-2 subvariant, BA.3.2, unofficially named “Cicada,” within the Omicron lineage, detected by the Ministry of Health’s Public Health Center during genomic sequencing. The World Health Organization considers this subvariant not to pose a heightened epidemic threat; risk to public health is low and it remains under surveillance. Internationally, Cicada has been detected in several dozen countries, including the United States, United Kingdom, Hong Kong, and Mozambique, with wastewater surveillance confirming circulation in the U.S. Symptoms are typical of COVID-19: fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, fatigue, headache, and loss of smell or taste. Vaccination remains the most effective protection against severe disease. Some studies suggest children may be more susceptible, though adults generally mount stronger responses due to prior immunity; mutations may confer partial immune evasion. No evidence of more severe illness has been found. Emphasizes hygiene and timely medical attention for at-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が警告：ウクライナに新たなCOVID-19株が到来
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の新規亜系統BA.3.2の初検出は異常・予想外だが、WHOが低リスク評価しており重症化の証拠がなく、IHR基準を明確に満たさない。情報不足により経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウクライナが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため verified_locations から除外。中国（香港を含む）のみ対象国のため記載。WHOが低リスク評価し重症化証拠がないことで PICKUP ではなく WATCH 判定。続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Em 2025, hospital de Novo Hamburgo registrou surto de superbactéria; relembre outros casos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In 2025, Novo Hamburgo hospital reported a superbug outbreak; revisit other cases.
article.articleSummary: Multidrug-resistant bacterium detected in the Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) at Hospital Fêmina in Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. Four of 34 NICU patients tested positive; a severely premature newborn died. The outbreak echoes a 2025 pattern of similar incidents: in Novo Hamburgo (August 2025) the hospital was closed for more than two weeks after ICU transmission, with two infected patients (July 11–15) and seven relocations; extensive cleaning and isolation followed. In Brasília, Hospital da Criança de Brasília José Alencar reported a 13-patient NICU outbreak in November 2025; 12 asymptomatic, 1 infected, no deaths, with strict isolation and restricted ICU access. In Amparo, SP, Santa Casa Anna Cintra detected the bacterium in August 2025; four patients were moved to a backup ICU during containment and the main ICU was thoroughly disinfected. GHC notes full isolation, regulator notification, and ongoing care for three other infected newborns who remain stable.

triage.headline_ja: 2025年、ノーボ・ハンブルゴの病院が耐性菌のアウトブレイクを報告。他の事例も回顧
triage.triage_reason: 多剤耐性菌による新生児集中治療室での複数アウトブレイクが報告され、死亡例を含む重症度が高く、複数の医療施設での継続的な感染リスク（prolonged exposure）が認められる。IHR基準およびWPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 疾患は「Unknown Illness」として分類されているが、記事サマリーから多剤耐性菌（superbug/superbacteria）による感染症であることが明確。複数の州（Rio Grande do Sul、São Paulo、Brasília）における2025年の連続的なアウトブレイク（NICU関連）が報告されており、医療施設内感染制御の課題を示唆。新生児死亡例が記録されている。

article.articleHeadline: Em surto epidêmico, estado recebe a 1ª vacina do mundo contra chikungunya produzida no Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid an epidemic outbreak, the state receives the world's first chikungunya vaccine produced in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Amid an epidemic outbreak in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, the first chikungunya vaccine produced by Instituto Butantan is being distributed in a phased rollout totaling 46,500 doses. Dourados will receive 43,500 and Itaporã 3,000, with vaccination planned to begin on 27 April 2026. Anvisa approved the vaccine for adults 18–59 with high exposure risk; contraindications include pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppression, or more than one uncontrolled chronic condition. In clinical trials in the US, 4,000 adults generated 98.9% neutralizing antibodies; results published in The Lancet. The vaccine, approved in Canada, the United Kingdom, and Europe, uses an attenuated-virus platform. Ministry of Health allocated R$28.4 million to expand care capacity in Dourados and region, including 50 Endemic Disease Control Agents for Jaguapiru and Bororó villages. SUS conducted over 2,500 visits and deployed larvicide-disseminating stations to reach difficult-to-reach breeding sites; a Day D and extramural vaccination aim to complete within two.

triage.headline_ja: 流行中のChikungunyaに対応、ブラジル国内初のChikungunya予防ワクチンが配布開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の2基準に該当し、WPRO基準でも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が確認された。ブラジルにおける急性Chikungunya流行の管制対応とワクチン配布という公衆衛生上の重要なイベント。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUSA、Canada、UKが含まれているが、記事サマリーではこれらは臨床試験やワクチン承認国として言及されており、実際のChikungunya流行発生地はBrazilのみである。Mato Grosso do Sul州のDouradosとItaporãが主要な流行地域として明示されている。記事は2026年4月時点の情報であり、流行規模の詳細データは限定的だが、流行宣言と大規模なワクチン配布キャンペーンが実施されていることは確認できる。

article.articleHeadline: Người bán thịt chó tử vong vì bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dog meat seller dies of rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death reported in Dong Thap: Nguyen Ngoc Son, 58, a dog-meat seller, died after a week in hospital with rabies suspected to have been contracted from exposure to saliva/blood from a rabid slaughterhouse animal via skin scratches. On 22 April, Dong Thap CDC confirmed this is the province’s first rabies death this year. He lived alone in My Truong Hamlet, My Tinh An Commune; at home a 2–3 month old dog was vaccinated against rabies and remains alive; no animal rabies infections detected in the area in the past month. He had been traveling to slaughterhouses in My Tho Ward (Dong Thap) and Tay Ninh Province to obtain dog meat. About a week earlier he sought care at Tien Giang General Hospital with dizziness and unilateral weakness, progressed to hydrophobia and dyspnea on drinking water, then transferred to Ho Chi Minh City Tropical Diseases Hospital; rabies confirmed by test, and he died on 20 April. Likely infection source: exposure to rabid animal’s blood/secretions through scratches. Ho Chi Minh City CDC warns of rising rabies risk during hot season; Ho Chi Minh City has recorded three rabies deaths this year, compared with five in the previous year. Rabies is untreatable once symptoms appear; vaccination or rabies immunoglobulin after a bite or scratch is preventive.

triage.headline_ja: 犬肉売人が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで確認された狂犬病死亡例であり、スクリーニング基準（重症度：死亡事例、異常性：職業関連曝露）を複数満たすが、散発的な個別事例であり国際的拡大リスクは低く、情報不足のため。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は発症後治療不可能で致死率が極めて高い疾患だが、本事例は散発的な職業関連曝露による個別死亡例。ベトナムの複数地域（ドンタップ、タイニン、ホーチミン市）での活動が報告されているが、動物への狂犬病感染は検出されていない。地域保健当局による警告は発せられている。国際的拡大リスクは低いと評価される。

article.articleHeadline: पेंटिंग व क्विज के माध्यम से स्वास्थ्यकर्मियों ने दिया मलेरिया मुक्ति का संदेश
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health workers delivered a message of malaria elimination through painting and quizzes.
article.articleSummary: On World Malaria Day, April 25, awareness programs were organized in Lakhisarai district at the Sadar Hospital auditorium, engaging GNMs and para-medical staff. District Vector Borne Disease Officer and Deputy Superintendent Dr. Amit Kumar explained that malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites and spreads through bites of infected female Anopheles mosquitoes, which typically bite at night or in the early morning and evening. The campaign emphasized community participation to control and eradicate malaria, aligned with a World Health Organization initiative. Messages urged families to protect themselves with mosquito nets and embodied the slogans: ‘Malaria-free district is ours; malaria will be eliminated when we all participate,’ and ‘protect your family.’ Health workers used painting, writing, and quiz activities to convey these points, highlighting protection for children and pregnant women, the groups most at risk.

triage.headline_ja: ペインティングとクイズを通じて保健職員がマラリア撲滅のメッセージを発信
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア撲滅の啓発活動報告であり、新規感染症イベントや異常な感染症クラスターの報告ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも該当せず、社会的・政治的関心も一般的な公衆衛生キャンペーンの範囲内である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはWorld Malaria Day（4月25日）を契機とした州立病院での啓発イベントの説明であり、マラリア感染者の発生報告ではない。保健職員がペインティングやクイズを活用して予防啓発活動を行った内容である。公衆衛生上の脅威や新規クラスターの兆候は見られない。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh Whitmore tăng ở Thái Lan, Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo 8 biện pháp phòng chống
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Melioidosis on the rise in Thailand; the Ministry of Health recommends eight preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports 732 Whitmore (Melioidosis) cases and 23 deaths as of 22 April 2026, mostly among farmers exposed to soil and water contaminated with Burkholderia pseudomallei. The bacterium is environmental, inhabiting soil, mud, and surface water; transmission occurs via contact with contaminated soil/mud/water through wounds, inhalation of dust or droplets, or consumption of contaminated water or food. Clinical presentation is diverse, including pneumonia, multi‑organ abscesses, septicemia, and septic shock, with high mortality if untreated. The infection is not typically human‑to‑human. Endemic in Southeast Asia and northern Australia; Vietnam sees sporadic annual cases, often rising after heavy rains and floods. To prevent disease, Vietnam’s Ministry of Health lists eight measures: limit contact with soil/mud/dirty water; wear protective gear; cover wounds and avoid exposure; don’t walk barefoot in wet areas; practice good hygiene; use clean water and safe food; particularly safeguard high‑risk individuals (diabetes, kidney, liver, lung disease, immunodeficiency); seek care promptly if symptoms develop after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: メリオイドーシスがタイで増加、保健省が8つの予防対策を勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。タイでの732症例・23死亡の増加傾向と、東南アジア地域でのエンデミック性から、地域的な感染症動向として注視が必要。
triage.notes: メリオイドーシスは東南アジアのエンデミック疾患だが、タイでの732症例・23死亡の報告と、ベトナムでの散発症例の増加傾向はWPRO地域での重要な監視対象。土壌・水との接触が主な感染経路で、豪雨・洪水後の増加が特徴。ヒト・ヒト感染は稀。オーストラリアは対象国に含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura realiza mutirão e caminhada contra a dengue no Setor Imperial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall carries out a mass campaign and a dengue walk in Setor Imperial.
article.articleSummary: Porto Nacional's Municipal Health Secretariat, with Environment and Infrastructure, launches a mass dengue-control campaign and a dengue-awareness walk on Thursday, April 23, 2026, at 7:30 a.m., beginning at the UBS in Setor Imperial. The integrated mutirão targets elimination of Aedes aegypti breeding sites to curb dengue, Zika, and chikungunya transmission, highlighting community participation. Activities include street roçagem (brush clearing), urban cleaning, and collection of items that can accumulate water (tires, bagged waste), with a dedicated truck to speed removal. The plan also features focal sweeps, technical oversight, and direct guidance to residents. Throughout the day, endemic agents will conduct home visits to identify and eradicate breeding sources and to give prevention tips on eliminating standing water and maintaining clean yards. For questions, residents can visit a nearby UBS or contact the Municipal Health Secretariat.

triage.headline_ja: 市役所がセトール・インペリアルでデング熱対策の一括キャンペーンと啓発ウォークを実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルのポルト・ナシオナル市における計画的なデング熱対策キャンペーン（蚊の繁殖地排除、コミュニティ啓発）の報道であり、新規感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。公衆衛生リスク、異常性、国際的拡大懸念、渡航制限リスクいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は既知感染症（デング熱、ジカ、チクングニア）の予防的コミュニティキャンペーンであり、新規発生やアウトブレイク報告ではない。計画的な公衆衛生活動の報道として判定。

article.articleHeadline: Uzbekistan announces cattle hygiene measures, citing foot-and-mouth outbreaks abroad
article.articleSummary: Uzbekistan on Wednesday announced partial cattle quarantine as part of a national 'cattle hygiene' month, linking measures to foot-and-mouth disease outbreaks in 48 countries during 2025–26. Measures include disinfection facilities in farm areas, restricted access for outsiders, and elimination of infected animals. The move follows reports of a foot-and-mouth outbreak in northwest China and mass culling in Siberia tied to pasteurellosis and rabies, which critics say were excessive. The USDA Foreign Agricultural Service cited local sources suggesting the scale may indicate an unconfirmed FMD outbreak; Russia’s agriculture watchdog denied ongoing risk as of March 25. Kazakhstan banned imports of animal-feed wheat from Russia after the outbreaks. The Siberian culling in the Novosibirsk region sparked rare protests and prompted calls for resignations among top agricultural officials.

triage.headline_ja: ウズベキスタンが口蹄疫の海外発生を理由に家畜衛生対策を発表
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は国際的に重要な動物疾病であり、複数国での発生報告と予防措置が確認されるが、ウズベキスタンでの確認感染ではなく予防的措置であり、詳細情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はウズベキスタンの予防措置を主題とするが、実際の確認感染は northwest China（中国北西部）と Siberia（シベリア、ロシア）での報告である。対象国リストではシベリア（ロシア）は含まれないため、検証済み地域は中国のみ。口蹄疫は48カ国での2025-26年の発生が言及されているが、対象国でのみの検証に限定。ウズベキスタンはIHR基準4つ全て該当するが、記事サマリーに基づく実地発生確認がないため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Balangan Pasang Jebakan Tikus di 25 Rumah Warga Kambiyain, Buntut Temuan Kasus Leptospirosis  - Banjarmasinpost.co.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Balangan Health Office Sets Rat Traps in 25 Homes of Kambiyain Residents Following Leptospirosis Case Findings
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis case identified in Kambiyain village, Tebing Tinggi District, Balangan Regency, South Kalimantan, Indonesia, prompting the Health Office to deploy rodent traps across 25 surrounding homes (two traps per house, inside and outside). On 22 April 2026, a confirmed leptospirosis case was reported in a resident, triggering rapid intervention. Traps are baited with salted fish and will be checked the following day; captured rats will undergo kidney extraction and laboratory testing to detect Leptospira. The move follows a reactive case previously managed at RSUD Datu Kandang Haji. Investigations include environmental hygiene assessment (home former village office with poor sanitation) and the patient’s travel history. Coordination involved Dinas Kesehatan Balangan, Puskesmas Tebing Tinggi, village authorities, Polsek, and Koramil. Some residents work outside Balangan, notably Kotabaru, informing exposure risk.

triage.headline_ja: バランガン保健局がカンビヤイン住民25家屋にネズミ捕獲トラップを設置、レプトスピラ症患者発見を受けて
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南カリマンタン州で確認されたレプトスピラ症患者により、公衆衛生上の対応が既に開始されている。複数地域での発生可能性（患者の外出先がコタバル等）と環境要因（劣悪な衛生環境）を含む異常事象として認識される。IHR基準2つ以上に該当。
triage.notes: インドネシア南カリマンタン州バランガン県テビンティンギ地区カンビヤイン村での確認症例。患者がコタバルなど県外に出かけており、曝露リスク範囲が広がる可能性。劣悪な衛生環境による ネズミによる媒介のリスクが高い。今後の実験室検査結果と追加症例の有無が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados se prepara para campanha de vacinação contra Chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados prepares for a vaccination campaign against Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination campaign begins in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, on 27 April 2026, with a drive‑thru vaccination on 1 May (8:00–12:00) at the City Hall. Led by the Municipal Health Secretariat and the Public Health Emergency Operations Center (COE), the effort covers the Indigenous Reserve and urban areas as part of the Chikungunya Incident Action Plan. Epidemiological bulletin (20 April) reports 4,972 probable cases, 2,074 confirmed, 1,212 discarded, and 2,900 under investigation; eight deaths have occurred, seven among Indigenous Reserve residents. The vaccine, developed by Valneva with Butantan and approved by Anvisa in April 2025, targets adults 18–60 and aims to vaccinate at least 27% (~43,000) of the population. Trials indicate strong immunogenicity with mostly mild to moderate adverse events. Contraindications include pregnancy/breastfeeding, immunosuppression, congenital immunodeficiency, cancer treatment, recent organ transplant, HIV, autoimmune diseases, two or more chronic conditions, or recent chikungunya infection or other vaccines. Transmission is by Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスはチクングニヤに対するワクチン接種キャンペーンの準備を進める
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで確認されたチクングニヤの活動的な流行（4,972例、確定例2,074、8死亡）に対する公式なワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されており、IHR基準の重症度・異常性に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州ドゥラードス市）におけるチクングニヤの活動的な流行と公式なワクチン接種キャンペーンを報告しており、2026年4月時点で確定例2,074、死亡8例（うち7例は先住民保護区）を記録。Valneva/Butantan/Anvisaが開発・承認したワクチンが使用される。HIV感染者はワクチンの禁忌対象とされている。記事はチクングニヤのみを主体としており、HIVはワクチン禁忌情報の文脈でのみ言及されているため、主要疾患はチクングニヤ。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : plus de 1 million d'enfants visés par la campagne de vaccination contre la poliomyélite
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: More than 1 million children targeted by the polio vaccination campaign.
article.articleSummary: Polio vaccination campaign in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo targets 1.4 million children aged 0–59 months in a three-day, door-to-door operation launched April 21 in Bunia. The effort covers 36 health zones across five Ituri territories, aiming for zero unvaccinated children to prevent poliovirus circulation. Governor Johnny Luboya inaugurated the campaign, underscoring universal access and protection for every child, while Marcel Lola Lolawi, head of the Provincial Health Division, confirms the target age group. Despite access and security challenges, including population displacement, health authorities stress that high vaccination coverage is essential to avert a poliomyelitis resurgence in a province with ongoing mobility. Success hinges on reaching children in hard-to-access and rural areas and securing strong community engagement over the campaign period.

triage.headline_ja: イツリ州：ポリオ予防接種キャンペーンで100万人以上の子どもを対象
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのポリオ予防接種キャンペーン報道であり、疾患の実際の発生・流行ではなく公衆衛生対応活動である。ポリオは重要な疾患であるが、本記事は予防的対応で状況を制御中と考えられる。情報不足により詳細なリスク評価ができないため経過観察推奨。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際のポリオ患者発生ではなく、ポリオ予防接種キャンペーン（対応活動）の報道である。記事中に現在のポリオ患者数、死亡者、ウイルス検出に関する具体的情報は記載されていない。セキュリティ上の課題と人口流動性による継続的なリスク言及があるため、背景の疫学状況確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Target Temukan 21.744 Kasus TBC, Gresik Gelar Rontgen Gratis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Target to Detect 21,744 TB Cases, Gresik to Offer Free X-Ray Screenings
article.articleSummary: TB screening campaign in Gresik Regency, Indonesia, offers free chest X-ray screenings at Balai Kelurahan Kroman on 22 April 2026. Coordinated by Stop TB Partnership Indonesia (STPI) Gresik, the effort aims to screen 200 people per day and to detect 21,744 tuberculosis cases in Gresik Regency. In addition to X-ray, participants receive free general health checks to mitigate communicable diseases. TB program lead Lela says SSTB, or systematic TB screening, seeks to curb TB incidence and transmission. Priority groups include individuals at risk of infection, especially those with diabetes or hypertension, and people living with HIV (PLHIV). Those with suspected TB on X-ray will undergo a Mantoux skin test; if positive, treatment proceeds; if negative but at risk or a close contact, TB preventive therapy (TPT) is offered. Transmission is linked to gatherings without masks around TB patients, with most participants having chronic diseases or recent familial TB contact.

triage.headline_ja: 結核症例21,744件の発見を目標、グレシック地域が無料X線検診を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はインドネシア・グレシック地域における結核スクリーニングキャンペーンの実施報告であり、新規感染症アウトブレイク、異常な疾病動向、または急速な国際的拡大の兆候を示していない。公衆衛生上の計画的な予防活動に該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核スクリーニングキャンペーンの実施案内であり、新規のアウトブレイク報告ではない。既知疾患の計画的な予防・検診活動として扱われるべき。シグナルトリアージの対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Fifth Imported Measles Case Confirmed in Colombia: What You Need to Know About the Disease and Public Health Response - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Fifth imported measles case confirmed in Colombia: a 24-year-old woman contracted measles after travel to the United States and is under observation; one initially suspected case linked to flights was ruled out, leaving three under analysis before this fifth confirmation. The WHO reports 2,318 confirmed measles cases in the Americas as of 18 April 2025, with 3 deaths—an 11-fold increase from 2024. Countries affected include Argentina (21), Belize (2), Brazil (5), Canada (1,069), Mexico (421 with one death), and the United States (800 with two deaths). By end-2025, 247,623 measles cases globally in 179 countries; the Americas had 14,891 (32-fold rise from 2024). Colombia warns that upcoming events could raise importation risk and strengthens surveillance and vaccination; Minsalud monitors travelers and coordinates with airports and regional health departments. Measles is airborne and preventable with two doses; more than 22 million children did not receive the first dose in 2023.

triage.headline_ja: コロンビアで第5例の輸入麻疹を確認：疾病と公衆衛生対応について知るべきこと
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で4項目該当（異常性、重症度、流行リスク、管理能力）。2025年のアメリカ大陸での麻疹症例数が大幅増加（11倍）し、複数国での確認と死亡報告あり。
triage.notes: 記事はコロンビアの麻疹輸入症例を主題としているが、コロンビアは対象国リストに含まれていない。記事本文内で具体的に症例数が報告されている対象国はブラジル（5例）のみ。米国で800例と最多数報告されているが、米国も対象国リストに含まれていない。アメリカ大陸全域での流行拡大の文脈において、対象国内での確認状況の継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde de Criciúma alerta para aumento de casos gripais que podem causar síndrome respiratória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Criciúma Health Department warns of an increase in flu-like cases that could lead to respiratory syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Criciúma, Brazil, health authorities warn of rising flu-like syndromes that could progress to Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG). The municipal health department promotes influenza vaccination as the primary preventive measure, noting the trivalent vaccine protects against influenza A (H1N1, H3N2) and influenza B, and is available for priority groups in municipal vaccination clinics. More than 20,000 doses have been administered so far, targeting children aged 6 months to under 6 years, adults over 60, pregnant women, and other high-risk individuals. People with mild symptoms—nasal discharge, cough, sore throat, and low fever—should seek care at the nearest Basic Health Unit (UBS); more serious cases should go to urgent care centers, emergency departments, or hospitals. Emphasized hygiene and cough etiquette, including frequent handwashing and covering coughs or sneezes, to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: クリシウマ保健局が呼吸器症候群に進行する可能性のある流感様症例の増加について警告
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの地方都市での季節性インフルエンザの増加報告だが、公開情報が限定的で重症度や流行規模の詳細が不明。国内での管理体制は整備されており、国際的リスクも現時点では低い。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国（GeoNames ID 3469034）に含まれるが、WPROスクリーニング基準は2つ該当（長期曝露と流行しやすさ）するものの、IHR基準は0個該当。季節性インフルエンザの定期的な警報であり、管理可能性は高い。社会的関心は地方レベルに留まっている可能性が高い。追加情報（患者数、死亡件数、確定診断数）が得られれば判定の精緻化が可能。

article.articleHeadline: Russia offers to help fight mysterious disease in Africa  --  RT Africa
article.articleSummary: Burundi faces an unknown outbreak in the north with 35 cases and at least 5 deaths in Mpanda district. Symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, hematuria, fatigue, and jaundice; WHO reports negative lab tests for Ebola, Marburg, and other known pathogens, with investigations ongoing. Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor offered assistance to Burundi and announced plans for a new epidemiology and infection prevention center in the Republic of the Congo, following a 2023 sanitary cooperation agreement; the memorandum was signed by Rospotrebnadzor head Anna Popova and Congo health minister Jean-Rosaire Ibara. Moscow has expanded Africa health cooperation, including training Ugandan personnel, supplying Burkina Faso with a mobile lab capable of 800 tests/day, and aiding Rwanda, DRC, Guinea, and Ethiopia during mpox outbreaks, amid mpox concerns across parts of Africa and other West/Central African outbreaks noted in the context.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、アフリカの謎の病気との戦いを支援することを申し出る
triage.triage_reason: ブルンジで原因不明の新規アウトブレイク（35例、5死亡）が報告され、症状がウイルス性出血熱を示唆している。複数の既知病原体が除外されているが、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的関心の高さから、フルRRAが必要。
