triage.notes: 記事では複数アフリカ諸国がウイルス性出血熱に関連して記載されているが、現在のアウトブレイク主体はブルンジの原因不明疾患。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCとブルンジのみ。WHOが既知病原体を除外しており、原因特定が急務。ロシアとアフリカ各国の協力拡大が地政学的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Menina de 8 anos morre após complicações da dengue em MT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An eight-year-old girl dies after dengue fever complications in Mato Grosso.
article.articleSummary: Eight-year-old Ana Júlia Lacerda Queiroz died from dengue complications in Barra do Garças, Mato Grosso, Brazil. She developed symptoms four days before admission and went to a UPA on Sunday, April 19, with abdominal pain, fever and vomiting; a dengue antigen test was positive. Worsening condition led to transfer on Monday, April 20 to the Hospital Municipal Milton Pessoa Morbeck, with chest pain, myalgia and abdominal pain, no bleeding. She died in the early hours of Tuesday, April 21. The municipality reports 448 dengue cases, plus 3 chikungunya and 4 Zika since January. A decree mandates cleaning of lots by April 30, with fines and municipal work charged to owners; 93 fines have been issued in high-risk areas. A Dia D vaccination campaign against influenza, with dengue vaccine available, is planned for Saturday, April 25 at all UBS units.

triage.headline_ja: マット州でデング熱の合併症により8歳の少女が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでデング熱による小児死亡が報告されており、重症度基準（死亡例）とIHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性）を満たす。また複数の蚊媒介感染症（チクングニア、ジカ熱も同地域で報告）が同時に流行中である。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国ではないが、IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響と異常性）、かつ蚊媒介疾患複合流行（デング、チクングニア、ジカ）による重症例（死亡）報告であり、シグナルとしてピックアップが適切。地方政府による対応措置（蚊対策令、ワクチン接種キャンペーン）も進行中。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค โต้ข่าว 'โรงงานชลบุรี' สาเหตุแพร่เชื้อไวรัสตับอักเสบเอ ย้ำยังหาที่มาไม่พบ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control refutes rumors about the 'Chonburi factory' as the source of hepatitis A transmission, reiterating that no source has yet been found.
article.articleSummary: Hepatitis A outbreaks are ongoing in Thailand’s eastern region, with cases across several provinces and a concentration in Chonburi. Patients aged 5–67 include day laborers and company workers; no clustered outbreaks reported. Rumors linking a particular factory as the source have been refuted. After cases were observed in the factory, authorities expanded proactive case finding, but there is currently no confirmed source. A joint investigation has collected 20 samples from the factory—water, ice, food, and environmental specimens—testing negative for hepatitis A virus. Investigations continue in the factory and surrounding communities to identify connections and assess risks related to food, drinking water, hygiene, and the environment, informing control measures. Public guidance emphasizes cooking foods thoroughly, keeping hot, practicing hand hygiene, and seeking medical care for fever, fatigue, nausea, or jaundice; contact 1422 for information.

triage.headline_ja: タイ疾病管理局が『チョンブリ工場』がA型肝炎ウイルス感染源であるという報道に反論、感染源がまだ特定されていないことを強調
triage.triage_reason: タイ東部地域でのA型肝炎集団発生は異常で、複数省での患者発生と5～67歳の多様な患者構成が確認されている。しかし、感染源が特定されておらず、情報が不完全である。
triage.notes: 複数省での散発的なA型肝炎患者が報告されており、感染源が確定されていない点が懸念される。工場内の環境検体はウイルス陰性だが、引き続き調査が進行中。重症度や死亡率に関する具体的情報が記事に含まれていないため、WATCH判定とした。続報で患者数、重症度、確定感染源情報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 水痘进入"好发期"！传染性强，2剂疫苗是关键
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chickenpox has entered its peak incidence period! It is highly contagious; two-dose vaccination is key.
article.articleSummary: Chickenpox (varicella) is at peak incidence in China, with highly contagious spread. One-dose vaccination provides about 85% protection; completing a two-dose schedule raises protection to over 99%, markedly reducing infection risk. Immunity after one dose wanes within 2–5 years; two doses confer longer-lasting immune memory and protection lasting decades. National vaccine adverse reaction surveillance shows varicella vaccination has a favorable safety profile; adverse events are within expected range, mainly transient fever and local rashes that largely resolve. Beijing’s two-dose policy indicates second-dose adverse reactions are lower than first-dose, supporting improved safety. These findings reinforce the importance of two-dose vaccination to achieve durable protection during peak activity.

triage.headline_ja: 水痘が「好発期」に入った！伝染性が強く、2回接種ワクチンが鍵
triage.triage_reason: 記事は水痘の季節的な流行ピーク到来とワクチンの有効性に関する一般的な情報提供記事であり、異常な発生状況、重症化、国際的拡大のリスク、管理困難性などの警告兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国での水痘の季節的流行に関する予防啓発記事である。ワクチン政策と予防措置の重要性を強調する教育的コンテンツであり、突発的な感染症クラスタ発生、制御不能な流行、または国際的懸念を示唆する兆候はない。シグナルレベルのイベントではなく、通常の公衆衛生情報である。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Lagoinha confirma mortes de duas pessoas por febre amarela
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lagoinha City Hall Confirms Two Deaths from Yellow Fever.
article.articleSummary: Two people died of yellow fever in Lagoinha, São Paulo, Brazil, with a third patient hospitalized under investigation, per the municipal epidemiological bulletin. The fatalities occurred in rural Santa Rita (April 3) and Canta Galo (April 12); both were unvaccinated. Lagoinha authorities extended vaccination hours to 7:00–19:00 on weekdays and will intensify outreach during Saturday's Health in the Square event on April 25. Separately, the São Paulo State Health Department reported the state's first yellow fever death of 2026 in Cunha on April 16, a 38-year-old man. Two Cruzeiro cases (a 23-year-old woman and a 52-year-old man) recovered. Yellow fever is viral, transmitted by Aedes aegypti and not person-to-person. Vaccination guidance: routine childhood doses (9 months with a 4-year booster) and a single-dose recommendation for those 5–59 without vaccination; verify prior campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴイニャ市庁舎、黄熱病による2人の死亡を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのサンパウロ州で黄熱病による死亡が確認され、IHR基準3項目（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。ワクチン接種拡大と州レベルの公衆衛生対応が実施されており、シグナルとしてのピックアップが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブラジル（対象国リストに含む）のサンパウロ州における黄熱病の死亡事例を主題としている。複数の死亡例（ラゴイニャで2人、クーニャで1人）が確認され、未接種者が罹患している点が懸念要因。媒介蚊（ネッデスエジプト蚊）の存在と農村部での流行の可能性から、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。フルRRA実施が必要。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: La Côte d'Ivoire de nouveau confrontée à la grippe aviaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ivory Coast Once Again Facing Avian Influenza
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza A(H5N1) outbreak in Ivory Coast at a poultry farm in Koun-Fao, Gontougo region, central-eastern Côte d'Ivoire near the Ghana border. The World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) reported on April 6 that the highly pathogenic H5N1 strain has killed about 95,000 poultry; the origin of the outbreak remains unknown. The report provides no details on human infections, containment measures, or surveillance actions. This marks a significant poultry sector event in Côte d'Ivoire, underscoring the risk of spread near international borders and the ongoing challenge of controlling highly pathogenic avian influenza in West Africa. As of 2026-04-22, this remains the latest reported outbreak; no human infection data is provided.

triage.headline_ja: コートジボワール、再び鳥インフルエンザに直面
triage.triage_reason: 高病原性H5N1の家きん農場での大規模発生（約95,000羽死亡）であり、西アフリカ地域での懸念事項であるが、人への感染報告がなく、公衆衛生への直接的な深刻度や国際的ヒト-ヒト感染リスクについては現時点で明確でない。続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコートジボワール（Côte d'Ivoire）での発生を述べているが、対象国リスト内ではガーナ（Ghana）のみが該当。記事にガーナとの国境近くでの発生と明記されているため、ガーナを verified_locations に含める。人への感染報告がないため、IHR基準の「重症度」や「国際的拡大」については判定困難。動物への影響カテゴリで報告されており、畜産セクターへの重大影響が示唆されるが、人的ヘルスセキュリティへの直接的脅威の詳細情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Bireuen Siaga Rabies, Lintas Sektor Sepakati Langkah Penanganan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bireuen on Rabies Alert, Intersectoral Stakeholders Agree on Response Measures.
article.articleSummary: Rabies alert in Bireuen Regency, Aceh, Indonesia: four animal-bite cases (GHPR) reported since 2025 through March 2026 in Kota Juang, Juli, and Jeumpa. On 21 April 2026, intersectoral stakeholders held a coordination meeting to implement an integrated response. Major measures include vaccination campaigns, a Rabies Center, and integrated bite-management linking puskeswan and puskesmas; enhanced public education; dog owner and hunting-group involvement for surveillance; regulation via local qanun on rabies control; and village-level circulars to raise awareness. Strengthened cross-agency collaboration among Dinas Peternakan Aceh, Dinas Kesehatan Bireuen, Dinas Lingkungan Hidup, and Dinas Pemberdayaan Masyarakat dan Gampong; funding for vaccination and operations; enhanced surveillance and epidemiological analysis; rapid response to suspected rabies in animals; and monitoring inter-district animal movement. Aim: protect communities and achieve a rabies-free Bireuen.

triage.headline_ja: ビルン地域が狂犬病警戒態勢、セクター横断的なステークホルダーが対応措置に合意
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのアチェ州ビルン県で狂犬病アラートが発令され、2025年以来4件の咬傷事例が報告されている。当局による統合的な対応体制が構築されており、管理可能性が比較的高いと考えられるが、引き続き情報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドネシア・アチェ州ビルン県における狂犬病アラートについて記述。4件の咬傷事例は2025年以来のもので、当局は予防接種キャンペーン、狂犬病センター設置、統合咬傷管理等の対応を実施中。セクター横断的な協力体制が整備されており、地域レベルでの管理対応が進行中であるため、WPRO基準3項目該当（異常性、持続的曝露、流行性）するが、死亡報告はなく重症度は不明。情報追加に際しては、実際の死亡例や症例増加の有無、他地域への拡大可能性に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: A bat coronavirus can enter human cells through a previously unknown gateway
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-22, alphacoronaviruses in bats can enter human cells via a previously unknown gateway. Gallo et al. computationally selected 27 spike proteins from >2,700 sequences, made pseudoviruses, and screened against known receptors. Most bat-derived spikes could not use established receptors; only two bound bat APN but not human APN, indicating ACE2/APN entry is rare for alphacoronaviruses. A Kenyan bat-derived spike enabled infection of human cells independent of ACE2/APN, pointing to an alternative receptor. A large-scale screen of hundreds of human surface proteins identified three CEACAM family candidates; expression of CEACAM6 rendered cells susceptible, with the spike’s receptor-binding domain engaging CEACAM6’s IgV-like domain at the N-terminus. This mirrors, though distinct, a murine hepatitis virus strategy targeting CEACAM1a IgV. Additional strains from Kenya, Russia, and China used CEACAM6 with varying efficiency; serology from nearby populations over two decades showed no clear spillover, suggesting real-world transmission remains limited.

triage.headline_ja: コウモリコロナウイルスが未知の経路を通じてヒト細胞に侵入できる
triage.triage_reason: 基礎研究成果に基づく理論的リスク評価であり、実際のヒト感染症の流行や公衆衛生危機の証拠がない。ケニア、ロシア、中国のコウモリ由来スパイクの検討が含まれるが、血清学的調査で明確なスピルオーバーが示されていない点が重要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは Nature 誌の査読済み論文報告であり、基礎研究としての価値は高い。ただしケニア、ロシア、中国のコウモリから採取されたコロナウイルスに関する計算機スクリーニングおよび in vitro 実験の知見であり、実際のヒト感染症例や流行の報告ではない。20年間にわたる血清学的調査で明確なスピルオーバーが検出されていないことは、現実世界での伝播リスクが限定的であることを示唆している。したがって公衆衛生上の直近の危機ではなく、病原体監視と将来のリスク認識の観点から経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Wamenkes tinjau ACF TB di Blora
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deputy Health Minister Reviews TB Active Case Finding in Blora.
article.articleSummary: In Blora, Central Java, Indonesia, Deputy Health Minister Dr. Benjamin Paulus Octavianus reviewed Active Case Finding for Tuberculosis (TB) integrated with the Free Health Check program (CKG) in Desa Tunjungan. He emphasized six-month TB treatment and preventive therapy (TPT) for close contacts to break transmission, with all cases followed by contact tracing. From 1,600 TB cases, about 6,000 people are projected to need screening. Blora Regent Arief Rohman noted TB as an ongoing challenge: 2024 had 1,485 cases, 2025: 1,676, and by 2026 about 350 cases were identified. Integration with free services has boosted case finding and awareness, but challenges remain in public awareness and service reach. Continued promotive and preventive efforts are needed to move Blora toward TB elimination.

triage.headline_ja: 保健副大臣がブロラにおける結核の能動的患者発見（ACF）を視察
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの結核ケースに関する公式視察の報道であり、IHR基準に該当しない。ただし結核は依然として公衆衛生上の関心対象であるため、継続的な監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はブロラ（中央ジャワ州）での結核能動的患者発見（ACF）プログラムの視察を報道しており、保健副大臣の公式訪問である。症例数の増加傾向（2024年1,485件、2025年1,676件）が記載されているが、これは既知の流行地域での継続的な管理状況である。IHR基準の『異常性』や『国際的拡大リスク』には該当しないため、フルRRA対象とはしない。ただし結核は継続的な公衆衛生関心事項であり、進展状況の経過観察が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Past Tuberculosis Diagnosis Linked to Increased Long-Term Mortality Risk for Up to 14 Years, Global Prevention Urgently Needed - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Past tuberculosis diagnosis is linked with increased long-term mortality risk up to 14 years, across multiple organ systems, in a Brazil-based cohort. A Nature Medicine study using Brazil's 100 Million database (2004–2018) compared 185,921 individuals diagnosed with TB and 111,871 TB-free controls. Mortality from natural causes over 14 years was 2.16 times higher in those with TB; among those who completed treatment, risk remained 1.77 times higher. Elevated deaths were observed for cancer, cardiovascular disease, endocrine disorders, respiratory conditions, and external causes, with respiratory deaths peaking early: one-year relative risk 6.15 in the treated group. Findings support long-term monitoring of TB survivors, including lung function and cardiovascular screenings, to mitigate ongoing burden. Global context: about 10.8 million new TB cases and 1.25 million deaths in 2023. The study underscores the need for prevention and post-treatment care within public health strategies in Brazil and worldwide.

triage.headline_ja: 過去の結核診断が14年間の長期死亡リスク上昇と関連、グローバルな予防が緊急に必要
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの過去の疫学データ分析に基づく予後研究であり、新規感染症イベント・アウトブレイク発生を報告するものではない。オピニオン記事・啓発記事として分類され、急性の公衆衛生上の危機を示さない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去の結核患者の長期予後に関する疫学研究論文の紹介記事である。新規イベント、アウトブレイク、または急性的な感染症危機を報告していない。結核は既知の慢性疾患であり、本記事は医療啓発・予防推進の文脈に位置づけられる。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Chuvas e alagamentos aumentam risco de doenças em Fortaleza; saiba os cuidados necessários
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rain and Flooding Increase the Risk of Diseases in Fortaleza; Learn the Necessary Precautions.
article.articleSummary: Fortaleza and its metropolitan region are experiencing heavy rains and flooding increasing exposure to infectious diseases. Frequent contact with flooded, contaminated water and growing mosquito breeding sites heighten illness risk. Health professionals highlight leptospirosis, acquired from contact with water contaminated by rat urine, and hepatitis A, transmitted via contaminated water or food. Dengue, chikungunya, and Zika—transmitted by Aedes aegypti—may rise in flood-affected areas. The situation is exemplified in neighborhoods such as Conjunto Tancredo Neves, where residents traverse standing water daily. Preventive measures emphasize avoiding direct contact with floodwaters, preventing water stagnation, proper waste management, safe food and water handling, and thorough produce cleaning. Individuals should seek medical care promptly for fever, malaise, body pains, vomiting, or diarrhea, at a health unit, UPA (emergency care unit), or a basic health post to ensure appropriate evaluation and guidance.

triage.headline_ja: フォルタレーザでの豪雨と洪水により疾病リスク増加；必要な対策を確認
triage.triage_reason: 複数の水関連感染症（レプトスピラ症、A型肝炎、デング熱、チクングニア熱）がブラジル・フォルタレーザの洪水で増加しているが、現時点では具体的な患者数や重症度が記載されておらず、情報が限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事は豪雨・洪水による水関連感染症リスクの増加を報じているが、確定患者数、死亡者数、流行の段階については記載されていない。複数の感染症が同時に増加リスクを示しており、特にベクター媒介性疾患（デング、チクングニア）と水系感染症（レプトスピラ症、A型肝炎）の並行リスクが注目される。今後の患者数増加報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: China confirma foco de aftosa e abates na Rússia elevam alerta no mercado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China confirms foot-and-mouth disease outbreak, and slaughterings in Russia raise market alert.
article.articleSummary: China confirms a foot-and-mouth disease outbreak in its northwest near the Russian border, with a highly contagious strain triggering culling, area disinfection, and tighter border controls on cattle movement. Russia has not officially confirmed FMD; authorities attribute fatalities to diseases such as pasteurellosis, but more than 90,000 cattle have been slaughtered since February across regions, heavily in Siberia, fueling market doubts about the true scope. Regional trade restrictions have begun as buyers reassess risk. The episode matters for markets because Russia was recently recognized by the OIE as foot-and-mouth disease free, a key export condition, amplifying concerns about price volatility and redirected trade flows. Brazil enters the spotlight as the world’s largest beef exporter (over 3 million tonnes exported annually) and a major supplier to China and other markets, while producing about 10 million tonnes. Brazil remains FMD-free since 2006, maintained by surveillance, traceability, and border controls; global sanitary unrest can influence prices and demand, highlighting animal health as a competitive asset.

triage.headline_ja: 中国が口蹄疫の発生を確認、ロシアでの殺処分が市場警戒を高める
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫（FMD）は家畜に影響を与える重要な動物疾病であり、中国とロシアでの複数国での発生・疑いが報告されている。国際的な貿易・市場への影響が顕著であり、OIE認定国ステータスの変化に関わる事案として国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、中国が口蹄疫の発生を確認し、ロシアでも疑いのある大規模な殺処分が報告されている。ロシアはOIE認定の清浄国であり、その地位変化は国際貿易に重大な影響を及ぼす。ブラジルは2006年以降清浄国として言及されており、グローバルな動物衛生環境の不安定化により市場が影響を受けている。複数国での発生疑い、国際貿易制限の開始、市場価格への影響など、経済的・政治的影響が大きい事案。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya: Dourados decreta calamidade; vacinação começa segunda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya: Dourados declares calamity; vaccination begins Monday.
article.articleSummary: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, declared a 90-day public health calamity as chikungunya, an Aedes aegypti-transmitted arbovirus, spreads from the Indigenous Reserve of Dourados into urban neighborhoods. Since March 20, emergency decrees guide a COE-coordinated response for both the reserve and the city. The municipality reports a critical epidemiological scenario with more than 6,186 probable cases and a 64.9% positivity rate, along with hospital bed occupancy at about 110%, indicating strained healthcare capacity. A vaccination campaign is scheduled to start Monday, April 27, 2026, after the first vaccine shipment arrived April 17. Vaccination is limited to adults 18–59; eligibility requires health assessment and adherence to contraindications (pregnancy or lactation, immunosuppression, certain chronic diseases, recent chikungunya, or recent vaccines). The drive-thru vaccination is planned for May 1, 2026. As of March 20, 2026, Dourados had 4,972 probable cases, 2,074 confirmed, 1,212 discarded, 2,900 under investigation, and eight chikungunya deaths (seven in the Indigenous Reserve).

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア：ドゥラードスが災害を宣言、ワクチン接種は月曜日に開始
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な拡大、国際的な関心の可能性）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。ブラジル国内での大規模流行で死亡例があり、医療キャパシティ逼迫状況。
triage.notes: チクングニアの局地的な大規模流行。ドゥラードスでは6,186件の疑い患者、死亡8件、入院率110%超の医療逼迫。先住民地区から都市部への感染拡大。ワクチン接種キャンペーン開始。ブラジルは対象国外だが、IHR通知基準とWPRO全スクリーニング基準を満たすため、フルRRA進展の価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados decreta calamidade pública por epidemia de chikungunya - News Rondônia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados Declares a Public Calamity Due to Chikungunya Epidemic - News Rondônia
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, prompts a 90-day public calamity declaration as of April 22, 2026. The crisis extends from the Indigenous Reserve into urban neighborhoods, with a 64.9% test positivity rate and hospital occupancy at 110%, straining care for severe cases. Dourados reports 6,186 probable chikungunya cases and eight deaths. The federal Ministry of Health has released 900,000 reais for vector surveillance and Aedes aegypti control. A vaccination campaign begins Monday, April 27, targeting 18–60-year-olds, aiming to inoculate 43,000 people; the vaccine, approved by Anvisa in 2025, carries restrictions for pregnant individuals, immunosuppressed, and those with chronic diseases such as diabetes and hypertension. Vaccination will occur in standard vaccination rooms and Indigenous health units; a drive-thru site at the Paço Municipal courtyard is planned for May 1. Dourados is among 20 municipalities selected to receive initial doses due to high risk and virus circulation.

triage.headline_ja: ドウラードス市、チクングニア流行に対する公衆衛生上の災害を宣言
triage.triage_reason: チクングニアの大規模流行で公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、死亡報告があり、IHR基準で複数該当。また重症度が高く（病院占有率110%）、ブラジル国内での対応が進行中であり、地域内での継続的な拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: ブラジル・マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州ドウラードス市でのチクングニア流行。公式な公衆衛生上の災害宣言、8件の死亡報告、6,186件の確定/推定患者数、64.9%の検査陽性率、病院占有率110%と深刻な状況。ワクチン接種キャンペーン開始予定（4月27日）。複数のIHR基準および全てのWPRO基準に該当する重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados decreta calamidade por epidemia de chikungunya e inicia vacinação - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados decrees a state of calamity due to a Chikungunya epidemic and begins vaccination
article.articleSummary: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, declares a public health state of calamity amid a chikungunya epidemic. The municipal system reports 6,186 probable cases with a 64.9% positivity rate; by May 20, 2026, 2,074 were laboratory-confirmed, 1,212 discarded, and 2,900 under investigation. Eight fatalities due to chikungunya complications are confirmed, seven in the Dourados Indigenous Reserve. Hospital bed occupancy sits around 110%, signaling strained capacity. A vaccination campaign for adults 18–59 begins Monday, April 27, with the first doses arriving May 17. Nursing staff training is planned for May 22–23 to assess contraindications (pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppressants, immunodeficiencies, recent cancer therapy, transplants, HIV/AIDS, autoimmune diseases, chronic comorbidities). Exclusions include recent chikungunya (30 days), severe febrile illness, or recent vaccines (live attenuated 28 days, inactivated 14 days). Target vaccination is at least 27% of the ~43,000 eligible, aided by a drive-through on May 1. Emergency funding of R$900,000 supports surveillance and Aedes aegypti control; Anvisa-approved chikungunya vaccine will be used in about 20 municipalities across six states.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスがチクングニア流行による災害状態を宣言し、予防接種を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル南部でチクングニア流行による公衆衛生上の重大事象。6,186件の患者、8件の死亡が確認され、病院ベッド占有率110%と医療負荷が深刻。IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準4項目該当。
triage.notes: ドゥラードス市は災害状態（state of calamity）を宣言。確定例2,074件、死亡8件（先住民地域で7件）。病院ベッド占有率110%で医療逼迫状態。複数州にわたる広がりの可能性あり。チクングニア予防接種キャンペーン実施中。記事ではHIV言及は除外基準として登場のみで、流行主体はチクングニア。

article.articleHeadline: Morte de adolescente por gripe K alerta para vacinação contra doenças respiratórias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a teenager from Influenza K highlights vaccination against respiratory diseases.
article.articleSummary: Death of a 17-year-old girl from Influenza K in the Federal District raises concerns about rising respiratory diseases in Brazil’s DF. The Health Secretariat confirmed the sixth influenza K case in the region, amid alerts across 15 states and the Federal District for severe acute respiratory syndromes. Vaccination coverage among priority groups stands at 35%, far below the 90% target, with ongoing vaccination campaign through May 30. Most severe cases have occurred in children under 10 years old. The report underscores the need to boost immunization and surveillance to curb hospitalizations and fatalities associated with Influenza K under the current outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザK感染による少女の死亡、呼吸器疾患への予防接種の必要性を強調
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザKによる死亡例の報告、複数州での症例多発、予防接種率が目標値を大きく下回る状況がWPRO基準（重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性）を満たす。また社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: インフルエンザKは既知のインフルエンザ亜型ではなく、新興株または報告誤りの可能性がある。15州およびFederal District全域での急性呼吸器症候群警報発令、予防接種カバー率35%（目標90%）、10歳以下での重症化が多いという点から、地域的な流行管理上の懸念が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura inicia no dia 27 de abril campanha de vacinação contra Chikungunya - A Tribuna News - Notícias de Campo Grande-MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall launches Chikungunya vaccination campaign on April 27 - A Tribuna News - News from Campo Grande, MS
article.articleSummary: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, launches a Chikungunya vaccination campaign on April 27 under the city’s Public Health Emergency Operations Center, targeting the Indigenous Reserve and urban areas. Doses arrived on April 17; staff training occurred April 22–23; doses were distributed to vaccination sites on April 24; rollout starts April 27, with a drive-thru vaccination planned for May 1 at City Hall. Vaccination is limited to ages 18–59 per Anvisa rules; contraindications include pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppression, HIV, organ transplants, cancer treatment, and several chronic diseases. The goal is to vaccinate at least 27% of the target population (~43,000). The Valneva/Butantan vaccine, approved by Anvisa in 2025, shows strong antibody responses and is used in Canada, the UK, and Europe. In Dourados, 4,972 probable cases, 2,074 confirmed, 1,212 discarded, 2,900 under investigation, and 8 deaths (seven in the Indigenous Reserve). Transmission by Aedes aegypti.

triage.headline_ja: 4月27日にChikungunya予防接種キャンペーンを開始 - A Tribuna News - マットグロッソ・ド・スル州カンポ・グランデのニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：8人の死亡、4,972人の疑い例；国際的拡大リスク：既にカナダ・英国での使用ワクチン）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡）と流行しやすさ（蚊媒介、先住民居住区での集中）が該当。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル（ドゥラドス市、マットグロッソ・ド・スル州）でのChikungunya発生と予防接種キャンペーンが主題。カナダと英国は参照用にワクチン使用国として言及されているが、発生地域ではない。HIV除外基準として記載されているが、この記事の主要な懸念はChikungunyaである。死亡8件、確認例2,074件、先住民居住区での集中など重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Paludisme | L'Afrique Francophone Face à Une Crise Sanitaire Majeure, Appel à Une Mobilisation Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria | Francophone Africa Faces a Major Health Crisis, Call for Urgent Mobilization.
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Francophone Africa is a major health crisis. The region, 13% of the world’s population exposed to malaria, accounts for 42% of global cases and 40% of deaths. A Benin-launched World Malaria Day report names Burkina Faso, Cameroon, DR Congo, Mali, and Niger among the 11 most affected. In 2024, DR Congo, Niger, and Nigeria together represented more than half of malaria deaths in the Africa region; children under five accounted for about 75%. Challenges include fragile health systems, limited funding (2024 global investments: $3.9B vs $9.3B target), rising resistance to insecticides and drugs, and the invasive Anopheles stephensi threatening urban control. The Sahel—Mali, Burkina Faso, Niger—faces conflict-driven displacement and disrupted services; climate change and floods worsen access. AES cooperation, new generation bed nets, and two WHO-recommended vaccines deployed in infant programs are urged; a francophone malaria resolution is sought for the Nov 2026 OIF Summit.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア：フランス語圏アフリカが大規模な保健危機に直面、緊急動員を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: マラリアによる大規模な公衆衛生危機。アフリカ地域が全世界のマラリア症例の42%、死亡の40%を占め、多数の国で深刻な状況。IHR基準で2つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はフランス語圏アフリカ全体のマラリア危機を論じているが、対象国リストから該当するのはDRCのみ。ただしWPROスクリーニング基準で重症度（子ども5歳未満が死亡の75%）、長期曝露（5つ国で継続的な流行）、流行しやすさ（脆弱な保健システム、薬剤耐性、新興ベクター）、管理可能性（資金不足、支援要請）の複数基準に該当。世界マラリアデーレポートによる公式声明であり、国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados decreta calamidade devido ao avanço da chikungunya e inicia vacinação - Destak Jornal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados Declares a State of Calamity Due to the Spread of Chikungunya and Begins Vaccination - Destak Jornal
article.articleSummary: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, declared a 90-day public health calamity as chikungunya spreads from the Indigenous Reserve into urban neighborhoods. By March 20, the municipality logged 4,972 probable cases (2,074 confirmed, 1,212 discarded, 2,900 under investigation) with 8 fatalities (7 among Indigenous residents). Overall, probable cases exceed 6,186 with a 64.9% positivity rate and hospital bed occupancy around 110%, signaling strained services. A vaccination campaign is planned to start April 27, 2026, after arrival of the first doses on April 17. The target is 27% of the 18–60-year-old population (about 43,000 people). Vaccination has restrictions: no chikungunya in past 30 days; no fever; no recent attenuated vaccines within 28 days or inactivated vaccines within 14 days. Dourados will distribute vaccines to all rooms on April 24, with a drive-through event on May 1 at City Hall. Emergency funding of R$900,000 supports surveillance, vector control, and care.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラドス、チクングニア熱の拡大を受けて公衆衛生災害を宣言し、ワクチン接種を開始 - Destak Jornal
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡8例、医療ベッド占有率110%、ワクチン展開）、異常・予想外（先住民居住区から都市部への拡大）、国際拡大リスク（チクングニア熱の既知の国際的拡散傾向）。WPRO基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で該当。政府による非常事態宣言と対応措置の開始により社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱は蚊媒介疾患で流行性が高く、先住民居住区から都市部への地理的拡大が報告されている。死亡例（8例、先住民7例）、高い確定率（64.9%）、医療システム逼迫（病床占有率110%）が深刻な影響を示唆。政府による90日間の災害宣言、緊急資金投入、ワクチン展開計画など対応措置が実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Thế giới cảnh giác với virus Nipah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World on alert for Nipah virus
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus, a highly dangerous Henipavirus in the Paramyxoviridae family, causes encephalitis and severe respiratory illness with high fatality and pandemic potential. The first outbreak occurred in 1998 in Kampung Sungai Nipah, Perak, Malaysia, with 28 initial patients testing positive for Nipah IgM. Fatality rates vary by outbreak: Malaysia/Singapore about 40%, Bangladesh over 76%, India around 69%, with some outbreaks up to 91%; Philippine fatalities about 53%, and hospital deaths 40–75%. The primary reservoir is fruit bats of genus Pteropus; transmission to humans occurs via direct contact with infected animals or their tissues, fluids or droplets, and through contaminated foods such as unwashed fruit or fresh palm sap contaminated by bat saliva or excreta. Nipah has caused distributed concerns across South and Southeast Asia; related henipaviruses include Hendra (Australia, 1994) and Langya (China, 2021), with later detections in North America. Deforestation and El Niño-driven food scarcity are linked to Malaysia’s emergence.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルスへの世界的警戒
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスはIHR基準4項目すべてに該当する高リスク病原体であり、複数対象国で歴史的に発生記録がある。高い致死率（40～91%）、パンデミック可能性、人獣共通感染症としての特性から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的なニパウイルス発生事例の総説的内容。マレーシア（1998年の初発生地）、インド、フィリピン、中国が対象国リストに該当し、検証済み位置として記載。高い致死率、人獣共通感染、複数地域での反復発生、および環境変化（森林破壊、エルニーニョ）との関連性が指摘されている点が重要。本記事は具体的な現在進行中の新規アウトブレイク報告ではなく、病原体のリスク説明と歴史的背景を扱っているが、ニパウイルス自体の固有リスクプロファイルの高さにより、継続的な監視対象として格付けされるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Atendimentos por gripe crescem 18% em UPAs de Campo Grande e acendem alerta na Sesau
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Flu-related visits are up 18% in Campo Grande's urgent care centers, triggering an alert at Sesau.
article.articleSummary: Campo Grande, Brazil, logs an 18.3% weekly rise in urgent-care visits for respiratory syndromes, increasing from 3,669 to 4,340, with 540 SARI notifications this year. Of these, 40 confirmed influenza, 56 RSV, 141 rhinovirus, 15 SARS-CoV-2, and 17 metapneumovirus; remaining cases are unspecified or under investigation. Compared with 2025, overall notifications are down, but the uptick in respiratory symptoms heightens concern for influenza as winter approaches, stressing UPAs. Triage guidance directs mild cases to Basic Health Units and reserve UPAs for severe illness (high fever, respiratory distress). No permanent COES activation yet, though emergency operations could be invoked if the situation worsens; monitoring continues via the Respiratory Virus Situation Room. A second Dia D flu vaccination day is planned for Saturday the 25th, with only 18.4% coverage; 74 health units and 27 vaccination points are available.

triage.headline_ja: カンポ・グランデの救急外来でインフルエンザ関連の受診が18%増加、セサウで警報が発動
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・カンポ・グランデで呼吸器症候群の救急外来受診が18.3%増加し、SARI通知540件（インフルエンザ確定40件含む）が報告されているが、全体的には2025年比で減少しており、現時点では深刻な公衆衛生危機の段階には至っていない。ただし冬季到来に伴う懸念があり、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルが対象国リストに含まれることを確認。カンポ・グランデで呼吸器症候群受診の週次増加（18.3%）が報告されており、冬季到来時期での監視が重要。ただし確定インフルエンザは40件にとどまり、全体通知数は前年比で減少傾向。COESの正式な活動化はまだなされていない。ワクチン接種率が18.4%と低いことが懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: Food poisoning in Amroha village: Over 100 take ill after wedding feast, probe ordered
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-22, over 100 people in Kamalpur Kazi village, Dhanaura tehsil, Amroha district, fell ill within 24 hours of consuming food at a wedding-related feast. Suspected food contamination caused vomiting, diarrhoea, and acute abdominal pain among attendees, including children and the elderly. More than two dozen patients are hospitalized in nearby private facilities; others remain under observation, with some discharged. A local resident suggested the number affected could be as high as 100. The district administration, led by sub-divisional magistrate Shailesh Kumar Dubey, has launched an investigation; health and food safety teams will collect food samples and identify the contamination source. No laboratory confirmation or exact infection source is reported yet. The incident involved a pre-wedding ceremony with guests from Haivatpur Chaudharyan village and residents, with authorities promising strict action if negligence is found.

triage.headline_ja: アムロハ村での食中毒：結婚式の宴で100人以上が発症、調査が指示される
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の局所的な集団発生であり、国際的な拡大リスクは低い。情報が限定的（原因未確認、検査未実施）であるため、推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 一般的な食中毒の局所的集団発生ケース。100人以上の患者が報告されており重症度基準を満たすが、感染源が未確認で検査も実施されていない。イベントは過去24時間に限定されており、継続的な感染拡大のリスクは低い。今後、実験室確認結果や原因特定に基づいて判定を見直す必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Japanese Measles Outbreak Rises: Travel Alerts Issued Amid Surge in Infections and Vaccination Urges - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Japan faces a measles surge despite elimination status, with 236 confirmed infections nationwide as of early April 2026 and 34 new cases in the week to April 5; year-to-date total 236. About 13% were infected abroad (about 30 individuals), linked to outbreaks in Indonesia and New Zealand where low vaccination rates and delayed diagnoses are reported. Domestic transmission occurs when international travelers import the virus and it spreads in settings. Symptoms include high fever, cough, runny nose, and a red rash; measles spreads via airborne droplets and direct contact and can cause pneumonia, encephalitis, and death, especially among young children and the immunocompromised. Authorities urge travelers to verify vaccination status and emphasize routine immunization for children with two MMR doses. As Golden Week approaches, public health officials remain vigilant. Globally, measles activity is rising in the US, Canada, and parts of Europe, with WHO noting a resurgence since 2023.

triage.headline_ja: 日本の麻疹流行が拡大：感染増加と予防接種呼びかけの中、旅行警告が発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準3項目該当（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ）、国際的な関心と政府の警戒が高い。
triage.notes: 日本での麻疹流行は記事の主題だが、日本は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。インドネシアは明示的に海外感染源として言及されており、対象国リストに含まれるため記載。米国、カナダ、ニュージーランドは記事で言及されるが、対象国外のため除外。Golden Week（ゴールデンウィーク）に向けた警戒が示されており、国際的な人流増加による更なる拡大リスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: 8 ca tử vong, cảnh báo gia tăng ca tay chân miệng diễn biến nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eight deaths, warning of a rise in severe hand-foot-mouth disease cases.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) remains endemic in Vietnam, with Enterovirus A71 (EV-A71) circulation contributing to more severe cases. From January to April 2026, about 26,000 HFMD cases and 8 deaths have been recorded nationwide, led by Ho Chi Minh City (>7,000 cases), Dong Nai (>2,200), and Hanoi (~2,000). The South accounts for roughly 70% of cases. Most patients are young children under 5, clustered in daycare and kindergarten settings. EV-A71 circulation raises risk of severe illness, prompting close monitoring. Transmission is mainly fecal-oral; outbreaks tend to rise in March–May and September–October, aided by warm, humid conditions. Responses include enhanced surveillance, early detection, school-health measures, hygiene promotion, and timely reporting. Parents should monitor fever, mouth ulcers, rashes on hands/feet, and keep affected children at home; seek care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 8人の死亡、手足口病の重症化ケースが増加する可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで2026年1月～4月に26,000件のHFMD症例と8人の死亡が報告されており、EV-A71の循環による重症化が懸念される。IHR基準で「公衆衛生への影響は深刻」「異常」に該当し、また全国規模での流行拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれており、記事サマリーで明確にホーチミン市、ハノイ、ドンナイなどベトナム全国での流行が主題。2026年4月時点での報告で季節的な上昇期（3-5月）に該当。EV-A71の重症化リスク、特に5歳未満の幼児が主な患者群であることから、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cobertura vacinal contra gripe segue baixa e nova variante já causa mortes no país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza vaccination coverage remains low, and a new variant is already causing deaths in the country.
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports low influenza vaccination coverage amid emergence of a new influenza variant gripe K. In the Federal District, six cases have been identified, including the death of a 17-year-old girl. The vaccination campaign targets elderly, pregnant women, and children, aiming for at least 90% coverage by 30 May; currently, about 23% of elderly and under 20% of pregnant women are vaccinated. Officials warn gripe K is a more resistant influenza variant, underscoring vaccination to prevent severe symptoms. Goiás state has declared a state of emergency due to rising cases. Health guidance recommends masking in indoor spaces, especially for symptomatic individuals, to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザワクチン接種率が依然低く、新しい変異株がすでに国内で死亡者を出している
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで新型インフルエンザ変異株（グリペK）による死亡例が報告され、複数州で対応が進んでいる。IHR基準では異常性・重症度が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行リスク・管理上の懸念が該当するため、フルRRA対象
triage.notes: グリペK変異株は耐性が強いとされ、連邦直轄地区で6例（死亡1例：17歳女性）が確認されている。ゴイアス州は緊急事態宣言を発令。ワクチン接種率が目標値（90%）に対し高齢者23%、妊婦20%未満と非常に低い状況。マスク着用の推奨など公衆衛生対策が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Rússia oferece ajuda técnica a Burundi para conter surto de doença desconhecida
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia offers technical assistance to Burundi to contain an outbreak of an unknown disease.
article.articleSummary: Unknown-origin disease outbreak in northern Burundi with 35 cases and at least 5 deaths; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, blood in urine, fatigue, and jaundice. Ebola, Marburg, and other known pathogens tests were negative; investigations continue per Burundi Health Minister Lydwine Badarahana. Russia offers technical assistance to Burundi and proposes an epidemiology center in the Republic of the Congo, under a memorandum with Health Minister Jean-Rosaire Ibara. Rospotrebnadzor chief Anna Popova says the center will conduct surveillance, build technical capacity, and coordinate outbreak response, reducing dependence on foreign laboratories; this builds on the Russia–Africa Summit partnership from 2023. The agency notes a joint infectious disease research center in Burundi’s capital that can be mobilized. Moscow’s Africa health efforts also include mpox support to Rwanda, DRC, Guinea, and Ethiopia in 2024, a mobile lab in Burkina Faso, and health-training programs in Uganda, per RT.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、原因不明の病気の流行を抑制するためブルンジに技術支援を提供
triage.triage_reason: 原因不明の高病原性疾患outbreak（35症例、5死亡以上）で、Ebola/Marburg検査陰性ながら症状の重篤性と国際的な技術支援体制の構築が急速に進行中。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、主要な発生地はブルンジ北部（35症例、5死亡以上）。DRCはロシアが提案する疫学センター拠点地として言及されている。記事は他国（ルワンダ、ギニア、エチオピア、ウガンダ、ブルキナファソ）への過去のロシアの支援にも触れるが、これらは現在の流行との直接的な因果関係は不明確。原因不明・病原体特定未了である点が特に懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Funding gaps threaten Ghana's malaria elimination agenda - NMEP
article.articleSummary: Funding gaps threaten Ghana's malaria elimination agenda, with the National Malaria Elimination Programme (NMEP) cautioning that scarce resources slow essential interventions aimed at reaching elimination targets by 2028. Ahead of World Malaria Day 2026, Deputy Programme Manager Dr. Nana Yaw Peprah says Ghana has moved from control to elimination in selected districts, prioritizing indoor residual spraying (IRS), seasonal malaria chemoprevention (SMC), and mass net distribution. Despite this, nationwide scale-up is hampered by funding shortfalls, with 21 Greater Accra districts earmarked for elimination under the 2024–2028 framework. He urged increased private sector engagement and reinforced community involvement, case management, and surveillance to prevent backsliding. Malaria transmission declined from 28% in 2011 to 8.6% in 2025, and mortality fell from 3,300 to 52 by end-2025; targets remain a 90% mortality reduction and a 50% drop in parasite incidence by 2028.

triage.headline_ja: 資金不足がガーナのマラリア撲滅計画を脅かす - NMEP
triage.triage_reason: マラリアの資金調達上の課題に関する政策ニュースであり、新規の疾病発生イベント、深刻な健康危機、異常な流行の兆候は示されていない。既知の疾病における制度的課題の報道である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はガーナのマラリア撲滅計画における資金不足という政策課題であり、新規の感染症クラスター、異常な発生パターン、または流行の兆候は含まれていない。むしろ、既存プログラムの進展（感染率低下、死亡率低下）が報告されている。シグナルトリアージの対象となる急性的な公衆衛生上の危機ではない。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค โต้ข่าว 'โรงงานชลบุรี' สาเหตุแพร่ ตับอักเสบเอ แจงยังหาที่มาไม่พบ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control refutes reports that the 'Chonburi factory' was the cause of Hepatitis A transmission, saying the source has not yet been found.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 Apr 2026, Hepatitis A outbreaks in Thailand’s Eastern region have spread across several provinces, with most cases in Chonburi. Patients aged 5–67 are mainly day laborers and office workers; no outbreak cluster identified. The Department of Disease Control refutes social media claims that a ‘Chonburi factory’ is the source, noting no confirmed link yet and ongoing investigations. A joint team is conducting active case finding. Twenty samples—including water, ice, food, and factory environmental swabs—were tested for Hepatitis A virus; none were positive. Symptoms observed include fever, fatigue, nausea, and jaundice. The factory reports good sanitation; no infections detected among workers. Investigations continue in the factory and surrounding communities to locate the true source and risk factors (food, water, hygiene, environment) to guide control measures. Follow official updates; call 1422 for information.

triage.headline_ja: タイ疾病管理局がコンケン工場がA型肝炎の原因であるという報道に反論、感染源はまだ特定されていないと説明
triage.triage_reason: A型肝炎がタイ東部の複数県に拡大し、チョンブリ県で患者が多発している異常な発生。公衆衛生上の影響が深刻で、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心が存在するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: A型肝炎がタイ東部地域で複数県に拡大し、患者年齢層が広い(5～67歳)ことから感染源の特定が重要。社会メディアで工場が感染源という説が広がっており、当局が調査を続けている。感染源が水、食物など環境由来である可能性が高く、公衆衛生上の対応が急務。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Bady Bassitt inicia vacinação contra a chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bady Bassitt begins vaccination against Chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination began in Bady Bassitt, São Paulo, on 2026-04-22, with free doses at local health units for residents aged 18–59 (population ~29,000). The rollout follows Mirassol’s pilot and a national strategy approved by Anvisa in April 2025; the Instituto Butantan–developed vaccine has also been approved in Canada, the United Kingdom, and the European Union. In the first phase, ten municipalities across four states were chosen; Mirassol has administered 5,415 doses as of April 21. Clinical data from Brazil and the United States show the vaccine is well tolerated and immunogenic after a single dose, with about 99% of U.S. trial participants developing neutralizing antibodies. Contraindications include immunosuppressed individuals, pregnant women, and those allergic to components. Chikungunya is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; symptoms include high fever and severe joint pain; no antiviral treatment exists; supportive care. In São Paulo state, 2025 saw 7,952 cases and 7 deaths; by April 21, 2026, 616 cases and 2 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: Bady Bassittでチクングニア予防接種が開始
triage.triage_reason: この記事はブラジルの予防接種キャンペーン進捗の報道であり、新規の感染症クラスターや異常な発生を報じるものではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当がなく、社会的関心も限定的である。
triage.notes: 記事は既に進行中の予防接種プログラムの段階的展開について報じており、新規の感染症クラスターや公衆衛生上の危機を示していない。症例数の減少傾向（2025年7,952例→2026年4月616例）も報告されており、状況はコントロール下にある。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Россия передала Конго две мобильные лаборатории для борьбы с инфекциями
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia handed over two mobile laboratories to Congo to combat infections.
article.articleSummary: Two new mobile laboratories were handed over by Russia to the Republic of Congo during the 2nd Russian-African Conference on Infectious Diseases in Brazzaville. The head of Rospotrebnadzor, Anna Popova, presented the certificates to Congo’s Minister of Health and Population. The first unit is built on a GAZ off-road vehicle, capable of about 1,800 tests per day across 30 infections, including express tests in 30 minutes. The second is a portable pneumocart-based laboratory that can be transported disassembled by any vehicle, with a capacity exceeding 1,300 analyses per day. Russia–Congo cooperation continues; a mobile lab on a KAMAZ delivered in February 2025 aided a cholera outbreak in August 2025. The pneumocart complex previously proved effective in Dolisie, where four weeks of interventions reduced dangerous intestinal infections by sixteen-fold. Epidemiological collaboration remains a cornerstone of the Russian–Congolese humanitarian partnership.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、感染症対策のためコンゴに2つの移動実験室を引き渡し
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の発生イベントではなく、ロシアによるコンゴへの医療機器援助に関する協力・支援ニュース。コレラなどの病原体は過去の事例として言及されているが、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクではなく、疾病管理の対象外。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は医療援助・国際協力であり、進行中のアウトブレイク報告ではない。コレラなどの感染症は文脈中に補足例として記載されているのみ（過去の事例「August 2025のコレラアウトブレイク」への対応実績として言及）。Bluedot APIが検出した地域情報にはロシア連邦が含まれているが、記事の主題はコンゴでの発生ではなく援助・協力であるため、感染症イベント検出としてのシグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados passa de 6,4 mil notificações de Chikungunya -- AconteceuMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados surpasses 6,400 Chikungunya notifications — AconteceuMS.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, reports 6,411 notifications with 2,204 confirmed, 4,959 probable, 1,462 discarded, and 2,755 under investigation (Epidemiological Report No. 30). Hospitalizations for complications total 41 across facilities: Porta da Esperança Indigenous Hospital (2), HU-UFGD University Hospital (22), Cassems (5), Regional Hospital (7), Hospital da Vida (2), Evangelico Mackenzie (3). In the Indigenous Reserve (Bororó and Jaguapiru), 2,337 probable cases are recorded (1,461 confirmed, 639 discarded, 876 under investigation) totaling 2,976 notifications, with 8 confirmed deaths (7 residents of the reserve). A vaccination campaign begins April 27 under the Chikungunya Incident Action Plan; eligibility is 18–59 years with contraindications including pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppression, congenital immunodeficiency, cancer therapy, organ/bone marrow transplant within 2 years, HIV, autoimmune diseases, or two chronic conditions. Distribution starts April 24; vaccination proceeds in all health units after pre-vaccination health assessment.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスがチクングニア6,400件超の通知を超過 — AconteceuMS
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマットグロッソドゥスル州で確認者2,204名、死亡8名を含む大規模なチクングニア流行が発生。公衆衛生への深刻な影響とワクチン接種キャンペーン開始により、IHR基準複数該当およびWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事ではチクングニアが主要な疾患でブラジルで大規模流行が進行中。先住民居留地での死亡例（8名）を含む重症例が報告されており、政府のワクチン接種キャンペーンが開始予定。HIV患者はワクチン接種から除外対象とされている（免疫抑制状態のため）。WPROの地理的スコープを超えるが、公衆衛生的重要性により PICKUP と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Sùi mào gà lan rộng vì tự điều trị
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Genital warts spread widely due to self-treatment.
article.articleSummary: Genital warts (condyloma acuminata) caused by HPV types 6/11 are increasingly seen among Vietnamese youths, illustrated by an 18-year-old man with perianal soft papules who self-treated with topical medications, worsening irritation. Examination revealed moist plaques ~2.5 cm around the anus; PCR confirmed HPV 6/11. After removal and intensive wound care, he stabilized. The case reflects a youth-driven trend: early sexual debut, limited knowledge, reluctance to seek care, and reliance on online topical products. CDC notes most HPV infections are asymptomatic, with many clearing within two years; screening often detects co-infections such as gonorrhea, chlamydia, syphilis, or other high-risk HPV types. Management should address lesion location, transmission risk, co-infections, and post-treatment follow-up due to recurrence risk. Vaccination prevents new infections but does not treat existing ones; condoms reduce risk but are not fully protective. A 2024 Ho Chi Minh City study found median ages 20–27, with 53.3% aged 18–23.

triage.headline_ja: 生殖器疣贅が自己治療により広く蔓延
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの若年層における性感染症（尖形コンジローマ、淋病、梅毒の合併感染リスク）の増加傾向が報告されているが、単一事例中心で集団発生の明確な証拠に乏しく、公衆衛生上の緊急性が限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は単一患者事例を中心とした教育的コンテンツであり、集団発生や顕著な流行の報告ではない。ただし記事サマリーに「2024年ホーチミン市調査で若年層（中央値20-27歳、18-23歳が53.3%）での増加傾向」が示唆されており、潜在的な公衆衛生トレンドとして注視する価値がある。HPV関連疾患と複数の性感染症（淋病、梅毒、クラミジア）の合併感染リスク言及も確認。

article.articleHeadline: Casos em alta mantêm 41 internados por chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising cases keep 41 people hospitalized for chikungunya in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya activity remains high in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil. As of 22 April 2026, the municipality has 2,204 laboratory-confirmed cases (out of 6,411 notifications: 4,959 probable, 2,755 under investigation, 1,452 discarded), with 41 patients hospitalized for suspected or confirmed infection. The state has reported 12 chikungunya deaths in 2026, eight of them in Dourados, which accounts for more than half of Mato Grosso do Sul’s fatalities. Among the eight deaths in Dourados, seven were Indigenous; two were infants (1 and 3 months) and five were adults, including a 63-year-old man with comorbidities such as cancer and diabetes—the most recent urban-area death. Two additional deaths remain under investigation: a 12-year-old child and an 84-year-old man from the urban area (symptoms began Feb 28 and Apr 18, respectively). CHIKV is transmitted by Aedes aegypti; symptoms include high fever and severe joint pains; testing is available through SUS.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスでチクングニア熱の入院者が41人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：死亡8例、入院41人；異常性：Indigenous集団での高い死亡率；管理性：州レベルの対応が必要）。WPRO基準も複数該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ブラジル、マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州のドゥラードスでチクングニア熱が流行中。2026年4月22日時点で2,204例の確定診断例、41人入院、州全体で12死亡（うち8例がドゥラードス）。先住民とその他の脆弱集団への影響が顕著。Aedes aegypti媒介なため、継続的な伝播リスク有。

article.articleHeadline: Menina de 8 anos morre por complicações da dengue no interior de MT  | Rdnews - melhor portal de notícias de Mato Grosso | principais notícias de Cuiabá e Várzea Grande
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An eight-year-old girl dies from dengue complications in the interior of Mato Grosso.
article.articleSummary: An eight-year-old girl died from dengue complications in Barra do Garças, Mato Grosso, Brazil, in the interior of the state. The death occurred on Monday, 20 April 2026, and was confirmed by the Municipal Secretariat of Education, which extended condolences to the girl’s family, classmates, and school community. The girl was a student at CMEB Dona Delice Farias dos Santos. The report notes a fatal outcome linked to dengue, but provides no details on clinical presentation, laboratory confirmation, or the infection source. The incident underscores dengue risk in the region, though no broader outbreak information is provided in the release. The school administration and local authorities expressed sympathy and solidarity with those affected by this irreparable loss.

triage.headline_ja: 8歳の女の子がマト・グロッソ州内陸部のデング熱の合併症で死亡
triage.triage_reason: デング熱による小児死亡例であり、IHR基準「深刻な公衆衛生への影響」と「異常性」に該当。ブラジルにおける確認された死亡事例であり、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはポルトガル語から英語に翻訳されたもの。死亡が2026年4月20日に確認されており、時間的に最近の事例。ただし、より広範なデング流行の有無や他の死亡例の存在については情報がない。臨床的詳細や検査確認については記載がない。

article.articleHeadline: T7News | Lagoinha confirma duas mortes por febre amarela e reforça vacinação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: T7News | Lagoinha confirms two deaths from yellow fever and reinforces vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Lagoinha, Brazil confirms two deaths from yellow fever and a third suspected case per the state epidemiological bulletin dated 22 April 2026. The victims resided in the rural zone and were unvaccinated; one death occurred in the Santa Rita neighborhood on 3 April and the other in Canta Galo on 12 April. A vaccination blitz is underway, with health teams visiting neighborhoods and the vaccination center operating 7:00–19:00, Monday–Friday. On 25 April, the 'Health in the Square' event will focus on boosting immunization. The outbreak prompts alerts across Vale do Paraíba; Cunha reported the state's first yellow fever death of 2026, while Cruzeiro has two confirmed cases with recovery. Yellow fever is mosquito-borne with no human-to-human transmission; symptoms include fever, body pains, chills, nausea, and fatigue. Vaccination remains the main preventive measure.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴイーニャ、黄熱病で2人の死亡を確認し予防接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで黄熱病による死亡例（2人確認、1人疑い例）が報告され、複数地域（Vale do Paraíba地域）への拡大が示唆されている。IHR基準では重症度と国際的拡大リスク、WPRO基準では重症度と長期曝露が該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ブラジルのラゴイーニャおよびVale do Paraíba地域（Cunha、Cruzeiro含む）での黄熱病発生が明確に確認される。死亡者は予防接種を受けていない農村部の住民。複数地域への拡大と公衆衛生機関の対応（予防接種キャンペーン）が報告されている。蚊媒介疾患であり人間への感染経路は限定的だが、ワクチン未接種者が多い地域での流行リスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: Typhoid Outbreak At VIT Hostel In MP's Sehore After Over 250 Students Fall Sick In 10 Days; What University Said
article.articleSummary: Typhoid outbreak at VIT University hostel in Kothari Kalan, Sehore district, Madhya Pradesh. Over 250 students fell sick in 10 days with high fever, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Pathology at Chirayu Medical College reports 23 of 57 samples positive for Salmonella Typhi; 34 results pending, with one student in ICU on life support. University registrar KK Nair had dismissed reports as rumours, claiming only 80 cases. Health authorities ordered third-party inspection of campus water supply and mess cleanliness, and health checks for mess staff. As a precaution, the university issued leaves for the 2025 batch and sent students home. Experts attribute the mass infection to contaminated drinking water or food, linked to poor hygiene in the hostel mess and water tanks. Background: a prior November 2025 outbreak at the same campus due to contaminated water, with unrest and police action.

triage.headline_ja: マディヤプラデシュ州セホーラのVITホステルでの腸チフス集団発生、10日間で250人以上の学生が罹患、大学が対応を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の大規模集団発生、国内拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（異常/予想外、中等度重症度、長期曝露のリスク、流行しやすい環境）。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 大学が当初250人以上の罹患を報告し、確検陽性23/57、1名がICUで生命維持中。2025年11月の同一キャンパスでの先行集団発生による水質汚染が背景にあり、インフラ欠陥の継続的問題を示唆。管理当局が対応しているが、学生の不安と学位取得の中断リスクから社会的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Alems terá votação rápida para reconhecer calamidade por chikungunya em Dourados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ALEMS to fast-track vote to declare a state of calamity due to chikungunya in Dourados.
article.articleSummary: On 22 April 2026, Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, faces a rapidly spreading chikungunya epidemic, prompting Alems to fast-track a legislative decree recognizing a public calamity. The measure, requested by the city under Decree 638 (20 April 2026), would acknowledge an exceptional situation under Article 65 of the Fiscal Responsibility Law to authorize extraordinary administrative and financial actions. The proposal advances to the CCJ with aims for urgent plenary voting within the week. Epidemiological data show 4,982 probable cases, 2,163 confirmed, 2,819 under investigation, and 6,343 notifications, with a 61.4% positivity rate. Eight deaths are confirmed and two are under investigation, predominantly among Indigenous communities; transmission now centers in the urban population. Hospital occupancy runs ~110%, with up to 500 daily UpA visits and at least 42 hospitalized. Co-circulation with Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) strains health services. Calamity recognition would enable emergency hiring, procurement, and budget flexing for up to 90 days, with transparency and oversight.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスのチクングニア熱の災害認定を急速投票するALEMS
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準4項目該当（異常、重症度、長期曝露、流行性），複数の死亡と確認症例、医療システム逼迫、政府の緊急対応。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: ドゥラードス市（マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州）での急速な流行。確認患者2,163名、死亡8名（先住民社会に集中），医療施設の逼迫（110%の占有率），SRAGとの同時循環。政府が災害宣言を緊急投票予定。チクングニア熱はWPRO地域外（南米）だが、重症度と規模によるシグナル価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura lamenta morte de menina de 8 anos por complicações da dengue - Agora MT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: City Hall mourns the death of an eight-year-old girl due to dengue complications - Agora MT.
article.articleSummary: Eight-year-old Ana Júlia Lacerda Queiroz died on April 21 in Barra do Garças, Mato Grosso, Brazil, from complications of dengue fever. A pupil of CMEB Dona Delice Farias dos Santos, she was mourned by the Barra do Garças Municipal Secretariat of Education, Sport and Leisure, which issued condolences and highlighted the school community’s grief. The case underscores dengue’s risk, noting that the disease can progress to severe and fatal forms, especially among children, and calls for renewed attention to mosquito control and preventive measures in the community. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation or the infection source, and does not mention other cases or outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱の合併症により8歳の少女が死亡 - ブラジル、バッハ市
triage.triage_reason: デング熱による小児死亡例が報告されており、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か」に該当（死亡例）。また、WPRO基準の「重症度」（死亡例）と「異常/予想外」（小児デング死亡）に該当するため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのバッハ市におけるデング熱による小児死亡を報告している。ラボ確認や感染源の詳細が記載されていないため、他の症例やアウトブレイクの有無は不明。地域的に限定された個別死亡例だが、公衆衛生上の重要性と社会的関心から当該シグナルはピックアップ値する。

article.articleHeadline: Роспотребнадзор сделал грозное заявление об оспе обезьян в России
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor issued a grim statement about monkeypox in Russia.
article.articleSummary: As of 22 April 2026, Russia's consumer health watchdog Rospotrebnadzor says the risk of importing monkeypox remains due to a tense global situation, but there is currently no transmission within the Russian Federation. Head Anna Popova emphasized that every detected case is promptly identified and localized, and border measures aim to prevent entry of pathogens. The article also notes warnings from the World Health Organization Director-General that a future pandemic could emerge at any time. Globally, monkeypox remains centered in Africa, with more than 50,800 cases reported in the past 12 months, mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda and Sierra Leone. Academician Gennady Onishchenko said there is nothing to fear, recalling that monkeypox was brought under control after smallpox eradication in 1980. Popova urged vigilance and border control to prevent importation.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健監視機関が猿痘についての厳しい声明を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準は2つ以下だが、WPROスクリーニング基準で「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」の3つが該当。ただし記事サマリーではロシア国内での実際の感染は報告されておらず、情報不足のため WATCH 判定。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な発生地域はアフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ、シエラレオネ）とされているが、ウガンダとシエラレオネは対象国リストに含まれていないため含めない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ロシアはBluedot APIで指摘されているが、記事サマリーではロシア国内での実際の感染は報告されていない（「currently no transmission within the Russian Federation」）ため、ロシアは verified_locations に含めない。ザンビアは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーには明示的に記載されていない点に注意。情報不足のため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Dourados decreta calamidade pública por avanço da chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dourados declares a public calamity due to the spread of chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil triggers a public health calamity as cases spread from the Reserva Indígena de Dourados to urban neighborhoods. Following a March 20 public-health emergency, a subsequent civil-defense emergency was declared; a third decree escalates the response under the COE. Calamity status is valid for 90 days. By the reporting date, about 6,186 probable cases (64.9% positivity) and a health-system collapse with ~110% bed occupancy, including eight deaths (seven among Indigenous residents). Vaccination begins Monday, April 27; first doses arrived April 17. Target population 18–60 years, aiming to immunize at least 27% (~43,000). Contraindications include pregnancy, lactation, immunosuppression, cancer treatment, recent transplants, HIV/AIDS, autoimmune or multiple chronic diseases, and recent chikungunya or vaccination. Doses distributed to all health units on April 24; drive-thru planned May 1, 8–12, at city hall. Anvisa approval in April 2025; about 20 municipalities in six states targeted.

triage.headline_ja: ドゥラードスがチクングニア熱の拡大に伴い公共の大惨事を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのマットグロッソ・ド・スル州で大規模なチクングニア熱の流行が発生し、公衆衛生上の大惨事宣言、医療体制の崩壊（ベッド占有率110%）、8名の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準3項目以上を満たす。
triage.notes: ドゥラードスはマットグロッソ・ド・スル州の都市。公式な大惨事宣言、急速な症例増加（6,186件、死亡8件）、医療システムの過負荷、ワクチン接種キャンペーン開始など、複数の深刻な懸念要素が存在。Indigenous population（先住民）への影響が顕著。ただしWPRO対象国リストに含まれるのはBrazilのみ（オセアニア地域外）。

article.articleHeadline: В Роспотребнадзоре рассказали, как помогали жителям Конго справляться с холерой - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rospotrebnadzor explained how they helped residents of Congo cope with cholera — News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: Cholera in Congo was addressed by Russia’s Rospotrebnadzor, which says specialists who fight cholera in Congo were trained in Russia. Local doctors took the lead, supported by a mobile laboratory and equipment transferred by Russia. In 2025 Congo faced a serious cholera situation; after training and tools were provided, local teams began operating independently and reportedly succeeded. Popova emphasized that Russia’s role was to collaborate with local professionals, not to dominate the continent, aiming to impart knowledge and skills to enable biological sovereignty in participating countries. The effort focuses on capacity-building and sustainable response. Putin previously stated Russia’s support to Africa in biosafety, with Moscow-African ties in this area described as dynamically developing.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア保健監視庁がコンゴのコレラ対策への支援方法を説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響(Yes)と国際的拡大リスク(Yes)の2つ以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度(Yes)、流行しやすさ(Yes)、管理可能性(Yes)の複数基準に該当。コンゴの深刻なコレラ状況は優先的なシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおけるコレラの深刻な状況とロシアによる支援体制を報道している。発生地域にMoscow/Russian Federationが含まれているが、これらは支援提供国であり、実際のコレラ発生地はDRCのみ。2025年にコンゴで深刻なコレラ流行があったことが明記されており、継続的な感染曝露リスクが存在する。容易な人-人感染により流行性が高く、国際的支援が必要な状況が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Trump Administration's America First Global Health Strategy Fights Infectious Di...
article.articleSummary: On April 17, 2026, the United States and Bolivia signed a three-year Memorandum of Understanding under the America First Global Health Strategy, extending through December 2028 to interrupt Neglected Tropical Diseases, procure HIV medicines, and advance Bolivia’s health system autonomy. The agreement totals more than $12 million, with the U.S. providing about $10 million to bolster global health security and shield the Western Hemisphere from infectious diseases; Bolivia will increase domestic health expenditures by over $2 million through 2028. Overall, America First MOUs exceed $20.6 billion in new health funding, comprising roughly $12.8 billion in U.S. assistance and $7.8 billion in recipient co-investment. As of April 21, 2026, the State Department had signed 31 bilateral MOUs with countries including Angola, the Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Kenya, the Philippines, Rwanda, and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: トランプ政権の「アメリカ第一」グローバルヘルス戦略：感染症対策をボリビアとのMOU締結で推進
triage.triage_reason: HIV対策に関する国際保健協力の政策発表であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクやシグナルではない。記事は外交的な保健MOU署名について述べており、IHR基準やWPRO基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症アウトブレイク情報ではなく、米国とボリビア（対象国リストに含まれず）および複数国との保健協力協定に関する政策発表である。対象国リストに含まれるPhilippinesはMOU署名国として言及されているのみで、具体的なイベント発生地ではない。シグナルトリアージとしてはピックアップの必要性なし。

article.articleHeadline: Especialistas reforçam urgência da vacina em meio a aumento de síndrome respiratória no DF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts emphasize the urgency of vaccination amid a rise in acute respiratory syndrome in the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-22, health specialists in Brazil's Federal District emphasize vaccination as the main measure to curb severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) amid rising cases. The circulation of influenza K is described as a more aggressive variant capable of causing severe illness and deaths. The Federal District has recorded more than 1,600 SRAG cases this year, including the death of a 17-year-old girl. Although the immunization campaign began nearly a month ago, only about 100,000 people have been vaccinated, far short of the 90% target for the priority population. The situation also alarms neighboring Goiás, where authorities declared a state of public health emergency due to rising cases. Officials stress that vaccination protects individuals and helps reduce virus transmission and pressure on the health system.

triage.headline_ja: 専門家がブラジル連邦直轄区の急性呼吸器症候群増加の中でワクチン接種の緊急性を強調
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザK型による急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)の事例増加と死亡例の報告がありスクリーニング基準を複数満たすが、ワクチン接種推進の記事であり感染症アウトブレイク報告としての確実性に乏しい。引き続き情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないが、記事サマリーで実際の発生地としてBrazilが言及されているため verified_locations に含めた。なお記事の主要目的はワクチン接種キャンペーン推進であり、アウトブレイク検出アラートではない点に注意。インフルエンザK型の詳細情報（WHO分類での正式名称、変異株情報など）が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Customs and Border Protection seize monkey carcass, 125 pounds of ruminant meat at O'Hare Airport
article.articleSummary: Monkey carcass and 125 pounds of prohibited ruminant meat were seized at Chicago’s O’Hare International Airport on April 11 by U.S. Customs and Border Protection. A passenger from Cameroon underwent secondary agriculture inspection; an X-ray and luggage search uncovered the monkey carcass, which was seized and destroyed. A separate passenger from Liberia attempted to bring in ruminant meat, found among meat, bones, and hair concealed inside dried seafood, which the passenger admitted. Ruminant meat from certain parts of the world is prohibited because it could carry diseases such as bovine spongiform encephalopathy and foot-and-mouth disease; seafood is admitted. In addition, one pound of prohibited fresh leaves and four types of prohibited seeds were seized in the Liberian’s luggage. CBP advises travelers to declare all plant and animal materials and consult the CBP website for import rules; a December Congo incident reported similar confiscations of non-human primate meat and other items.

triage.headline_ja: 税関・国境警察がオヘア空港でサルの死骸と125ポンドの反芻動物肉を押収
triage.triage_reason: 記事は違法輸入物品の押収報告であり、実際の感染症発生ではない。検査・差し止め措置が正常に機能した事例で、国際的な感染症リスク拡大の可能性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は感染症イベントそのものではなく、税関における違法物品の押収報告である。参照国（Cameroon, Liberia, DRC）は密輸元として言及されているが、これらの国で実際に口蹄疫などの発生が報告されているわけではない。違法輸入物品を適切に検疫・破棄した事例であり、シグナルとしてのピックアップ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Sehat Terancam! Ini dia Ciri TBC Paru: Batuk 3 Minggu Dahak Darah Keringat Malam BB Turun - Suara Merdeka Purbalingga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Health at Risk! Here are the signs of pulmonary TB: Cough for three weeks, blood in sputum, night sweats, weight loss - Suara Merdeka Purbalingga
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis (Mycobacterium tuberculosis) in Purbalingga, Indonesia, is highlighted with classic signs: productive cough >3 weeks with sputum, hemoptysis (blood in sputum), fever, night sweats, weight loss, loss of appetite, chest pain, and shortness of breath. The article notes cough lasting 2–3 weeks or more as a key indicator of active, highly transmissible TB, underscoring airborne transmission via droplets from coughing or sneezing. Diagnosis relies on sputum smear/microscopy, culture, PCR, and chest X-rays. Standard treatment spans six months of first-line anti-TB therapy (OAT), with complete cure possible. Early detection at primary health centers (puskesmas) is free, and full treatment helps prevent transmission to family. The piece references public health messaging from ayosehat.kemkes.go.id and stresses prompt care to curb spread in the local community.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：健康が脅かされている！肺結核の兆候はこれだ：3週間の咳、痰に血、夜間の寝汗、体重減少 - スアラ・メルデカ・プルバリンガ
triage.triage_reason: 肺結核の臨床的特徴と診断・治療法についての啓発記事であり、具体的な感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイク事例ではない。公衆衛生メッセージであり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準をいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア・プルバリンガ地域における肺結核の臨床的特徴、診断方法、治療法に関する公衆衛生啓発記事である。具体的な新規患者数、集団発生、または異常な疾患パターンの報告がなく、既知の対象疾患の教育的情報提供に過ぎない。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定する。

article.articleHeadline: Com baixa vacinação e aumento de casos graves, Campo Grande faz novo Dia D contra gripe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With low vaccination rates and an increase in severe cases, Campo Grande holds a new D-Day against the flu.
article.articleSummary: Day D flu vaccination in Campo Grande, Mato Grosso do Sul, aims to raise coverage after only 18% uptake among priority groups. As of 22 April 2026, the city has recorded 287 cases of Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG), with 40 laboratory-confirmed influenza and 5 deaths, per CIEVS-CG. A new vaccination drive takes place on Saturday, 25 April 2026, from 7:30 to 16:45 at 27 health units citywide and a central point at Praça Ary Coelho, to broaden access amid rising respiratory illnesses. The drive targets children 6 months–<6 years, elderly, pregnant women and puerperae, health workers, education workers, security forces, indigenous and quilombolas, people with comorbidities, and essential workers including postal workers, truck drivers, and public transport staff. Last year’s vaccination coverage reached only 59%, prompting this additional Day D; vaccination remains available throughout the week at 74 USFs.

triage.headline_ja: 低いワクチン接種率と重症例の増加により、カンポグランデがインフルエンザに対する新たなD-Dayを実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザの局所的な流行であり、重症化事例と死亡例が報告されているが、国際的拡大やIHR基準の明確な該当がない。情報不足により慎重な判定が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に含める。記事は2026年4月22日付けで、カンポグランデ市（マット・グロッソ・ド・スル州）におけるインフルエンザの局所的流行を報告している。SRAG 287例、確認インフルエンザ 40例、死亡 5例が記録されている。ワクチン接種率が低く、追加のワクチン接種キャンペーンが実施されている。国内的な対応が進行中であり、現時点では国際的拡大リスクは不明だが、スクリーニング基準で複数該当するため WATCH 判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: Hong Kong Reports First Local Dengue Fever Case of the Year as Health Official Warns of Moderate Outbreak Risk Amid Rising Temperatures and Rainy Season, Urges Public to Eliminate Mosquito Breeding Sites - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports its first locally transmitted dengue fever case of the year: a 21-year-old man with no recent travel history, who developed fever and a rash and was admitted on April 16 to Alice Ho Miu Ling Nethersole Hospital in Tai Po; he remains in stable condition. He was bitten by mosquitoes near a construction site in Penny's Bay, Lantau Island. Environmental inspections found breeding sites such as weed‑choked drainage channels and stagnant water at the site. The CHP has opened a health consultation booth at Tai Wo Estate to offer symptom assessments and free dengue antibody tests. So far in 2026, 12 other dengue cases have been recorded, all imported. In 2025, there were 59 imported cases; in 2024, 161 total with five locally acquired. Authorities warn of a moderate outbreak risk due to rising temperatures and the rainy season, and no epidemiological link to prior imported cases. Public urged to eliminate standing water and avoid bites; no locally registered dengue vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 香港が今年初の地域内デング熱感染者を報告、衛生当局が気温上昇と雨季の中での中程度の流行リスクを警告、蚊の繁殖地の除去を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の地域内感染例は香港にとって異常で予想外であり、気温上昇と雨季による流行リスクが警告されている。IHR基準2項目（異常性・流行リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常性・流行しやすさが明確に該当するため、シグナル認定はフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 香港の地域内デング熱感染例は過去3年間で稀有であり（2024年に5件の地域内感染、2025年はゼロ）、今年初となる。建設地周辺の蚊の繁殖地が特定されており、気温上昇と雨季による拡大リスクが公式に警告されている。ただし現段階では単一症例であり重症度は低い。香港はChina（GeoNames ID 1814991）に含める。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Updates Zika Virus Travel Alerts: Barbados, Bolivia, Ecuador, Guadeloupe, Saint Martin, Guyana, Cape Verde, and Samoa Added - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-22, the CDC notes that on Jan 22, 2016, Barbados, Bolivia, Ecuador, Guadeloupe, Saint Martin, Guyana, Cape Verde, and Samoa were added to areas with ongoing Zika transmission in its interim travel guidance, following an earlier Jan 15, 2016 alert for Puerto Rico, Brazil, Colombia, El Salvador, French Guiana, Guatemala, Haiti, Honduras, Martinique, Mexico, Panama, Paraguay, Suriname, and Venezuela. Zika, dengue, and chikungunya are spread by Aedes mosquitoes described as aggressive daytime biters that live indoors and outdoors near people. At that time, there was no vaccine or medicine for Zika; prevention relied on avoiding bites. Some travelers may be asymptomatic; when present, Zika symptoms include fever, rash, joint pain, and red eyes, usually lasting several days to a week. The CDC continues monitoring transmission and will update alerts, advising travelers to consult its Travelers' Health resources and risk maps.

triage.headline_ja: CDC、ジカウイルス渡航警告を更新：バルバドス、ボリビア、エクアドル、グアドループ、セントマーチン、ガイアナ、カーボベルデ、サモアを追加
triage.triage_reason: ジカ、デング熱、チクングニアの多地域同時発生で国際的拡大リスクが高く、複数のIHR基準に該当。CDCの渡航警告発令により国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が確立している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはCDC渡航警告の広範な地域追加について述べており、ジカウイルスの多地域同時発生を示唆している。対象国リスト内ではブラジルのみが該当。他の地域（バルバドス、ボリビア、パナマなど）は対象国外であるため verified_locations から除外した。CDCの公式警告により信頼性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Com epidemia de chikungunya, Dourados contrata hospital por R$ 4 milhões para atender indígenas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Amid a chikungunya epidemic, Dourados hires a hospital for 4 million reais to treat indigenous people.
article.articleSummary: Amid a chikungunya epidemic in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, the city formalized a R$4 million one-year agreement with Missão Evangélica Caiuá to contract hospital services for Indigenous residents. Monthly payments are R$336,418.18, funded by federal SUS maintenance blocks and state transfers, with additional nursing wage support. The contract was signed April 15, with SES involvement. On April 20, the city declared a public health calamity due to the epidemic and hospital network collapse; Alems will vote on a health calamity decree on April 23. Dourados has 2,204 chikungunya cases in 2026, including 8 deaths, with over 6,000 suspected/notified cases and 41 hospitalized; 41 new cases since April 21. The outbreak began in the RID, home to ~15,000 people over 3,500 hectares, where Aedes aegypti proliferation—amid water supply issues—spread to other neighborhoods, with hospitals operating at 110% capacity and concerns over Severe Acute Respiratory Syndromes (SRAG).

triage.headline_ja: チクングニア流行により、ドゥラドスは先住民向け医療サービスに400万レアイスで病院を契約
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ドゥラドス市でチクングニア流行により公衆衛生危機が宣言され、IHR基準で深刻な影響と異常な状況が確認された。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡8名、41名入院）、長期曝露（先住民居住地での蚊の増殖継続）、流行可能性（Aedes aegyptiによるヒト-ヒト感染媒介）、管理可能性（医療機関の過負荷110%）が複数該当し、社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにより、ブラジルのマトグロッソドスル州ドゥラドス市でチクングニア流行が確認されている。2026年に2,204確定例、8死亡、41入院例、6,000以上の疑い例が報告されている。公衆衛生危機宣言（2026年4月20日）、病院ネットワークの過負荷（110%稼働率）、先住民居住地での蚊媒介の継続、SRAG懸念など複数の深刻なリスク要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: Defesa Civil intensifica ações contra surto de chikungunya em Dourados - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Civil Defense steps up efforts against Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados - Jornal de Brasília
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya outbreak in Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, as of 22 April 2026, intensified with a high number of cases. The Ministry of Integration and Regional Development (MIDR) dispatched a Sedec technical team to support cleansing and recovery operations, including the Dourados Indigenous Reserve. A total of R$2.3 million has been allocated to the municipality: R$1.3 million for relief and humanitarian aid and R$974,000 for restoration actions. The mission will run into next week, with Sedec teams coordinating with municipal and state protection and civil defense authorities to improve alignment with the federal protection system. Chikungunya is a viral disease transmitted by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus, presenting with fever and severe joint pain; while most cases resolve without complications, rare fatalities can occur, especially among the elderly and those with comorbidities.

triage.headline_ja: civil defense strengthens actions against chikungunya outbreak in dourados
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目該当（異常性・重症度）。Dourados市での流行拡大により、複数の州・連邦当局による支援とR$2.3百万規模の資源動員が実施されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が確認される。
triage.notes: Dourados, Mato Grosso do Sul州での局所流行が確認。Aedes aegypti/albopictusによるヒト-ヒト感染可能な蚊媒介性疾患であり、高齢者・基礎疾患者での重症化リスク記載。連邦・州・市レベルでの多段階対応体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: 'Rabid' dog on biting spree injures 36 wedding guests, pedestrians in Badaun
article.articleSummary: 36 people injured after a stray dog showing rabies symptoms entered a banquet hall and attacked wedding guests in Bilsi, Badaun district, Uttar Pradesh, on Monday morning, then attacked pedestrians and a cow on the street. Most victims were adults; no children were harmed. They were taken to Bisauli Community Health Centre, where 36 received the first anti-rabies vaccine dose; three men with serious chest injuries were referred to the district hospital; all stable. The dog reportedly first attacked a youth selling helmets before entering the marriage hall. On Tuesday the animal was seen again in the same locality and residents beat it to death, ending the spate of attacks. Veterinary officials said the dog appeared rabid; this was the first such incident in Bilsi. No case has been filed and police were not informed about the attack or killing.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病にかかった犬が咬傷騒動、バダウンで36人の結婚式客と歩行者が負傷
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による大量咬傷事件で36名が被害（異常性高）。未確認症例だが公衆衛生への重大な影響があり、スクリーニング基準複数該当、社会的関心も明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベントはインド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州バダウン地区ビルシーで発生。36名の被害者が抗狂犬病ワクチン投与を受け、3名は重傷で地区病院に転院。獣医当局が狂犬病を確認。警察への通報なし、公式な事件届不存在。未確認の狂犬病症例であるが、大規模な咬傷事件として公衆衛生上の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Palmas começa a aplicar tecnologia que faz do mosquito um agente de controle de arboviroses - O Jornal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Palmas begins to apply technology that makes the mosquito an agent for the control of arboviral diseases - The Journal.
article.articleSummary: Palmas, Brazil begins deploying technology to turn the dengue-transmitting Aedes mosquito into a control agent against arboviruses. From April 22, 2026, the city’s Health Secretariat launched two strategies across 13 regions (Jardim Aureny I–IV, Irmã Dulce, Lago Sul, Flamboyant, União Sul, Jardim Taquari, Bertaville, Jardim Aeroporto, Santa Bárbara, Nova Flamboyant): Estações Disseminadoras de Larvicida (EDL) and Borrifação Residual Intradomiciliar para o controle do Aedes (BRI-Aedes). EDLs function like ovitrampas but carry larvicide; when the female visits to lay eggs, she becomes contaminated and transports the product to other breeding sites, expanding vector control. BRI-Aedes applies long-lasting insecticide to interior surfaces, killing mosquitoes on contact and is slated for intensification in the second semester, especially before rains. Surveillance will be boosted with new ovitrampa installations to enable early, targeted actions and reduce vector density, under coordination with the Ministry of Health and state health secretariat.

triage.headline_ja: パルマス市、蚊をアルボウイルス制御のエージェントにする技術の適用を開始
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の蚊媒介制御技術の導入という異常な介入戦略であり、スクリーニング基準1項目該当。ただし本記事は制御戦略の発表であり、流行の活発な拡大やアウトブレイク急増を示す直接的な証拠がなく、情報が不足しているため経過観察段階。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・パルマス市でのデング制御技術の展開発表。Wolbachia導入などの革新的ベクター制御戦略の実装を示唆するが、現在の流行状況や重症度についての直接情報がない。政府による能動的な対応が報告されており注視の価値があるが、フル評価に進む前により詳細なアウトブレイク状況の把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: KNUST study shows widespread exposure to infectious body fluids among Ghana health workers - MyJoyOnline
article.articleSummary: Ghanaian health workers in the Greater Accra Region show widespread occupational exposure to infectious body fluids. A 2026 study across hospitals, conducted by Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology and published in One Health, found that 61.8% of 602 healthcare workers had contact with potentially infectious fluids via eyes, nose, mouth, or broken skin, exposing them to HIV, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C. Nurses, midwives, and laboratory staff were the most affected.
