Rotating shifts, overtime, and understaffing correlated with higher exposure risk, while consistent use of PPE (gloves, masks, protective eyewear) significantly reduced it. The researchers advocate structured reporting mechanisms to improve monitoring and safety practices, along with stronger institutional policies, regular training, and improved workforce planning. Lead researcher Dr. Philip Tawiah underscored the ongoing risk and the need for action to protect Ghana’s health system.

triage.headline_ja: KNUST研究がガーナの医療従事者における感染体液への広範な曝露を示す
triage.triage_reason: HIV、肝炎B・Cへの職業的曝露が確認されているが、新規の集団発生事例ではなく、実施された横断研究による職業衛生リスク評価である。IHR基準は明確には満たさないが、公衆衛生上の関連性がある。
triage.notes: 本事例は既知の感染症（HIV、肝炎B・C）への職業的曝露に関する研究論文であり、新規の流行・集団発生ではない。医療従事者における感染体液曝露リスク（61.8%の接触報告）と、適切なPPE使用による防止効果が明らかになっている。職業衛生面での懸念があるため、継続的なモニタリング対象とすべきだが、緊急対応は不要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: COVID-19: Cross River traces, isolates 10 persons over contact with Chinese national
article.articleSummary: Cross River State identifies and isolates 10 individuals who had contact with a Chinese national who reportedly reimported COVID-19 into Nigeria. The state epidemiologist, Inyang Ekpenyong, says the ten persons are quarantined after contact-tracing. The Chinese national, a 53-year-old male working in Akamkpa LGA, flew into Nigeria on March 17 and later developed symptoms; diagnostic samples at the University of Calabar Teaching Hospital (UCTH) confirmed COVID-19. Authorities note protocols have been followed and there is no alarm, with the patient’s movements restricted to his home while receiving treatment; he is reportedly responding to care at UCTH. Public health officials urged regular handwashing and mask-wearing and adherence to medical advisories to mitigate spread. Commissioner Henry Ayuk had announced the COVID-19 case earlier, indicating ongoing surveillance and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19：クロスリバー州、中国人との接触で10人を追跡・隔離
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の確定症例（輸入症例）と接触者追跡が報告されており、スクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当する可能性があるが、情報が限定的であり、ナイジェリアは対象国外のため詳細なRRA前に続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にナイジェリアとChinaが列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題は『ナイジェリア（クロスリバー州）での中国人からの輸入COVID-19症例とその接触者追跡』である。ナイジェリアは対象国（GeoNames ID）リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。Chinaについては、症例の『発症地』ではなく『出発地』としての記載であり、実際のイベント発生地はナイジェリアのため含めない。社会的・政治的関心は限定的であり、症例は軽症で対応中と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Após ampliar ações preventivas, Nova Santa Rita registra queda nos casos de dengue | abc+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After expanding preventive measures, Nova Santa Rita records a drop in dengue cases | abc+.
article.articleSummary: Nova Santa Rita, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, expanded vector-control measures against Aedes aegypti, with visits by Environmental Surveillance teams up more than 115% in recent months and installation of ovitraps. The Municipal Health Secretariat reports a 60% drop in dengue cases. Acting Health Secretary Mariana Colombo says teams average 3,000 visits per two-month cycle, rotating activities across strategic points and trap monitoring, following an operational calendar aligned with weather and vehicle availability. Current focus areas include Berto Círio, Centro, Pedreira, Morretes, Califórnia, Maria José and Caju; Berto Círio and Centro have the highest incidence. Residents receive guidance on proper waste disposal, eliminating standing water, dengue symptoms, and prevention. As of mid-April, Nova Santa Rita had 2 confirmed dengue cases, with 20 suspected and 17 discarded; 2025 saw 153 cases. When a focus is identified, authorities may involve the Ombudsman and apply enforcement measures. Community contact: WhatsApp 51 98923-0926; ouvidoria@novasantarita.rs.gov.br.

triage.headline_ja: 予防措置を拡大した後、ノヴァ・サンタ・リタはデング熱患者数の減少を記録
triage.triage_reason: 記事はブラジルのノヴァ・サンタ・リタにおけるデング熱患者数の**減少**を報告する肯定的なニュースであり、IHR基準を満たさない。患者数が減少傾向にあり、公衆衛生上の新興の危機を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な内容は予防措置の成功と患者数の60%減少を報告するもので、新規の感染症危機を示唆するシグナルではない。ブラジル南部での局所的なデング熱対策の進展を示す情報提供型記事である。

article.articleHeadline: KNUST study shows widespread exposure to infectious body fluids among Ghana health workers - Ghanamma.com
article.articleSummary: Across Ghana's Greater Accra Region hospitals, a 2026 study by Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST, Kumasi) published in One Health found that 61.8% of 602 healthcare workers had contact with potentially infectious body fluids via eyes, nose, mouth, or broken skin. Exposures are linked to HIV, Hepatitis B, and Hepatitis C. Nurses, midwives, and laboratory staff were the most affected groups. Lead researcher Dr. Philip Tawiah cites experiences during 2012 hospital internships and notes that rotating shifts, overtime, and understaffing heighten risk, with fatigue driving splashes. Consistent PPE use, gloves, masks, and protective eyewear, significantly reduces exposure. The study suggests structured reporting, stronger institutional policies, regular training, and improved workforce planning to protect health workers, a cornerstone of Ghana's health system. No outbreak details or imported/exported cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: KNUST研究がガーナの医療従事者における感染性体液への広範な曝露を示唆
triage.triage_reason: 医療従事者への職業曝露に関する研究論文報告であり、集団感染イベント（アウトブレイク）ではない。ただし公衆衛生上の関心領域であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は医療従事者の職業曝露に関する研究結果の報告であり、進行中のアウトブレイクではない。サマリーに『No outbreak details or imported/exported cases reported』と明記されている。長期的な職業曝露リスク（prolonged_exposure）という観点ではWPRO基準1項目該当するが、シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準には達しない。公開衛生政策への関心（医療施設の安全管理強化）があるため、経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: 春季注意预防传染病
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Take precautions to prevent infectious diseases in spring.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-22, Beijing and across China report fluctuations in respiratory infections, with influenza viruses and rhinoviruses on the rise since April. With the upcoming May Day holiday, increased travel and gatherings may raise transmission risk. The National Center for Disease Control and Prevention warns to watch for vector-borne diseases such as dengue fever and chikungunya, as well as enteric infections including norovirus and hand, foot and mouth disease. Public guidance emphasizes seasonal weather awareness, prompt clothing adjustments, and pre-travel checks on destinations’ health conditions; maintain hygiene in food and water to prevent disease from ingestion. Ongoing emphasis on household protection for vulnerable groups, notably the elderly and young children. The briefing does not report specific case counts; the aim is heightened prevention and public health preparedness during holiday mobility.

triage.headline_ja: 春季注意予防伝染病（春季における感染症予防に注意）
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症が列挙されているが、記事は予防呼びかけ・公衆衛生準備の啓発性質であり、具体的な患者数や確定事例がない。スクリーニング基準に部分的に該当するが情報が不足しており、続報の注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は中国（特に北京）における季節性感染症予防の公式啓発。インフルエンザ、ノロウイルス、手足口病、デング熱、チクングニアなど複数疾患が言及されているが、具体的な患者数や重症度の報告がなく、予防ガイダンス性質が強い。5月1日連休における人流増加がリスク要因として指摘されている。確定事例や重症者情報の続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Solo Temukan 405 Kasus TBC, Tracing Kontak Erat di Mojosongo dan Jebres
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Solo Health Department Finds 405 TB Cases, Close Contact Tracing in Mojosongo and Jebres
article.articleSummary: TB in Solo City, Central Java, Indonesia: 405 tuberculosis (TB) cases recorded January–March 2026, with all patients currently under treatment. The Solo City Health Office (Dinkes) notes TB is airborne, spreading via droplets within about one meter. Integrated TB tracing with free health checks (CKG) identified 100 close contacts in the Mojosongo and Jebres sub-districts. The city has established 54 kelurahan (urban wards) as TB care villages to extend management, prevention, and health education at the community level. Mayor Respati Ardi frames integrated TB tracing as a government priority and indicates plans to rehabilitate substandard housing for TB-affected residents. The program is a collaboration among the Ministry of Health, Poltekes, and Solo Dinkes to sustain treatment and curb transmission at the local level.

triage.headline_ja: ソロ保健局が結核405例を発見、ジェブレスとモジョソンゴでの濃厚接触者追跡
triage.triage_reason: 結核の地域クラスターであるが、すべての患者が既に治療下にあり、濃厚接触者追跡が実施されているため直ちに国際拡大リスクは低い。ただし地域的な公衆衛生上の懸念と対応体制の確認が必要なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年4月配信と未来日時を示す可能性があるが、2026年1～3月の415例の結核症例報告は実在のイベントとして扱った。結核は慢性感染症であり急速な国際拡大のリスクは低いが、空気感染可能な感染症として、地域的な管理体制の有効性確認と濃厚接触者からの新規症例発生有無について続報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe avança no Brasil e casos quase dobram antes do inverno em 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza spreads in Brazil and cases nearly double before winter in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Influenza-driven SRAG (severe acute respiratory syndrome) cases in Brazil surged early in 2026, with 3,584 influenza-attributed SRAG cases from January to mid-March, nearly double the 1,838 recorded in the same period in 2025. Across the period, more than 800 people died from respiratory viruses in Brazil, and total SRAG cases reached about 14,000 by mid-March, signaling widespread viral circulation. Contagem, in the Belo Horizonte metropolitan area, declared a state of emergency due to rising respiratory illnesses. Virologist Anderson Brito notes that the COVID-19 pandemic altered respiratory virus behavior, shifting seasonality. In response, authorities accelerated vaccination nationwide, aiming to immunize 90% of priority groups by May 30. About 6 million doses have been administered, covering children, older adults, pregnant women, health workers, teachers, Indigenous peoples, and people with comorbidities, with free vaccination at health posts.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでインフルエンザが拡大、2026年冬前にケース数がほぼ倍増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：800人以上の死亡、予想外の季節的変化、国際的拡大リスク）。スクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。ブラジル国内での大規模なSRAG流行と対応体制の強化が確認される。
triage.notes: ブラジルにおけるインフルエンザ主導のSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）の著しい増加を報告。2025年同時期比で97%の症例増加、800人以上の死亡、約14,000件のSRAG総症例。季節性の異変はCOVID-19パンデミック後の呼吸器ウイルス行動変化に関連している可能性がある。当局による迅速なワクチン接種キャンペーン展開（590万回接種実績）。Contagem市における非常事態宣言が発令されている。

article.articleHeadline: 小动物可能携带病毒，被咬伤有致命风险
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Small animals may carry viruses; bites can be fatal.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-04-22 in Nanjing, China, a 60-year-old man developed rat bite fever after a mouse bite, evolving from a tiny finger wound to fever and migratory joint pain, culminating in near-immobility. Delayed wound care and vaccination preceded rapid deterioration, with pain spreading to the right knee, left shoulder, and ankle, leaving him unable to stand or feed himself. At Nanjing Second Hospital, Taishan Campus, clinicians diagnosed rat bite fever caused by rodent-borne bacteria Streptobacillus moniliformis (beaded-chain bacillus) and Spirillum minus. After targeted therapy, he recovered enough to walk independently and regained shoulder function. Rat bite fever is a rare but serious zoonosis with incubation 3–10 days; early symptoms resemble flu, followed by migratory arthralgia and rash, and potential complications include endocarditis, septic arthritis, sepsis, or meningitis. Prevention emphasizes prompt wound washing (15 minutes), disinfection, and seeking medical care after animal bites, with awareness of risks from pets and wildlife.

triage.headline_ja: 小動物がウイルスを持ち運ぶ可能性があり、咬傷は致命的なリスクがある
triage.triage_reason: ネズミ咬傷熱（Rat Bite Fever）は稀な人畜共通感染症だが、記事は単一症例報告であり、流行の兆候や国際的拡大リスクは明確でない。情報が限定的であり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ネズミ咬傷熱は既知の稀な人畜共通感染症であり、記事は単一症例の臨床報告である。南京市での孤発症例であり、流行の証拠はない。予防啓発情報が含まれているが、新規の感染症アウトブレイク兆候とは言い難い。ただし稀有な重症化例として医学的には注目に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Seis casos de tuberculose latente são confirmados em comunidade rural de Macapá
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Six cases of latent tuberculosis are confirmed in a rural community in Macapá.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-22, six latent tuberculosis infections have been confirmed in the rural area of Tracajatuba I, Macapá, Brazil, following a positive test in a 12-year-old student. Health teams expanded screening in the community after the case, with direct contacts undergoing tuberculin skin tests. Those testing positive will be referred to the Centro de Especialidades Dr. Papaléo Paes in Macapá for chest X-rays, to confirm active disease and guide treatment. Latent TB means the bacteria are present but dormant, with no symptoms and no transmission; however, if immune defenses wane, it can become active and transmissible. Authorities are conducting health education and medical consultations to identify new cases and rule out active infection. If treatment is started, drugs aim to eradicate the bacteria and reduce progression to active TB. Reported active-disease symptoms include a persistent cough for two weeks or more, fever, night sweats, and weight loss.

triage.headline_ja: マカパの農村コミュニティで潜伏結核6例が確認
triage.triage_reason: 潜伏結核のみで、能動的感染症ではなく、記事から重症度、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクのいずれも明確ではない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当基準が不足しており、フルRRA対象外。
triage.notes: 記事で報告されているのは潜伏結核（latent tuberculosis）のみであり、能動的結核（active tuberculosis）ではない。潜伏結核は感染性なく、症状もなく、通常の公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。スクリーニング実施中であり、当局は適切に対応している。規模も小規模（農村コミュニティ6例）であり、国際的拡大リスクや渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : les efforts du gouvernement et ses partenaires salués pour l'éradication de la poliomyélite - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: The government's and its partners' efforts praised for polio eradication - ACP
article.articleSummary: Polio eradication efforts in the Democratic Republic of Congo advanced with the launch of the first vaccination phase in Beni, North Kivu, in the east. The campaign targets immunizing over two million children across 34 health zones from 23 to 25 April 2026, using oral polio vaccine type 2 to strengthen immunity and interrupt transmission. The initiative is supported by partners including WHO and UNICEF, with praise for the government and its allies. Provincial authorities, led by vice-governor Louis Segond Karawa, urged security forces, mayors, and neighborhood leaders to mobilize communities, while parents were urged to bring their children for immunization. Success depends on broad parental and community engagement, as emphasized by the North Kivu Health Division, reflecting ongoing eradication efforts in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：ポリオ根絶のための政府とパートナーの努力が称賛される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ（根絶対象疾患）の予防接種キャンペーン実施は肯定的な公衆衛生対応であるが、同時に進行中の感染伝播の存在を示唆している。IHR基準2つ以上には達しないが、スクリーニング基準（異常性・長期曝露・流行易知性）に複数該当し、情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はポリオの根絶キャンペーン実施を報じており、DRC（特にベニ、北キヴ州）での進行中の伝播リスクを示唆している。WHO/UNICEFの支援と政府の関心が認められ、200万人以上の小児を対象とした大規模予防接種キャンペーンが計画されている。記事は肯定的なトーンであるが、キャンペーン実施の必要性自体が地域内でのポリオ伝播の継続存在を示す。感染確認数・重症度・死亡数などの詳細情報は記事には含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 天气转暖蚊虫蜱虫活跃 户外活动需做好防范
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the weather warms, mosquitoes and ticks become active; take precautions for outdoor activities.
article.articleSummary: Guangxi’s Nanning reports earlier mosquito activity due to rapid spring warming, led by Aedes albopictus (the white-striped/Asian tiger mosquito), a principal dengue and chikungunya vector. Activity peaks are daytime, roughly 7–9 a.m. and 5–7 p.m., with thresholds around 15°C; authorities say there is no conclusive evidence of exceptionally high mosquito numbers, so routine protection and avoiding long exposure in dense mosquito areas are advised. Seek medical care promptly if fever, rash, or joint pain develop. As temperatures rise, ticks are also becoming active. Outdoors, thoroughly check for ticks on return home, focusing on the scalp, neck, and body. Ticks are small but swell after feeding; remove them slowly and vertically to prevent rupture, and avoid twisting or pulling forcefully. Tick saliva can numb bites, making detection harder. Before outdoor activities, use DEET-based repellents; if fever, fatigue, headache, nausea, or vomiting occur after exposure, seek medical care and report the exposure history.

triage.headline_ja: 気温の上昇に伴い蚊・ダニが活発化、屋外活動での予防が必要
triage.triage_reason: 広西チワン族自治区南寧でのデング熱・チクングニア熱の媒介蚊（ヒトスジシマカ）の活動活発化を報道しているが、当局は「例外的に高い蚊の数」の根拠がないと述べており、深刻度や異常性の証拠が限定的。継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 中国当局は蚊の数が例外的に高いことを否定しており、予防啓発が主目的。記事はデング熱・チクングニア熱の媒介蚊活動が季節的に活発化する時期到来を報道するもので、現在の疾病発生を示唆する具体的な病例報告がない。ダニ活動も併記されているが同様に予防啓発のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de SP amplia estratégia de vacinação contra chikungunya e inicia ação em Bady Bassitt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo government expands its vaccination strategy against chikungunya and begins action in Bady Bassitt.
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya vaccination expands in Bady Bassitt, São Paulo, under a state strategy. On April 22, the São Paulo government began offering the Instituto Butantan–Valneva chikungunya vaccine free at local health units to residents aged 18–59 in Bady Bassitt, near São José do Rio Preto. The campaign follows a Mirassol pilot and uses Ministry of Health guidelines; the municipality has about 29,000 residents. The vaccine, approved by Anvisa in April 2025 and authorized in Canada, the UK, and the EU, requires a single dose and is generally well tolerated. In the first phase, 10 municipalities across four states were selected; Mirassol reached 5,415 doses by April 21. Safety and immunogenicity were shown in Brazil and the US, with ~99% of US trial participants developing neutralizing antibodies. In 2025, São Paulo state had 7,952 chikungunya cases and seven deaths; by April 21, 2026, 616 cases and two deaths. Symptoms include sudden high fever and severe joint pain; treatment is supportive.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州政府がチクングニア熱ワクチン接種戦略を拡大し、バディ・バッシットでの対策を開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるチクングニア熱ワクチン接種キャンペーンの展開についての記事。公衆衛生対応としては適切だが、新たな流行の急速な拡大を示す証拠がなく、むしろ予防接種による制御段階を示唆している。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はチクングニア熱に対する州政府の予防接種戦略の拡大について述べており、ワクチン承認後の実装段階である。2025年に7,952症例、7死亡があったが、2026年4月21日時点で616症例、2死亡と減少傾向を示唆。国際的な懸念基準は満たさず、ブラジル国内の公衆衛生対応の段階を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus TBC Tembus 2,5 Juta Sepanjang 2025, BPJS Kesehatan Salurkan Rp3,1 Triliun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Cases Reach 2.5 Million Throughout 2025, BPJS Kesehatan Disburses Rp3.1 Trillion
article.articleSummary: TB in Indonesia totaled 2.5 million cases in 2025, with BPJS Kesehatan disbursing Rp3.1 trillion to fund tuberculosis care. The program reports treating 2,566,085 TB cases in 2025, signaling a sustained TB burden and the need to bolster the sustainability of JKN to ensure continued access for all participants. Officials stress that TB treatment costs are fully covered under JKN when patients follow required procedures and medical indications. They urge the public not to delay medical checkups or discontinue therapy mid-course and to keep JKN membership active to access services. BPJS Kesehatan offers official channels for participants to verify active status. The article highlights Indonesia's TB burden and the associated financial demands on the national social health program for 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 結核患者数が2025年通年で250万件に達する、BPJS健康保険が31兆ルピアを配分
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの結核患者数が高い水準で継続しており、公衆衛生上の関心がある。しかし、新規の勃発や異常な増加ではなく、既知の課題の報告に基づく報道であるため、シグナルとしてのレベルは限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は2025年の結核患者数統計と国家健康保険（BPJS Kesehatan）による資金配分の報告。これは既知の公衆衛生課題の政策レベルの対応内容であり、新規の感染症イベント（異常な勃発、未知の病原体、急速な増加）ではない。WPROスクリーニング基準3項目に該当するが、IHR基準は1項目のみであり、医療費支援制度の実施報道に近い。継続的な結核負担と国家対応の継続を示す情報として経過観察価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: 疫学：コウモリ由来コロナウイルスがヒト細胞に侵入する経路を特定
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemiology: Identification of the route by which bat-origin coronaviruses enter human cells.
article.articleSummary: Alphacoronaviruses from bats can enter human cells via CEACAM6 receptor, according to Gallo et al. in Nature (open access) 2026. To explore alphacoronavirus entry, 40 spike proteins representing diverse bat viruses were rendered into pseudoviruses and tested against human receptor libraries. Most bat alphacoronavirus spikes could not use known receptors, but one spike from Cardioderma cor coronavirus, isolated from Kenyan heart-nosed bat, mediated human cell entry independent of established receptors. A large-scale screen identified CEACAM6 as the entry receptor, supported by structural and functional analyses. Related African and Eurasian alphacoronaviruses showed similar receptor usage patterns. Serology in people living near bat sampling sites showed no broad evidence of infection as of 22 April 2026, suggesting low current zoonotic transmission risk, though the findings provide a framework for preemptive surveillance of alphacoronaviruses in Africa and Eurasia.

triage.headline_ja: 疫学：コウモリ由来コロナウイルスがヒト細胞に侵入する経路を特定
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は基礎研究（受容体メカニズムの解明）に関する学術報告であり、実際の発生事例や集団感染の報告ではない。血清学調査では現在のヒトへの感染の広がりの証拠がないと明記されており、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術誌Natureに掲載された基礎研究論文に関する記事である。コウモリ由来コロナウイルスのヒト細胞への侵入メカニズムを実験室で解明したもので、実際の患者発生報告や集団感染を述べていない。血清学的調査により、現在のところコウモリ採取地付近の住民における感染の広がりは示されていないと明記されている。したがって公衆衛生上の緊急事象ではなく、学術情報として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Các đơn vị khối phòng bệnh tiếp tục đẩy mạnh giám sát, phòng ngừa dịch bệnh hiệu quả
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Units in the Disease Prevention Sector Continue to Strengthen Surveillance and Effective Disease Outbreak Prevention.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 April 2026, Vietnam’s Ministry of Health (MoH) underscored enhanced surveillance and outbreak prevention by evaluating a proposed central-to-regional model for disease control. The MoH warns that openness and rising cross-border travel heighten infectious disease risks, including zoonoses. A meeting chaired by Deputy Minister Nguyễn Thị Liên Hương reviewed whether to consolidate 11 specialized institutes of preventive medicine and public health into a single Central CDC; officials argued that a two-tier local government structure remains coherent, as provincial CDCs already perform surveillance, forecasting, and early outbreak response. The MoH tasked the Institute of Preventive Medicine to compile evidence and seek inter-ministerial and government consensus before presenting to the Government. Separately, the Department of Disease Prevention issued urgent instructions to 31 provinces and five International Health Quarantine Centers—Hải Phòng, Lạng Sơn, Lào Cai, Quảng Ninh, and Khánh Hòa—and to 26 provincial CDCs to boost Nipah virus surveillance at borders.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症対策部門の各ユニットが監視と効果的な感染症発生予防を継続して強化
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの多州での国境監視強化指示、異常・予想外、国際的な国境越え感染リスク増加の明示、および動物・ヒト・環境に跨る多層的な影響が認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当およびIHR基準該当によりシグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはハイリスク病原体であり、複数の省（ラオカイ、ハイフォン、クアンニン、ランソン、カインホア）の国際保健検疫センターでの国境監視強化は、国境越え感染の懸念を反映。ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれており、記事はベトナム国内での感染症監視体制強化を主題としている。動物由来感染症（zoonoses）への言及があり、公衆衛生面での深刻な影響が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo bệnh dại: Không chủ quan với vết xước xoàng năm 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Warning: Don't Take a Minor Scratch Lightly in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Rabies remains a health concern in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, in 2026. In Q1, the Ho Chi Minh City Infectious Diseases Hospital admitted 8 rabies patients, with 3 citywide deaths this year. Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City has seen a 10% rise in people seeking vaccination, and immunoglobulin requirements up 30% vs the same period. About 90% of exposures are from dogs; cats and other animals account for the rest. Those completing a five-dose post-exposure regimen (days 0,3,7,14,28) have not developed the disease, while fatalities occur among incomplete or absent vaccination. One 81-year-old in the city developed rabies after a long incubation from an unvaccinated dog bite. Key messages: wash wounds for at least 15 minutes with soap, then antiseptic; seek medical care immediately for vaccination and possible immunoglobulin; observe a biting animal for 10 days, which informs vaccination decisions. Pre-exposure vaccination is advised for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 狂犬病警告：2026年に小さな傷を軽視するな
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおける狂犬病の継続的な公衆衛生上の懸念を示しているが、IHR基準の2つ以上の該当を確認できず、国際的拡大リスクは明確でない。ただしスクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露）の複数該当と社会的関心から要経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は周知の地域性疾患（異常性なし）だが、死亡事例、ワクチン接種希望者の増加（10%上昇）、免疫グロブリン需要増加（30%上昇）が報告されている。記事は公衆衛生警告として社会的・政府的関心を反映しており、継続的な監視が適切。国際的拡大リスク（IHR基準）は現段階では不明確。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue dispara em MG e casos confirmados chegam a 17,8 mil; alta é de 12,5% em uma semana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue surges in Minas Gerais as confirmed cases reach 17,800; a 12.5% increase in one week.
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Minas Gerais, Brazil reached 17,878 confirmed as of 22 April 2026, a 12.5% weekly rise from 15,887 on 14 April. Deaths confirmed increased to 12, with deaths under investigation rising to 28 (from 10 and 26). Probable dengue cases climbed to 48,503 (up from 45,091; about 7.6%). Chikungunya activity also increased: probable 8,400 and confirmed 4,703 (roughly 14% and 20.6% rises), with one chikungunya death confirmed and another under investigation. Zika showed smaller growth: probable 38 and confirmed 8 (from 32 and 6). No Zika deaths have been confirmed or are under investigation in Minas Gerais. The data indicate ongoing arboviral transmission in the state, underscoring sustained surveillance and public health response.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州のデング熱が急増、確認症例が17,800件に達する；1週間で12.5%増加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのミナスジェライス州でデング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱の同時流行が確認されており、デング熱の確認症例が1週間で12.5%の急速な増加を示している。死亡例も増加しており、IHR基準（異常性、公衆衛生への影響）とWPRO基準（重症度、流行性）に該当するため、フルRRA実施対象とする。
triage.notes: 複数のアルボウイルス（デング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ熱）の同時流行。デング熱が主流で急速な増加を示しており、死亡例の増加も懸念される。ミナスジェライス州はブラジルの主要州であり、国内での広域流行の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 广州处于蚊媒传染病流行前期 全市抢占灭蚊"先手"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangzhou in the pre-epidemic stage of mosquito-borne infectious diseases; the city takes the lead in mosquito elimination.
article.articleSummary: Guangzhou is in the pre-epidemic stage for mosquito-borne diseases and launched a citywide anti-mosquito campaign on April 22 Patriotic Health Day. Officials, workers, residents, and volunteers are sweeping backstreets, old communities, markets, parks, construction sites, and rooftops to clear debris and standing water, aiming to curb mosquito breeding before the rainy season. In Yuexiu District, rooftop cleaning was part of a broader sanitation drive, focusing on removing water-holding items to prevent future breeding. Post-cleaning, professional teams apply larvicides to persistent water bodies and target adults during peak activity (7–9 a.m., 5–7 p.m.). The Guangzhou CDC notes rising mosquito density with warm weather and Canton Fair-related travel, elevating the risk of local spread from imported dengue fever and chikungunya. About 30,000 ovitraps and 800 smart monitoring devices have been deployed; the current risk is low. Preventive measures include environmental management, screens, nets, repellents, and selective fogging, with ongoing “Three-One” hygiene rectification and weekly actions.

triage.headline_ja: 広州は蚊媒介感染症の流行前期に入り、全市で蚊駆除の「先制攻撃」を展開
triage.triage_reason: チクングニア熱とデング熱の2つの蚊媒介疾患が報告されており、異常性・流行可能性の評価が必要だが、現段階では既に予防的対応が実施されており、重大な公衆衛生影響や国際的拡大リスクについて具体的な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 広州市は蚊媒介疾患（デング熱・チクングニア熱）の流行前期段階にあり、当局が既に大規模な蚊駆除キャンペーンを実施している。現在の感染リスクは低いとされているが、暖かい気候と広州交易会関連の人員移動により局所伝播リスクが高まっている。大規模な監視体制（30,000個の卵トラップ・800台のスマート監視機器）が整備されている。情報不足のため、引き続き進展を監視し、より詳細な患者データ・増加傾向の確認後に判定を更新する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo người trẻ mắc giang mai, diễn biến âm thầm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Syphilis in young people — a silent progression.
article.articleSummary: In Vietnam, a man over 20 was admitted with syphilis after unprotected sex. He developed a non-tender penile ulcer two weeks after intercourse, which progressed to a purulent discharge after a month, with mild itching but no fever. Laboratory work by Dr. Dương Thị Thúy Quỳnh at the National Dermatology Hospital confirmed Treponema pallidum infection. Syphilis is sexually transmitted and can spread via blood and from mother to child; if untreated, it may progress to neurosyphilis, cardiovascular syphilis, or congenital syphilis. Clinicians emphasize high STI risk with unsafe sex and that reinfection can occur even after treatment. A separate report notes a nearly 3-year-old boy testing positive for syphilis during overseas work pre-employment health checks, highlighting maternal transmission risk and the need for testing.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：若年層の梅毒感染、静かに進行する
triage.triage_reason: 梅毒（先天梅毒を含む）の症例報告であり、WPROスクリーニング基準で「異常/予想外」「重症度」に該当する可能性があるが、現時点では単一の症例報告・臨床啓発記事であり、集団発生規模や流行状況が不明確。追加情報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は若年層の梅毒感染の臨床的特徴と母子感染リスクについての啓発記事。複数症例が報告されているが、集団発生（アウトブレイク）としての規模や流行状況の詳細は記述されていない。梅毒は性感染症であり流行しやすい性質があり、先天梅毒の事例も含まれているため重症度基準に該当。ただし、現段階では個別症例報告の域を出ていないため、WATCH判定とする。後続の疫学情報（患者数増加、地域拡大など）の監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Com baixa vacinação e casos em alta, Capital terá novo Dia D contra gripe
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With low vaccination coverage and rising cases, the capital will have a new D-Day against influenza.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-04-23, Campo Grande reports 287 Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) cases, with 40 influenza-confirmed cases and 5 deaths, per CIEVS-CG. Vaccination coverage among priority groups is only 18%, far below expectations. In response, the Municipal Health Secretariat (Sesau) is staging a new influenza Vaccine Day (Dia D) on Saturday the 25th to broaden protection, following an initial drive on March 28; vaccination began March 26. Urgent/emergency care demand is rising due to greater circulation of respiratory viruses, risking crowding and longer wait times, especially with cooler temperatures potentially worsening SRAG season. Priority groups—elderly, young children, pregnant individuals, and those with comorbidities—are urged to vaccinate promptly. Vaccination will be available at 27 health units (7:30–16:45) plus a central point at Praça Ary Coelho (8:00–16:00); access continues across 74 USFs during the week. Last year’s coverage was only 59%.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン接種率の低さと感染者数の増加により、州都でインフルエンザに対する新たなワクチン接種キャンペーン実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのカンポグランデでインフルエンザ関連のSRAG症例287件、インフルエンザ確認40件、死亡5件が報告されており、重症度と長期曝露の可能性がWPRO基準を満たすが、現時点では地域限定的で国際的拡大リスクの情報が不足している。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルのマットグロッソ・ド・スル州カンポグランデで発生しているインフルエンザ関連SRAGについて報告。低いワクチン接種率（18%、昨年59%）とインフルエンザ死亡5件が報告されており、重症度と長期曝露リスクが認められる。ただし、発生地域は1都市に限定的であり、国際的拡大リスクの明示的な記述がないため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: 武汉疾控提醒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Wuhan CDC Issues Reminder
article.articleSummary: Wuhan CDC warns as temperatures rise and rainfall increases, mosquitoes and ticks become active around Wuhan, with more outdoor activities noted. The risk of imported and local transmission of dengue fever and chikungunya fever is rising due to increased international travel. Dengue fever, caused by dengue virus and transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, presents with facial, neck, and chest flushing, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias/arthralgias, and potential bleeding. Chikungunya fever, caused by chikungunya virus and also Aedes-borne, features fever, rash, and severe joint pain, particularly in wrists and ankles, lasting weeks to months. Prevention emphasizes eliminating standing water, removing breeding sites, using insecticides, screens, bed nets, protective clothing, and repellents. The article also covers fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), a tick-borne illness with fever and low platelets, peaking April–October in mountainous areas; prevention includes tick avoidance, careful removal, disinfection, and prompt medical care if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: 武漢CDCが注意喚起：蚊とマダニの活動が活発化、デング熱・チクングニア熱・SFTSのリスク上昇
triage.triage_reason: 気温上昇と降雨増加に伴う蚊・マダニの活動活発化と、デング熱・チクングニア熱・SFTS の複数の媒介生物感染症が同時に言及されている。ただし、現在の具体的な患者数や死亡数の記載がなく、主に予防啓発である点が不確定要因。
triage.notes: 記事は武漢CDCによる季節性リスク注意喚起であり、既存の公衆衛生上の周知である可能性が高い。デング熱・チクングニア熱は輸入症例リスク、SFTSは山岳地域での季節的リスクとして言及されているが、進行中のアウトブレイク報告ではない。患者数・入院数・死亡数の明記がないため情報不足。続報で具体的な流行データが出現した場合は PICKUP 昇格を検討する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: เด็กอายุต่ำกว่า 5 ปี "กลุ่มเสี่ยงสูงสุด" ไวรัสพาราอินฟลูเอนซา จริงหรือไม่? : เช็กข่าวชัวร์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Children under 5 years old are the "highest-risk group" for parainfluenza virus — is that true? : Fact-check.
article.articleSummary: Thai fact-check on parainfluenza: In weeks 13–14 of 2026 (22 March–4 April), 268 samples were tested under the Flu-RightSize respiratory surveillance; 68.7% were positive, with Parainfluenza types 1–4 most common. Among hospitalized severe cases (SARI), children under 5 years accounted for 70.6% of cases, with Parainfluenza and Rhinovirus as the principal pathogens. Typical early symptoms include cough, sore throat, and mild fever; most infections are mild and self-limiting, but young children and older adults with comorbidities can develop serious respiratory complications. The data supports that under-5s are the highest-risk group for parainfluenza and its severe manifestations during the analyzed period.

triage.headline_ja: 5歳未満の子どもはパラインフルエンザの「最高リスク群」か？：ファクトチェック
triage.triage_reason: タイでパラインフルエンザの活動が報告されており、小児での重症化が認められているが、記事はファクトチェック形式で制度的な懸念の程度が不明。社会的関心や国際的懸念の詳細が記事サマリーからは判断しがたい。
triage.notes: 記事はパラインフルエンザ（parainfluenza）をテーマとしており、2026年第13-14週（3月22日～4月4日）の呼吸器サーベイランスデータを報告。小児（5歳未満）における重症例（SARI）が70.6%を占めており、重症度が認められる。ただし記事の性質がファクトチェック形式であり、公衆衛生上の懸念の緊急性が明確でない。タイの政府サーベイランスシステムが稼働中であることから、管理可能性は相対的に高い可能性があるが、詳細は記事サマリーでは不明。

article.articleHeadline: 腸病毒疫情升溫，疾管署估6月中下旬達高峰！兩大兒醫學會籲：接種疫苗防重症  | 華人健康網 - 專業即時優質的健康新聞及資訊分享平台業即時優質的健康新聞及資訊分享平台
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Enterovirus outbreak intensifies; Taiwan CDC estimates a peak in mid-to-late June. Two leading pediatric medical associations urge vaccination to prevent severe illness.
article.articleSummary: As of 23 April 2026, Taiwan reports a rapid rise in enterovirus activity, with last week’s enterovirus-related visits exceeding 3,500 (up 16.5% from the prior week) and projections for May over 5,000, June around 10,000, peaking in mid-to-late June as schools close for summer. In response, the Taiwan Association of Pediatric Infectious Diseases and the Taiwan Society of Neonatology issued a prevention consensus urging vaccination against Enterovirus 71 (EV71) to prevent severe illness. EV71 is the most neurotropic and deadly enterovirus; from 2005–2024, about 80% of severe cases were EV71, with a case fatality up to 20%. Children under 2 are high risk; aim to build protection before age 6, evaluating vaccines for international evidence, real-world effectiveness, and antibodies lasting at least five years. Vietnam reports large EV71-dominated outbreaks (>26,000 cases) in the region. Severe warning signs include lethargy, altered consciousness, limb weakness, seizures, persistent vomiting, rapid breathing, or tachycardia; seek care promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 腸病毒疫情升溫，疾管署估6月中下旬達高峰！兩大兒醫學會籲：接種疫苗防重症
triage.triage_reason: 台湾ではエンテロウイルス71（EV71）の活動が急増し、6月中下旬にピークを迎える見通しが示されており、ベトナムでも大規模な集団発生（26,000例以上）が報告されている。EV71の致命率は最大20%であり、国家レベルでの予防接種キャンペーンが発動されている。IHR基準2つ以上に該当し、公衆衛生への重大な影響が認識されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にTaiwanが含まれているが、対象国リストに台湾は含まれていないため、verified_locationsはVietnamのみとした。記事サマリーでベトナムにおいて26,000例以上のEV71主導型集団発生が報告されている点を確認。台湾での状況は対象国外のため、フルRRAでの追跡対象は主にベトナムの発生となる。

article.articleHeadline: 江山平教授团队首提慢阻肺曲霉菌感染六型分类
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Professor Jiang Shanping's team first proposed a six-type classification of COPD-associated aspergillosis.
article.articleSummary: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease-associated aspergillosis (COPD-IPA) presents with diverse clinical phenotypes and high mortality, largely due to delayed diagnosis. In Guangdong, invasive aspergillosis occurs in about 3.9% of hospitalized COPD patients, with national estimates suggesting COPD-IPA may affect over one million people in China. Despite antifungal therapy, mortality exceeds 43%. A study from Sun Yat-sen University’s Sun Yat-sen Memorial Hospital, led by Professor Jiang Shanping, analyzed 63 COPD-IPA patients treated between 2008 and 2024 to propose the first internationally proposed six-type classification: explosive, tuberculosis-like, pneumonia-like, asthma-like, tumor-like, and heart failure–like. Published in the Journal of Thoracic Disease, the framework integrates demographics, clinical features, laboratory data, imaging, disease course, and treatment response, aiming to enable earlier diagnosis and treatment and improve prognosis across China.

triage.headline_ja: 江山平教授チームが初めてCOPD関連曲霉菌感染の6型分類を提案
triage.triage_reason: COPD関連曲霉菌感染の臨床分類に関する研究報告であり、新規感染症アウトブレイク・エピデミック事象ではない。既知疾患の診断分類枠組みの学術的提案であるため、シグナル基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は既知疾患（COPD関連侵襲性アスペルギルス症）の臨床分類枠組みに関する学術研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや流行を示唆する情報ではない。Bluedot APIが結核（Tuberculosis）と分類しているが、記事の主題はアスペルギルス菌感染の臨床分類であり、肺結核そのものではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Idoso é encontrado em situação grave com larvas no corpo em MS - Diário News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly man found in serious condition with larvae in his body in Mato Grosso do Sul - Diário News
article.articleSummary: An 83-year-old man was found in extremely grave condition in a room at the rear of a house in Selvíria, Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, on 10 April 2026. He displayed dehydration, malnutrition, multiple injuries, and a larval infestation (myiasis), indicating probable long-term neglect. Medical teams treated him and an ambulance transported him to hospital. The discovery mobilized social-work staff from CREAS, the Military Police, and health services following an anonymous report. Family members at the scene denied mistreatment. The case is registered as mistreatment and is under Civil Police investigation to determine circumstances and caregiver responsibilities. The incident has generated strong public reaction in Mato Grosso do Sul due to the severity of the findings.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・マットグロッソドスル州で高齢者がハエの幼虫に感染した状態で発見
triage.triage_reason: Tumbu Flyは医学的には寄生虫症であり感染症ではなく、本事例は虐待・ネグレクト事件の性質が強い。集団発生の可能性がなく、公衆衛生上の緊急事態性が低い。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていない（3469034はリストに存在しない）。また本事例は単一患者の虐待・ネグレクト事件であり、感染症の流行・集団発生ではなく、シグナル監視の対象外。重症度は高いが寄生虫症であり感染症危機管理の範囲外。

article.articleHeadline: 被群狗围攻女生被诊断为狂犬病Ⅲ级暴露 校园安全引关注
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Female student attacked by a pack of dogs diagnosed with Category III rabies exposure; campus safety draws attention.
article.articleSummary: On April 21, a female student at Pingdingshan University in Pingdingshan, Henan, was attacked by a pack of stray dogs while returning from the library to her dormitory, suffering bites to both legs. She was diagnosed with Category III rabies exposure and began treatment; her condition is stable. The university issued an update expressing regret and promising ongoing medical care and psychological support, and will cooperate with her family for follow-up arrangements. Local authorities—police and urban management—are coordinating to manage campus stray animals and carry out professional disposal. A 2019 campus notice tightened dog management, banning dogs outside staff housing and requiring dog registration within one week at the school police office; unregistered dogs may be captured. Pets outside teaching and dormitory areas must be removed within a week, with security and police enforcing inspections. Stray dogs on campus are to be handed over to authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 群犬に襲われた女子学生が狂犬病Ⅲ級曝露と診断される キャンパスの安全が注目を集める
triage.triage_reason: 単一の接触事例であり、IHR基準の国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクは低い。ただし狂犬病は致死的感染症であり、地域の社会的関心は高まっているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死的感染症であるが、本事例は単一の個人接触（Category III暴露）であり、アウトブレイク兆候ではない。キャンパス内の野犬管理という限定的な公衆衛生問題。大学および地方当局が既に対応を開始しており、患者の状態は安定している。狂犬病の二次感染リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: 夫妻同住羊圈双双染病 罕见病例敲响警钟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Married couple living in a sheep pen both infected; a rare case sounds the alarm.
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis diagnosed in a married couple living in a sheep pen in Guangyuan, China, after prolonged close exposure to sheep and livestock. Both developed fever and back pain; the wife later developed lumbar and paravertebral infection with night pain, while the husband had milder fever with similar back pain. Initial evaluation misattributed symptoms to lumbar strain; MRI suggested spinal infection. The shared exposure prompted serologic and culture testing. Rose Bengal plate agglutination test (RBT) and blood cultures were performed; Brucella grew in blood culture within 48 hours, confirming Brucellosis. Following standard anti-infective therapy, fever resolved within three days and back pain markedly improved. This rare case underscores Class B zoonotic disease risk from occupational livestock exposure. Guangyuan City Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital’s Infectious Diseases Department issued public education urging high-risk individuals—especially those in close contact with cattle or sheep—to strengthen prevention and seek early treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 羊小屋に住む夫妻が同時に感染 稀な症例が警鐘を鳴らす
triage.triage_reason: ブルセラ症の確認症例で、異常性（夫妻の同時感染）と重症度（脊椎感染）が明確。公衆衛生教育の発出と職業的リスクの警示により社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事は中国・広元市における夫妻のブルセラ症確認事例を報告。Class B人獣共通感染症の職業的リスク啓発が発令されており、地元医療機関による公衆衛生教育の実施が確認される。脊椎感染など重篤な臓器合併症が発生した稀な症例として医学的価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: RSUD H Padjonga Daeng Ngalle Takalar Gencar Sosialisasi Campak
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Regional General Hospital H. Padjonga Daeng Ngalle Takalar Intensifies Measles Outreach
article.articleSummary: Measles outreach led by pediatric specialist Dr. Andriana Susanti (Sp.A) at Regional General Hospital H. Padjonga Daeng Ngalle (HPDN) in Takalar, South Sulawesi, Indonesia. On Tuesday, 21 April 2026, hundreds of outpatients attended a measles information session at the hospital’s Polyclinic area (Jalan H Ince Husain Daeng Parani, Kalabbirang, Pattallassang) as Dr. Susanti, nicknamed dr. Anti, presented using projector slides with staff coordinating at five service counters. The report documents no measles cases, deaths, laboratory confirmation, or outbreak data. The outreach highlights ongoing public health education on measles prevention and vaccination for residents of Takalar Regency.

triage.headline_ja: タカラル地域総合病院H・パジョンガ・ダエン・ガレがはしかの啓発活動を強化
triage.triage_reason: はしかの啓発・教育活動の報道であり、確認された患者数、死亡例、検査確認例、発生状況のいずれも記載されていない。公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクはいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事ははしかの予防と予防接種に関する病院主導の啓発キャンペーンを記録するもので、発生状況を報告するものではない。確認された患者数、死亡数、検査結果、または疫学的データは記載されていない。したがって、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Vì sao 'sốt đất' được gọi là bệnh 'vi khuẩn ăn thịt người'?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why is 'real estate fever' called the 'flesh-eating bacteria' disease?
article.articleSummary: Melioidosis (Whitmore disease), caused by Burkholderia pseudomallei, is a rapidly progressive infection producing necrotizing soft tissue disease and multi-organ abscesses. In Thailand, as of 2026-04-23, it has caused 23 deaths among more than 700 cases, prompting an outbreak warning. Transmission mainly via contact with contaminated soil or water, through skin wounds, inhalation, or ingestion; human-to-human spread is limited. Clinical features include high fever, respiratory distress, hypotension, chronic fever, skin lesions, and abscesses in liver, spleen, lungs, bones, or prostate; some progress to septic shock. Diagnosis relies on culture of Burkholderia pseudomallei from blood or fluids, PCR, or serology. No vaccine; prevention emphasizes avoiding soil/water exposure, wearing protective gear, wound care, and seeking early care. Early, targeted antibiotics can cure Whitmore when detected promptly.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ「土地熱」は「食肉性細菌」病と呼ばれるのか？
triage.triage_reason: メリオイドーシスの集団発生として、タイにおいて700例以上の症例と23人の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への影響が深刻で異常なイベント。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、スクリーニング基準でも複数該当するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム語ソースだが、主題はタイでのメリオイドーシス集団発生。700例以上の症例数と23人の死亡という重篤な状況が示されており、土壌・水汚染を通じた継続的な曝露リスク（prolonged exposure）が存在。ワクチンなく、早期抗生物質治療が重要。国家レベルでの対応（outbreak warning）が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Tháp: Chủ quán thịt chó tử vong do bệnh dại
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Thap: Dog meat shop owner dies from rabies.
article.articleSummary: Rabies death in Đồng Tháp Province, Vietnam: a 58-year-old dog-meat shop owner from Mỹ Tịnh An (Mỹ Trường hamlet) died on 20 April 2026. He was admitted on 15 April with dizziness and progressive right-sided weakness; later developed hydrophobia and dysphagia, and was transferred to Ho Chi Minh City Hospital of Tropical Diseases, deteriorating through 18–20 April. He died on 20 April. A 3-month-old household dog, vaccinated, lived with him; he frequently handled the animal during meat processing and was exposed to dog blood or saliva. Health authorities are tracing close contacts for rabies vaccination and coordinating with veterinary services to identify the infection source in animals and slaughter facilities. Public health advisories urge annual dog vaccination, confinement of dogs, and prompt medical care for bites to prevent further rabies transmission in Mỹ Tịnh An and Đồng Tháp.

triage.headline_ja: ドンタップ：犬肉店主が狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病による死亡例で、動物由来感染症として公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、動物と人間両方が影響を受けている。濃厚接触者追跡と地域レベルでの感染源対策が進行中であるため、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は周知の疾患であり予期されるものだが、WPROスクリーニング基準では重症度（死亡例）、長期曝露（肉処理時の動物との頻繁な接触）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-動物間、食肉処理施設での露出）、管理可能性（接触者追跡と獣医サービス連携が進行中）が複数該当。地方当局による積極的な対応と公衆衛生勧告により、政府・公共の関心が高い。
